Who We Are
2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.
Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K, renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K.
At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!
What We Need
The PGA TOUR 2K Integrated Marketing team is looking for a Manager, Product Marketing. We are responsible for building data-driven marketing strategies that reach and engage fans with value-rich experiences that drive revenue growth, brand health, and loyalty. We aim to connect fans around the world to the most engaging golf platform: our franchise. As a Manager, Product Marketing, you will be responsible for helping deliver full-funnel marketing campaigns, in partnership with internal and external partners, to drive player satisfaction and commercial success. From Seasonal Live-Service executions, to multi-faceted partnership campaigns, to targeted in-game promotions, you will ideate on product feature messaging and strategies, lead in-game creative development, oversee tactical execution plans, and leverage new and emerging technologies to best serve our players. This is a role that never stands still, and where no two days are the same. To be successful in this role, you will need to be a true product marketing expert that understands every facet of our game and how they serve our current and prospective players. Within the integrated marketing team, it is your responsibility to be the product’s source of truth to help inform go-to-market strategies through a strong, collaborative mindset and data-driven insight. An existing passion for, or a willingness to learn about, the sport of golf is key: the PGA TOUR 2K franchise is the most authentic representation of the sport, and success in this role is determined by our ability to demonstrate that to our players. What You Will Do
Manage comprehensive end-to-end marketing campaigns across our full live-services machine. From title-level level marketing planning, to Seasonal creative executions, to Free-to-Play activations, to real-life sporting event tie-ins. You will often manage multiple campaigns concurrently.
Authentically represent player needs by knowing our game in and out, through a deep understanding and appreciation for player insights and analytics, as well as time spent in the game testing out features and flows to best represent ways we highlight product value and live services content. Own our in-game lifecycle strategy: architecting messaging and offer constructs that move our players through the optimal player experience. Leverage campaign learnings and insights to optimize evergreen messaging and intervention timings. Lead and execute high-profile brand partnerships, influencer tie-ins, and promotional activations; you will work with internal Partnerships and Product teams to help establish how our licensed partners come to life in-game, then build marketing campaigns to drive awareness and engagement with their branded content. Build and maintain high-trust relationships across our Business Unit and our shared service teams to ensure zero friction in the execution of integrated global campaigns. What Will Make You A Great Fit
Product Passion & Literacy: You're as comfortable in a product roadmap conversation as a campaign brief kick off call. You know how to establish, define and represent marketing priorities to influence product decisions and create content that authentically resonates with our players. Operational Rigor: You can hold multiple campaigns, live and upcoming, in harmony without losing precision on any one of them—meeting internal and external deadlines to execute flawlessly. Content & Channel Fluency: You can partner with multiple cross-functional teams to orchestrate a multi-touchpoint tactical execution, understanding the nuance between owned, earned and paid channels to maximise acquisition and engagement.
Partnership & Licensing Acumen: You know how to run activations that integrate licenses, licensors and/or talent from concept through to legal sign-off, balancing creative ambition with third-party and IP priorities and obligations.
Cross-Functional Influence: You build trust quickly with key stakeholders across the Business Unit, shared services teams, and our development studio. You will operate as the connective tissue that keeps teams moving in the same direction towards execution.
Qualifications
Proven experience in product marketing, live-service campaign management, or lifecycle marketing experience within gaming or digital entertainment.
Extensive knowledge or interest in sports verticals, ideally golf.
Passion to deliver thoughtfully integrated campaigns players can resonate with, that showcase the product as a means to drive awareness, acquisition and retention.
Deep understanding of how to measure and report on marketing performance across owned and operated, earned, and paid channels.
Strong ability to interpret data and learnings to influence real-time decision making.
Familiarity with PC & console gaming marketing (PlayStation, Xbox. Steam) a plus.

# Director of Industrial Sensors and Instrumentation
**About 42T:**
42 Technology is a successful and growing consultancy specialising in innovation, design, and development. Our work with world leading clients in a range of industries takes products and processes from ideas to reality. We have built a reputation for challenging the status quo and finding creative and pragmatic solutions to difficult technical problems.
Our employees love the variety and challenge of our work. We have a stimulating and open culture, an excellent team, and a great location in Cambourne Park Science & Technology Campus, close to Cambridge.
#### The Role
##### **Overall purpose:**
To join 42T’s business development team in the Industrial sector, with the remit to grow our industrial product development business. The Director of Industrial Sensors and Instrumentation will drive business development activities leveraging the company’s established experience in the development of industrial sensors, instrumentation, and equipment. Connectivity, fluid mechanics, thermal control, electronics and optics are strong capabilities that we seek to build on. Embedded AI/Edge AI will be an ongoing and growing theme in this area. There will be strong links to our manufacturing innovation service for our clients.
##### **What success looks like:**
Establishing 42T as a recognised development partner within the industrial sensors, instrumentation and metrology market, building and maintaining a strong, qualified pipeline of strategically relevant opportunities, and developing senior relationships with new and existing clients to convert strategic accounts into long-term customers. Originating and winning significant, high-value consultancy projects and programmes that are technically ambitious and commercially attractive, while growing the portfolio of product development and manufacturing innovation work in the sector. Using market insight and client engagement to shape future propositions aligned with 42T's technical capabilities and emerging industry needs, and providing accurate forecasts and clear visibility of sector performance, opportunities and risks.

To grow 42T’s business in the industrial sensors, instrumentation and metrology sector.
• Develop and execute a strategy to grow the sector by selling high value, ambitious consultancy projects.
• Understand market needs and trends combined with pro-active networking to identify prospective clients and to develop those relationships into new accounts.
• High-value proposition development to align with client needs and industry trends.
• Manage existing client accounts to identify opportunities to grow the project portfolio.
• Based on deep sector knowledge, be a thought leader on the current industry trends and championing production of marketing collateral aligned with 42 Technology’s capabilities and experience.
• Lead the commercial negotiation of projects, involving relevant legal and executive colleagues as appropriate.
• Liaise with relevant project managers to oversee project delivery, ensuring that projects are delivered in accordance with – or exceeding – client expectations as well as adhering to 42 Technology’s established business management processes and culture.
##### **Working relationships:**
* You will report to 42 Technology’s Chief Commercial Officer.
* Regular reporting on progress and forecasts against strategy and plan to the wider business development team.
* Working with other members of the business development team to establish consistent and best practice within the team.
* Working with key members of the project delivery team on your projects and accounts.
* Alignment on account ownership and responsibilities with other business developers who may be involved in developing business with similar clients.
* Coaching other team members seeking to play a role in business development.
##### **Person Requirements**
**Education / Qualifications:**
*Essential:*
• Educated to degree level in a relevant technical subject such as physics, engineering or electronics. Supported by further relevant commercial qualifications.
*Desirable:*
* Higher degree, such as PhD or MBA.
**Knowledge and Skills:**
*Essential:*

• Have an extensive, relevant, pre-existing network within the sector, including C-suite and senior management in R&D, Manufacturing and/or Quality. Network must be in the UK, Western Europe and/or US geographies.
• Have good experience of business development and/or sales within the sector.

• The right to work in the UK.

*Desirable:*

• Embedded AI or Edge AI technical knowledge and a relevant network.
• Experience managing complex product development/R&D projects.
• First-hand experience of corporate innovation processes.
• Full UK Driving Licence.
***Independent working***
*Essential:*
• Self-motivated ensuring good communications with colleagues, project teams and line manager.
• Ability to work on own initiative and pro-active approach to problem solving.
***Verbal and written communication skills***
*Essential:*

*Essential:*

Are you a plastics processing technician who takes pride in getting a line running right first time, enjoys getting to the bottom of a process problem, and wants a clear, published route to the next grade rather than a vague promise of progression?
As a Production Technician at A-SAFE, you'll be the person who makes sure our production lines start correctly, run to condition and keep running through the shift. This is a hands-on process role where your judgement directly affects quality, scrap and output on products used to protect people in industrial environments worldwide.
You'll work as part of a close shift team alongside operatives, maintenance, quality and process engineering, setting up injection moulding machines and extrusion lines to the required conditions and troubleshooting issues as they arise. This is not a maintenance role and it is not machine operating - it is the technical judgement in between.
How you will make an impact:
* You'll start up and monitor injection moulding machines and extrusion lines, setting them to the specified conditions with as little scrap as possible.
* You'll troubleshoot process issues as they arise, working out the cause and putting it right, and escalating to your team leader where a decision needs to sit with them.
* You'll carry out tool changes and material changes, and set feed systems and tool temperature control units.
* You'll run first-off samples and carry out initial quality checks using the relevant gauges and equipment, interpreting the results and taking corrective action before a process is released.
* You'll optimise processes in line with standard operating procedures, contributing to cycle time and scrap reduction.
* You'll undertake minor reactive maintenance on machinery and tooling, such as oil levels and cleanliness.
* You'll complete and submit production and performance documentation accurately, keeping process records up to date when changes are made.
* You'll take and give a thorough shift handover, so the incoming team knows exactly where things stand against the plan.
* You'll work closely with operatives, supervisors, maintenance, quality and process engineering to keep production moving.
* You'll make sure health and safety guidelines are followed at all times, and that 5S and housekeeping standards are maintained.
* You'll work through a structured training and sign-off programme, building evidence towards the next grade on our technical pay scale.
What we are looking for:
* Hands-on process experience in either injection moulding or extrusion. You do not need both - most of our team joined with one and learned the other here.
* The ability to start up and run a process unsupervised, following safe working practices.
* Confidence diagnosing and resolving process and tooling faults, and knowing when to escalate.
* Experience of tool and material changes, and a working knowledge of process conditions such as material drying and barrel temperatures.
* The ability to interpret technical drawings and work to standard operating procedures.
* A clear understanding of health and safety in a manufacturing environment.
* Happy to work a continental shift pattern - four on, four off, 7am to 7pm.
* Experience across both injection moulding and extrusion is desirable, as is exposure to rotational moulding or PU elastomer processes.
* CNC or robot programming experience is desirable but not essential - it is something you can gain here.
* A certificate within injection moulding, or NVQ Level 3 in mould tools and processes, is desirable.
You'll also bring:
* Strong communication skills - handovers, sample sign-offs and working with quality and engineering make this a genuinely communicative role.
* A methodical, questioning approach to problems, and the patience to find the real cause rather than the quick fix.
* Resilience and a willingness to learn our products and tooling from the ground up, however much experience you arrive with.
* Pride in quality and attention to detail, particularly around paperwork and process records.
* A collaborative, team-focused approach - you'll be one of five on shift and the team depends on each other.
* The ambition to progress, and the self-discipline to work through the training programme and evidence your development.
Why you'll love working with us:
You'll join a shift team of five - a team leader and four technicians - working across a genuinely varied set of processes, including injection moulding, extrusion, rotational moulding, PU elastomer, CNC machining and robotics. There is real scope to broaden your technical range rather than repeat the same task.
Progression here is published, not promised. Our technical pay scale sets out exactly what you need to demonstrate at each grade, from Setter through to Technician 4, with defined assessments, minimum time at grade and sign-off from a production or process engineer. Meet the criteria and the next grade follows. Training is funded and includes external courses, and at the top of the scale you'll be mentoring the technicians coming up behind you.
You'll be properly inducted, with time shadowing an experienced technician so you learn our products and tooling before you're expected to run with them. We invest in our people, and our commitment to filling at least half of our vacancies through internal development and promotion means the route on from here is a well-travelled one.
If you enjoy solving process problems, want your technical development mapped out clearly, and like working four on, four off pattern that gives you real time back, this role is for you.
Why A-SAFE?
Since 1984, A-SAFE has been a pioneer in industrial safety, inventing the world’s first industrial-strength polymer safety barrier. Today, we continue to lead the industry with cutting-edge solutions like our award-winning IoT system, RackEye™️. With 17 international subsidiaries, we partner with global giants such as Amazon, Coca-Cola, and BMW to enhance workplace safety. Learn more about our Customer Success Stories here.
At A-SAFE we put our values at the heart of the business.
* We Are Pioneers
* We Are in it Together
* We Do the Right Thing
 
Our Commitment to Diversity
We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels they belong. At A-SAFE, we believe our differences fuel innovation and enrich our work environment.
 
Ready to help us set new standards in workplace safety?

* Designing, building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports that translate complex commodity, pricing and forecasting datasets into clear, actionable insights.

* Building and maintaining data models that integrate cleanly with Snowflake and other upstream data sources.

* Strong hands-on experience building Power BI dashboards and reports in a live, evolving business environment.

You'll be engaged as a Ltd company contractor working alongside Adroit's own engineers and the client's internal analytics team — not dropped in alone. **Job Title:** Test Engineer (Software) **Department:** Engineering – Onsite **Reporting to:** Firmware Team Lead **Salary:**£38 – £43,000 **Band:**C
## Scope of the Role
Working within the Engineering team and reporting to the Firmware Team, Lead, this is a software-focused test engineering role responsible for developing the software and instrument drivers that control the company’s automated test equipment (ATE).
The primary function is to ensure the software side of every test system is correct, robust and maintainable – writing and validating equipment drivers, test sequences and data-handling code. New software is developed primarily using AI-assisted methods (Claude) to build code faster and more efficiently, while LabVIEW is used only to maintain and support legacy ATE sites.
The postholder also requires a working level of electrical and electronic knowledge to wire up, bring up and diagnose test fixtures, working alongside our hardware-focused Test Engineers – though hardware is a supporting skill rather than the primary function of this role.
## Main Duties and Responsibilities
The below list is not exhaustive, but the main duties and responsibilities will be:
* Design, write, test and maintain instrument and equipment drivers and low-level interfaces for automated test equipment.
* Develop and validate test sequences, control software and data-handling/logging code, ensuring the software side of each test system is correct and reliable
* Use AI-assisted development (Claude) as the primary approach for all new test software – building code faster, more efficiently and to a consistent standard
* Maintain and support LabVIEW-based software at legacy ATE sites, working within the existing VI library (legacy support only – not used for new development)
* Follow good software engineering practice – version control, code review, documentation and testing – for both AI-generated and hand-written code
* Integrate test software with instruments and interfaces (e.g. serial, USB, I2C/SPI, SCPI/VISA, digital I/O) and troubleshoot communications issues
* Interface test software with SQL databases for test data acquisition, storage and reporting
* Wire up, bring up and diagnose test fixtures to a competent level, supporting commissioning and fault-finding alongside hardware-focused Test Engineers (supporting function)
* Support the verification and validation of test equipment and fixtures against the test plan
* Provide software support and troubleshooting to production and the wider test team
* Contribute software and testing input into the NPI and PFMEA processes for new products
* Prepare clear software documentation and test reports, and keep records in line with quality and company procedures
* Support NPD with test scripts for scope of work validation and conformance testing with hands on testing support when required.
## Knowledge, Skills and Behaviours:
The postholder will possess a range of the following knowledge, skills, and behaviours:
* Degree or HND in Electrical & Electronic
* Engineering or equivalent experience
* Strong practical skills in building and wiring test fixtures – harnessing, crimping, soldering and connectorisation to a high standard
* Strong electrical and electronic fault-finding/troubleshooting skills – on test equipment, fixtures and products, to component level where required
* Able to read and work from schematics, wiring diagrams and mechanical drawings
* Experience selecting and integrating test instruments and interface hardware (e.g. DAQ systems, power supplies, electronic loads, relays and sensors)
* A working knowledge of the software side – able to run, configure and make minor changes to test software and instrument drivers, and to work with software-focused Test Engineers (a supporting skill, secondary to the hardware role)
* Familiarity with instrument interfaces such as serial, USB, I2C/SPI, SCPI/VISA or digital I/O
* Where software changes are needed, willingness to use AI-assisted tools such as Claude for new development; LabVIEW experience beneficial for legacy ATE support only and is being phased out
* Experience using SQL databases for test data acquisition and storage would be an advantage
* Strong understanding of electronics fundamentals and digital communications
* Structured, detail-oriented and safety-conscious approach to fixture build, wiring and documentation
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with good record-keeping
* Highly organised and self-motivated, able to work both autonomously and as part of a team
Characteristics Required:
* Commitment
* Strong work ethic
* Effective Communication
* Teamwork
* Embodies the organisation’s core values
* Problem-solving
* Leadership
* Interpersonal skills
* Negotiation and conflict resolution
* Project Management
* Commercial Awareness
## Additional Notes
Candidates must be authorised to work in the UK and work onsite from our offices based in Peterlee.

These should seamlessly integrate with any other areas of the commercial lifecycle, notably supplier management, third-party risk management and responsible procurement, and integrate considerations from key stakeholders such as Legal. The policies should align with public-sector legislation (including the National Procurement Policy Statement and applicable Procurement Policy Notes) and should be regularly reviewed and updated in line with benchmarking exercises, to ensure they reflect the latest best practice, and the processes should be continually improved to maximise efficiency and effectiveness.

Certified as a *Great Place to Work* around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the *Financial Times* in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by *Forbes* for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.
## ### Our Governance, Risk & Compliance practice are looking for a Director with a strong commercial track record to join the team.

We have hubs in Europe, the US, Asia and Australia and bring deep industry expertise enabled by advanced technology to help clients deliver with greater confidence and certainty.
Our Financial Services GR&C practice helps leading banking and insurance clients navigate an increasingly complex risk and regulatory environment to proactively manage and future-proof risk and compliance functions so they are streamlined, scalable and fit for the future. We support clients across economic crime, conduct & compliance, operational risk & resilience, data, digital & cyber risk, treasury & liquidity risk and climate risk & sustainability. All underpinned by our AI, data and technology capability.
As the market continues to evolve, we are investing in our Governance, Risk & Compliance capability and are seeking a Director with a strong commercial track record to help shape the next phase of growth.
**What you will be doing**

* Identify and originate new opportunities within existing and prospective client accounts, supporting the continued growth of the practice.

## What a career at Baringa will give you
### Putting People First.
### Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:
* Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.

## Our Solutions & AI Lab (SAIL) practice are looking for an experienced AI Architect to join the team.

The AI Architect role owns the technical blueprint for AI-enabled solutions delivered in and around our clients’ environments, combining deep architectural specialism with the commercial and leadership skills to shape and grow our practice. We expect expert-level depth in several of the areas below and working knowledge across the rest. **AI platform & cloud architecture** * Architect AI and Data Platforms using a mix of technologies including Databricks, Snowflake, Claude Enterprise and the native services of Azure, AWS and GCP - selecting the right tool for the workload rather than defaulting to a single vendor.

**Orchestration & control plane** * Architect the orchestration and control-plane layer that governs how AI capabilities are exposed, routed and managed across the enterprise.
* Design MCP, AI and LLM gateway layers for secure, observable and policy-controlled access to models and tools.
* Design agent and skills registries — including recommending suitable technologies and patterns — to enable discovery, reuse and governance of agentic capabilities.

**AI solution design** * Design retrieval and reasoning architectures including RAG, corrective RAG (CRAG), and agentic patterns, selecting the right approach for a given business problem.

**Evaluation, guardrails & responsible AI** * Design evaluation frameworks and guardrails that make AI systems safe, reliable and measurable — covering accuracy, safety, bias, and task success.
* Embed responsible-AI and governance controls aligned to emerging regulation and client risk appetites.
* Define human-in-the-loop and fallback strategies for high-stakes use cases.
**Observability & operations** * Architect logging, monitoring, tracing and cost-observability across the AI stack, including model, agent and platform telemetry.
* Design for drift detection, performance monitoring and continuous evaluation in production (LLMOps / MLOps).

Fusion energy offers the potential for significant quantities of low-carbon, inherently safe, abundantly fuelled baseload energy, supporting sustainable climate action and energy independence. Anticipated to come online for commercial purposes in the middle of this century, fusion offers a viable means to sustainable net zero in the UK and globally, as well as to increased energy security. ## **London (Hybrid) | Full-time | £100k – £130k + early-team equity**
## **The role**
We're a well-funded startup building AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic, trillion-dollar industry at a critical juncture. In the UK, the Building Safety Act is one of the most significant overhauls of how buildings are designed of this generation. Directors of AEC firms now carry personal liability for design decisions. We're building the system of record that lets them prove those decisions were sound.
You'll run engineering at Bite, reporting to and working alongside El-Amin, our CTO and a former practising structural engineer. You and El-Amin will shape technical direction together: he brings deep domain expertise on how engineers reason about a column, a load path or a revision, but the platform's architecture, and how it gets built and shipped, are yours to own. The foundations are in production and the platform is polyglot by design: a Node/TypeScript backend API, a React frontend, a C#/WPF Windows desktop connector and Python ML/RAG workers on Azure. You don't need experience in construction or in our exact stack. We hire for engineering judgement, and the team are polyglots who treat specific technologies as tools for tackling problems.
## **Why join Bite**
**The problem is genuinely hard.** When a structural engineer changes Column C7 in their analysis model, the same column exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don't understand, and with no shared identifier. Resolving those references into one canonical entity, and predicting what just went out of date, is the core of our product, and the architecture that gets us there is yours to set.
**You'll own engineering outright, not a slice of it.** There's no engineering organisation to inherit and no layer of management to negotiate with. What exists today is a working platform and a small team; the standards, the architecture, the hiring bar and the shape of the function as it grows are all genuinely open, and they're your decisions to make.
**Your work ships to people who pay.** Our product is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms. Work goes from a customer conversation into the hands of working engineers within days, and you'll hear directly what landed and what didn't. If you'd rather take a call with a structural engineer at 9am and ship them a fix by 5pm than sit in a product spec review, this is that job.
## **What we're building**
Bite is the platform that turns weeks of manual change-propagation work into seconds. Structural engineers work across a fragmented set of tools with no shared source of truth: ETABS models, SAFE analyses, Autodesk drawings, Excel specs, PDFs, emails. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive.
Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection, and propagation of those changes to every affected file under the engineer's supervision, all running on a single engineering knowledge graph..
## **About You**
* Love learning a new domain, and shipping something within weeks that actually fixes what was broken in it.
* Own the technical direction of the platform: the knowledge graph, the entity-resolution layer, and the architecture everything else depends on.
* Hire and grow the engineering team, and set the bar that every subsequent hire is measured against.
* Establish how engineering operates as it scales: standards, code review, release, on-call, and how work gets prioritised.
* Stay hands-on where it counts, writing and reviewing code, because that's how you earn credibility with the engineers you hire.
* Work with El-Amin on how engineers reason about a column, a load path or a revision, and encode that into the data model.
* Work closely with our Head of Product to build and execute a strong product roadmap, translating design-partner feedback into shipped features, and own engineering delivery against it.
* Ship fast without breaking trust, moving quickly on new capability while protecting the reliability of a product design partners already depend on day to day.
* Bring a track record of shipping and owning production systems end to end; years matter less to us than evidence you've done it.
* Bring experience hiring, growing and leading a small engineering team, with evidence of the engineers you've developed.
* Have strong backend depth, ideally Node.js or TypeScript in production, and are comfortable reading C# and Python.
* Have experience owning architecture for distributed, event-driven systems: APIs, queues, workers, storage.
* Are outcome-focused and hands-on, with a deep understanding of what's being built and comfort in the code, even when you're not hand-writing every line yourself.
* Have genuine product sense: there's no layer of product management between engineering and customers, and you'll be on the calls directly.
* Communicate clearly across deeply technical, semi-technical and plain-language conversations: clarity is what lets a small team move fast without customers losing trust in what's shipped.
* Are kind, curious, optimistic and driven. We believe in being kind over being nice, and we give and receive constructive feedback constantly.
## **What Will Make You Stand Out**
* Building an engineering function from a handful of people into a team, and the scar tissue that comes with it.
* LLM/RAG pipelines in production: embeddings, vector search, retrieval quality measurement.
* Graph-based data models, entity resolution, or knowledge graph tooling.
* Autodesk Platform Services or AEC data formats: IFC, Revit, ETABS, SAFE or similar.
* Background in construction, structural engineering software, or document-intensive vertical SaaS.
Don't rule yourself out over the stack. We're looking for strong engineers with sound principles. Technologies are tools.
## **What you can expect from us**
* £100k–£130k and early-team equity, with exact numbers on the table at the first conversation.
* An engineering function to build, and the authority that comes with owning it.
* Technical direction that's genuinely open. The foundations exist; the decisions ahead are yours.
* Headcount to hire against, and the final say on who joins your team.
* Direct access to customers. You'll be on calls with structural engineers, not reading a summary of them.
* Founders who want to be argued with, and who value action over consensus.
* Hybrid working from our London office (3 days a week).
* A vertical you'll learn deeply: how structural engineering firms work, how AEC data formats behave, and how LLM/RAG systems hold up in production.
## **How we work**
We believe in thorough automated testing. Not strict TDD, but every PR ships with the appropriate E2E tests, unit tests or eval harnesses. We own the entire platform including its deployment and reliability, so we control our own CI and CD. The team is autonomous, multi-disciplinary and empowered. Where you'd change any of that is your call to make.

## Become a BR-DGE Builder
**We are at an inflection point, scaling our platform, deepening our partnerships, and expanding into new markets. If you want to shape the future of payment orchestration, this is your moment.**
**About the opportunity**
As our Senior Product Manager, you will take strategic ownership of core areas of the BR-DGE platform. You will set the vision, define the roadmap, and lead discovery, working across commercial, technical, and operational functions to ensure we build the right things for the right reasons.
This is a role with genuine scope. You will operate as a strategist and decision-maker, partnering closely with the VP of Product to shape the overall product direction, while collaborating with Product Owners who translate that strategy into well-structured delivery. It is an opportunity to build product capabilities at scale, with the visibility and influence that comes from being part of a high-growth FinTech.
**What you’ll be doing**
* **Own a product domain end-to-end**: You will be accountable for its strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes, making crisp prioritisation decisions that balance merchant value with business impact.
* **Define and champion the roadmap**: You will work with the VP of Product to sequence what gets built, grounding every decision in market insight, customer evidence, and commercial opportunity.
* **Lead discovery**: You will identify the relevant personas (e.g. payments teams, finance teams) of our customer and prospect base (merchants and PSPs), engaging with representative users to tease out the payment problems to solve to support their core business.
* **Use vibe coding**: You will produce prototypes to articulate requirements and for show and tell with key internal and external stakeholders.
* **Market intelligence**: You will get to know the core business of our targeted Ideal Customer Profile and learn what payment 'means' for them and their different personas. Working together with the BR-DGE Marketing team, you will capture key market trends and competitive intelligence to deliver valuable outcomes for our customers.
* **Set and own success metrics**: You will define what "good" looks like for your product domain and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not just delivery milestones.
* **Bridge strategy and execution**: You will partner with Product Owners to ensure requirements become well-structured, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can move on with confidence.
* **Govern the backlog with rigour**: You will review and triage enhancement requests, ensuring everything entering the pipeline has a coherent rationale and is properly sequenced relative to strategic priorities.
* **Enable seamless merchant go-lives**: You will equip the onboarding team with the product context and knowledge they need to deliver frictionless launch experiences.
* **Influence the product culture**: You will contribute to the maturity of the wider product function as BR-DGE scales its team and practices.

* **Substantial experience navigating complex merchant domains** and requirements, gained in-house or through strategic partnerships.
* Advanced understanding of merchant workflows to seamlessly bridge the gap between commercial objectives and technical builds.
* Familiarity with payment orchestration, gateway infrastructure and/or e-commerce technology platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to define product vision, lead roadmap prioritisation, and communicate the 'why' clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Working collaboratively with Design, Production and Procurement teams to ensure specifications are practical and achievable.

* Maintaining awareness of current interior design trends, luxury products and customer preferences.
* Representing Sunseeker at selected international boat shows and customer events

* A degree or diploma in Interior Design or a related discipline (desirable).

* An excellent eye for colour, texture, materials and design detail.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Who We Are
 
Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

This role sits close to Product Managers, Technology Solutions and operational colleagues, helping us reduce ambiguity early, test assumptions quickly and make sure product concepts are well defined before scaled implementation begins.
 
The Role
 
The Product Designer will work with Product Managers and operational colleagues to explore new opportunities, understand customer and business needs, and turn early ideas into clearly defined product concepts.
 
You will use journey mapping, service mapping, wireframes, interaction models and prototypes to make ideas tangible, testable and easier to understand.
 
A key part of the role is working closely with Technology Solutions and engineers to assess feasibility, explore solution options and identify constraints, dependencies, risks and likely delivery effort.
 
You will help translate product vision into a shared understanding of how a solution could work, what needs to be built and where further investigation or development is required.
 
You will support the transition from discovery into scaled delivery by clearly articulating the problem, proposed experience, requirements and technical considerations.
 
Acting as a translator between Product and Technology Solutions, you will help improve product readiness, reduce rework and give delivery teams a stronger foundation from which to build scalable products.

⚽ The ability to translate between business, product, design and technology audiences, making complex ideas clear and creating shared understanding.
⚽ Experience working with Product Managers, engineers, architects or technology teams to explore feasibility, shape requirements and define potential solutions.
⚽ Strong technical understanding to identify dependencies, constraints, risks and implications of design decisions, without needing to be an engineer.
⚽ A structured, clear and pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, use insight and data to refine concepts, and identify what must be understood before a project is ready for build.

### Clinical Data Scientist
Clinical Partners- one of the UK’s fastest growing Mental Health providers- is building a modern
data capability to become a genuinely data-driven organisation.
We now have a data warehouse, a semantic layer, automated reporting and a growing analyst
community. What we do not yet have is a dedicated scientific function to interrogate our clinical data in
the deep, investigative ways that generate new understanding rather than restate what we already
report.
This is a research-oriented Data Scientist role. The purpose is to ask, and rigorously answer, the
harder questions in our data: how patients move through pathways, what drives clinical outcomes,
which presentations cluster together, where risk concentrates, and what we could measure but
currently don’t. You will bring advanced statistical and machine-learning methods to bear on clinical,
outcomes and operational data, and surface insight that changes how we understand our patients and
services.
You will work closely with the central data team, Clinical Informatics, and clinical leadership to turn
ambiguous clinical questions into well-formed analytical studies. This is a hands-on, hypothesis-driven
role for someone who is as comfortable with study design, causal reasoning and psychometrics as
they are with code. It is a foundational hire: you will help define what scientific rigour looks like at
Clinical Partners and build a reusable body of methods, models and evidence over time.
Our data landscape is complex, longitudinal and imperfect. Much of the value is latent - held in free-
text assessment notes, repeated outcome measures, and messy pathway histories. A core part of this
role is designing the analysis you wish you could run today, working within real-world data quality and
clinical governance constraints.
### Key Responsibilities
Deep interrogation of clinical data
Investigate clinical outcomes and operational data to answer high-value questions we cannot
currently answer - forming hypotheses, designing studies, and delivering defensible, reproducible
findings.

data capture, instruments or derived measures.
Advanced modelling and clinical insight
Apply advanced data science techniques with a clinical focus, including (but not limited to):
Survival / time-to-event analysis - e.g. time-to-treatment, waiting-list and pathway survival, with
competing risks.
Causal inference - propensity score matching, difference-in-differences, instrumental variables,
and uplift/ heterogeneous treatment-effect modelling to estimate what actually drives outcomes.
Bayesian and hierarchical / multilevel modelling - partial pooling across services, clinicians and
cohorts to produce stable estimates from sparse data.
Longitudinal and trajectory modelling - mixed-effects models, growth mixture / latent class
trajectory models of symptom change over time.
Psychometrics and latent-variable modelling - factor analysis, item response theory (IRT), reliable
change and minimal clinically important difference (MCID) on measures such as HADS, RCADS,
PHQ-9 and GAD-7.
Unsupervised learning and phenotyping - clustering and latent class analysis to identify patient
subtypes and presentation patterns.
Clinical NLP - topic modelling, embeddings, named-entity recognition and negation detection over assessment letters and free-text notes to unlock latent information.
Predictive risk modelling - deterioration, relapse, disengagement and DNA/no-show models, with proper calibration and validation.
Principled handling of missing and biased data - multiple imputation, sensitivity analysis, and reasoning about MNAR mechanisms.

Communicate complex findings clearly to clinical and executive audiences, distinguishing signal from noise and correlation from cause.
Capability building

Siena AI builds empathic AI agents for commerce that integrate with existing help desk and commerce systems to autonomously handle customer interactions across multiple channels. ## Founding Creative Director job description
## **Meet Siena**
Siena is the The Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns. It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.
We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.
If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.
## **The role**
Siena is building the intelligence layer for CX, and we're about to launch several products in quick succession. We are not looking for someone to execute a brief well. We are looking for the person whose taste the rest of the company gets measured against: someone who looks at a landing page and can't not have an opinion, who would rather kill a launch than ship something mediocre, and who has owned creative direction before, not just contributed to it.
If you need a creative director above you setting the vision, a team to delegate to on day one, or a slow, considered, one-project-at-a-time pace, stop reading now. This isn't that job.
If you're the person other designers already defer to on taste, continue.
## **This is a craft title. Not a headcount title.**
You will ship personally for the first year and set the bar for everyone who comes after. Over time you will build a small internal agency, two to three people across design, motion, and content, that can brief, position, and launch without outside help.
* Narrative and positioning across every launch - design as strategy, not decoration
* Every artifact that goes to market: landing pages, launch video, decks, social
* The design system, from v3 onward
* The bar, full stop - if it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it

* **A pattern of shipping in chaos, not around it.** Multiple launches in flight, feedback that moves in hours not weeks. If your best work happens on a slow, protected timeline, that's useful information - it's just not this role.
## **Why this is worth it**
You're not joining a design team to fit into. You're setting the taste bar for a company that's about to be a lot more visible, a lot faster than most companies get that chance.
This is intense - real ownership, real launches, a founder team that reviews your work directly and moves at the pace you'd expect from that. It's also one of the rare creative seats where nothing you make gets diluted by committee before it ships.
If that sounds like the room you've been trying to get into, we want to talk to you.
If it sounds like too much scrutiny too fast, this isn't a knock on you - it just isn't this role.

* **Work that ships and matters.** What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.
* **A category we are creating.** The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

* **Great salary plus equity or stock grants.** Own a piece of what you build.
* **Learning budget.** If you are growing, so are we.
* **AI-fluency by default.** Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite.
They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.
Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.
At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application.

* Stay curious about emerging digital and AI trends, bringing relevant developments into learning conversations where they add value.
* Contribute ideas and insight to continuously improve delivery approaches and learner outcomes.

* Expert working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot and/or other AI tools to support productivity and workflow improvement.

* Maintain high standards of quality, professionalism, and learner care.

# Junior Network & IT Support Technician (Telford or Prestwick)
We are looking for a Junior Network & IT Support Technician to join our IT team.
This role would suit someone at the beginning of their IT career, who has an interest in networking, infrastructure and cybersecurity. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. We are looking for someone who understands the basics, enjoys investigating problems, asks sensible questions and is willing to learn. You will help support and maintain the organisation's network and IT infrastructure while developing your technical knowledge alongside experienced members of the IT team. A strong security mindset is important. We want someone who thinks about how and why something works, rather than simply making a problem disappear. **This role can be based from on a hybrid basis either our Prestwick or Telford office, and we are open to candidates who are able to work from either location.**
## Key Responsibilities
* Assist with the day-to-day support and maintenance of network infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues across wired and wireless networks.
* Help investigate network faults, performance issues and unusual behaviour.
* Support switches, wireless access points, firewalls and other network equipment under guidance.
* Assist with VLANs, IP addressing, DHCP, DNS and other core networking services.
* Help identify devices connected to the network and investigate unknown or unexpected devices.
* Support network cabling, patching, ports and physical network equipment.
* Assist with monitoring network availability, performance and security.
* Help investigate security alerts and suspicious network activity.
* Follow IT and cybersecurity procedures when making changes or troubleshooting systems.
* Escalate issues when appropriate rather than making risky changes without understanding the impact.
* Maintain clear documentation of network devices, configurations, troubleshooting and fixes.
* Help keep network diagrams and infrastructure documentation accurate and up to date.
* Support general IT requests where required and work with other members of the IT team.
* Assist with the deployment and configuration of new network equipment.
* Take part in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity improvement projects.
* Research unfamiliar problems and technologies and work through them methodically.
* Help identify opportunities to improve, standardise or automate IT and network processes.
## Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
You do not need extensive commercial experience for this role. More important to us is your attitude and how you approach problems.
You should:
* Have a basic understanding of computer networking.
* Understand concepts such as IP addresses, subnets, gateways, DNS and DHCP.
* Have an interest in networking, infrastructure or cybersecurity.
* Enjoy troubleshooting and investigating technical problems.
* Be willing to research something when you do not immediately know the answer.
* Be comfortable asking for help when required.
* Care about doing things securely rather than taking shortcuts.
* Be able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical people.
* Be helpful and patient when supporting users.
* Be able to document what you have done and explain how an issue was resolved.
* Have good attention to detail.
* Be willing to learn new technologies and develop your technical knowledge.
**Desirable Knowledge**
The following would be useful but are not essential:
* Basic understanding of TCP/IP.
* VLANs and network segmentation.
* Wi-Fi troubleshooting.
* Network switches and access points.
* Firewalls.
* VPNs.
* Microsoft 365 or Entra ID.
* Windows administration.
* Linux.
* PowerShell or another scripting language.
* Network monitoring tools.
* Cybersecurity fundamentals.
* CompTIA Network+, Security+, Cisco CCST or CCNA study.
Home labs, personal projects, Raspberry Pi projects, Hack The Box, TryHackMe, networking labs or other self-directed learning are also valuable. Commercial experience is not required.
**The Kind of Person We Want**
Someone who sees a problem and wants to understand why it happened, not just how to make the error message disappear.
You might not know the answer immediately, but you should be comfortable investigating, testing, researching and asking questions until you understand the problem.
Security should be part of your thinking from the start. If something seems unusual, insecure or simply does not make sense, we want you to question it.
You should also remember that IT exists to support people. Technical knowledge matters, but being approachable, helpful and able to explain things clearly is equally important.
**Development**
This role is intended to develop over time.
You will be given opportunities to build experience across:
* Networking
* Cybersecurity
* Infrastructure
* Cloud services
* Network monitoring
* Automation and scripting
* IT troubleshooting
* Security investigations
The longer-term aim would be for the successful candidate to develop towards a Network Technician, Network Engineer or Network Security role as their knowledge and experience grows.

AGENTIC SOFTWARE ENGINEER
London · Full-time · On-site
TL;DR
AI is collapsing the time and effort required to turn ideas into working
software. We're redesigning how we build around that — using agents across the
software lifecycle and enabling more of our team to ship changes directly.
We're hiring an experienced software engineer who is already pushing beyond
task-by-task use of agents. You'll engineer the systems around agents that let
them take on increasingly substantial work — running for longer, working in
parallel and involving you when your judgement is actually required.
This isn't a model-training role. We're focused on what happens around the
models — engineering the systems that turn increasingly capable agents into a
fundamentally different way of building software.
WHY HULT?
Hult is a global business school that teaches a Computer Science for Business
degree. The engineering team doesn't sit adjacent to that mission — it's part of
it. How we build software, adopt new tools and think about automation feeds back
into what we teach.
We give engineers real ownership. You'll pick up open-ended problems, shape the
approach and have the backing of a team that trusts you to land them.
We ship fast and iterate constantly. We want the distance between an idea and
something running in production to be as short as possible.
AI has already changed who can ship software here. You'll help us push that
further — giving more of the team the tools, context and guardrails to turn
ideas into production changes without engineering becoming the bottleneck.
We're serious about discovering what AI-native engineering looks like in
practice. We don't have all the answers, and part of this role is finding them.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Own outcomes, not tickets. Work directly with product owners and stakeholders to
understand problems and find the shortest responsible path from idea to
production. You'll use engineering judgement — and agents — to close the gap
between request and delivery.
Delegate outcomes, not steps. Your goal is to be able to say: "Here's the
outcome, constraints and evidence I expect. Go progress this work and involve me
when my judgement is actually required." You'll design workflows where agents
can plan, execute and verify work rather than waiting for you to tell them what
to do next.
Engineer the agent harness. Build the instructions, skills, tools, permissions,
environments, validation and feedback loops that allow agents to reliably
complete substantial engineering work. You'll understand these as engineering
primitives rather than a fixed recipe, and continually experiment with how they
fit together. When an agent fails or requires intervention, you'll ask what
could change in the harness to prevent it next time.
Engineer context and memory. Design how agents discover and retain what they
need to know about our systems — architecture, conventions, decisions, product
intent, operational state and previous work. Give agents the right context at
the right time without simply giving them more context.
Push toward an autonomous software factory. Help work move from intent through
planning, implementation, verification, deployment and observation with
progressively less synchronous human intervention. Enable multiple agent
workstreams to run in parallel and converge on tested, shippable outcomes.
Make autonomous work trustworthy. Generating software is increasingly cheap;
knowing whether it's good is harder. Build tests, evaluations, observability and
feedback systems that establish whether work is complete without requiring a
human to inspect everything the agent produced.
Raise the capability of the whole team. AI has already enabled more of our team
to ship changes. Turn successful approaches into reusable capabilities that
allow people to safely take increasingly ambitious ideas into production.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
* Strong software engineering foundations. You have substantial production
software engineering experience and the judgement to understand architecture,
production systems and risk.
* You've materially changed how you work because of AI. You regularly delegate
substantial engineering work and spend more of your time defining outcomes,
providing context and designing verification than directing implementation
step-by-step.
* You systematically increase the scope of delegation. When an agent needs you
to tell it what to do next, you ask whether better context, tools,
verification or structure could have allowed it to progress independently.
* You think in systems, not prompts. You think about the environment an agent
operates in, how it gets what it needs, how it progresses work and how you
know when it has succeeded.
* You care deeply about verification. You don't trust generated output because
it looks plausible. You build ways to establish correctness without relying
on reading everything yourself.
* You can operate from an outcome. You're comfortable working directly with
technical and non-technical stakeholders, understanding what matters and
finding a pragmatic path to production.
Experience with particular languages or technologies matters much less to us
than the ability to understand unfamiliar systems quickly.
Experience building AI systems can also be highly relevant where the underlying
problems transfer to agentic software engineering.
SHOW US
We want to see evidence of how you actually work.
Your application will ask you three short questions about your experience with
agents: something you've built recently, how you've increased what you can
delegate, and something you've tried that didn't work.
We expect you may use AI to help with your application — we use it constantly
too. That's fine. What we're looking for is your experience and your thinking.
Specifics matter much more than polished writing, and we'll use your answers as
the starting point for the interview.
And don't feel constrained by our questions. If there's something that better
demonstrates how you work — a project, repo, harness, experiment, write-up,
demo, or anything else you think we'd find interesting — show us. We'd much
rather see something real than read another paragraph about how passionate you
are about AI.
ABOUT THE ROLE
This is a full-time, on-site role based at our Chelsea office in London,
reporting to the Engineering Manager.
We're trying to discover what software engineering looks like when
implementation is no longer the primary constraint.
If you're already experimenting at that boundary, we'd like to talk.

As our On-Board Sales & Education Manager, you’ll maximise retail and treatment revenue across the OneSpaWorld fleet by inspiring, coaching and developing on-board teams. Working side by side with facialists and spa leaders, you’ll bring the ELEMIS brand to life, strengthen commercial capability and ensure every guest receives an exceptional consultation, treatment and product experience.
This is an exciting, highly visible opportunity for an experienced OneSpaWorld professional who combines outstanding ELEMIS expertise with a proven ability to motivate teams and deliver measurable commercial growth.

* Build strong relationships across ELEMIS, OneSpaWorld and cruise-line partner teams to drive shared commercial goals.

* Several years demonstratable experience working with ELEMIS.

Are you looking for a values-led company that cares about the growth of its people as much as the strength of its platform?**
Elliptic is where ambitious people do the most important work of their careers. We are making crypto safe, secure and scalable, preventing global financial crime, exposing bad actors and protecting the world's financial system as it is being revolutionized. This is work your friends will actually want to hear about. You can expect to work in highly empowered teams, with remarkable breadth and the freedom to turn bold ideas into real impact, supported every step of the way by some of the most brilliant people you have ever called colleagues.
**The impact you will have:**
This role provides the people leadership for two connected functions at the heart of how Elliptic engineers. On the DevOps side, you keep a latency-sensitive screening platform dependable, cost-effective and scalable as transaction volume and customer expectations grow. On the AI Platform side, you lead the team that acts as Elliptic's centre of excellence for building AI agents, owning the shared frameworks, patterns, MCP management and evaluation capability that every product team draws on. You are a two-way conduit for that centre of excellence: carrying its best practice out to teams, and helping define what those best approaches should be. Reliability remains foundational to everything Elliptic does, and you will champion strong SRE practices across the business, though the SRE function itself sits outside your direct people-management scope. This is a hands-off, strategy and people-leadership role: you lead and grow the people, set the operating model, and make the calls that shape DevOps and AI Platform at Elliptic.
**What you will do:**
* Lead, grow and develop the people across two functions, DevOps and AI Platform, owning hiring, levelling, coaching and career development for a combined team of roughly twelve engineers.
* Set the strategy and operating model for DevOps: release safety, developer experience, observability, cost and the scalability of a latency-sensitive screening platform.
* Lead the AI Platform function as a centre of excellence, owning the people and operating model behind Elliptic's shared agent-building frameworks and patterns, MCP management, evaluation framework and shared AI infrastructure.
* Act as a two-way conduit for the centre of excellence: disseminate best practice and reusable approaches out to product teams building their own agents, and channel their feedback back to define and improve those approaches.
* Partner with the AI Platform technical lead and senior engineers to shape technical direction, bringing people leadership and delivery rather than owning the technical vision single-handedly.
* Own the cost, scalability and efficiency of the infrastructure as volume grows, bringing a FinOps mindset to infrastructure spend.
* Champion SRE and reliability practices across the business, partnering closely with the SRE function.
* Support the infrastructure and process maturity needed for certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC2, working with InfoSec.
**What you will achieve in the first 6 months:**
* Built trust across both functions and their counterparts, and developed a clear, evidence-based picture of the platform's reliability and cost posture and of how the AI Platform centre of excellence currently works and shares knowledge.
* Shaped and begun executing a people and hiring strategy across both functions, growing DevOps toward its target and building out the AI Platform and AI infrastructure team.
* Begun operating as an effective conduit for the centre of excellence, strengthening how agent-building best practice, MCP and evaluation approaches are defined centrally and adopted by product teams.
* Established a clear point of view on AI SDLC and how the platform enables it, and championed SRE practices across the business.
**You will be a great fit here if you:**
* Lead through people: you measure your success by the growth and impact of your team, not your own output.
* Are credible with senior engineers without needing to be the hands-on expert: you ask the sharp question and facilitate the right decision.
* Are genuinely curious about AI, agents and evaluations, and energised by helping an organisation learn to build with them well.
* Are honest and pragmatic about timelines and trade-offs, and comfortable owning a long-term build-out across two functions.
* Care about the mission: providing the infrastructure and intelligence that keep financial institutions safe from crypto crime and sanctions evasion.
**Our ideal candidate has:**
* A track record of managing DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineers, including hiring and building a growing team.
* An infrastructure background (cloud, IaC, CI/CD, observability) deep enough to make sound strategic calls and guide senior engineers toward the right ones.
* Extreme curiosity about AI and budding hands-on experience with AI, agents and evaluations: not necessarily deep expertise, but a real, demonstrated pull toward the space and the judgement to grow into leading it.
* A strong interest in the nuances of the AI-assisted SDLC, and the conviction that tooling alone does not make engineers more potent. Adoption, practice and guardrails are what turn AI access into real leverage.
* Kubernetes literacy, grounded in hands-on experience as an engineer, sufficient to reason about the estate and challenge the team's decisions.
* AI fluency: candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, responsible use of AI in an engineering context and the ability to set team norms for it. We are looking for an active AI promoter who can reason about where AI adds leverage and where it is a liability in a compliance setting.
**Bonus Points for:**
* Experience leading or building an internal platform, ML platform, developer-experience or enablement function.
* Hands-on exposure to agent frameworks, MCP, or building and running evaluation frameworks.
* Experience of a company scaling phase.
* Exposure to ISO 27001 / SOC2 and what they demand of infrastructure and process.
* Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems in a regulated or financial context.
* HODLs Crypto.

# Vector Design Lead - Plant Biology Institute

## Description
**Join us at EIT:**
At the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT), we're on a mission to translate scientific discovery into real world impact. We bring together visionary scientists, technologists, engineers, researchers, educators and innovators to tackle humanity's greatest challenges in four transformative areas:
* Health, Medical Science & Generative Biology
* Food Security & Sustainable Agriculture
* Climate Change & Managing CO[2]
* Artificial Intelligence & Robotics
This is ambitious work - work that demands curiosity, courage, and a relentless drive to make a difference. At EIT, you'll join a community built on excellence, innovation, tenacity, trust, and collaboration, where bold ideas become real-world breakthroughs. Together, we push boundaries, embrace complexity, and create solutions to scale ideas from lab to society. Explore more at .
**Welcome to the Plant Biology Institute:**
The Plant Biology Institute, headed by Professor Steve Kelly, is a key part of the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT) Oxford. The institute aims to develop impactful and commercially sustainable solutions for improving global food production and planetary health through pioneering plant science research.
The Plant Biology Institute will unite world-class researchers who are focused on expanding the frontiers of plant science. Our research is focused on enhancing our ability to feed the planet while simultaneously improving the climate and ecosystem outcomes of food production. By embedding cutting-edge plant science research within an organisation that is focused on solving global challenges at scale, we aim to accelerate the timeline from discovery to global impact.
Areas of exploration include:
* Improved plant productivity, both indoors and outside.
* Reduced reliance on inputs including water, fertilisers, pesticides, and herbicides.
* Novel decarbonised plant-based production platforms for food and medicines.
* Advanced technologies that speed up discovery and deployment in plants.
Researchers will have access to state-of-the-art laboratory and plant growth facilities and have opportunities to collaborate with experts at the forefront of research on AI, automation, and generative biology across the EIT ecosystem. They will also work with global leaders in market development, commercialisation, and impact creation. The Plant Biology Institute has long-term substantial funding to support the unique scale and ambition of its vision.
**Your Role:**
EIT is seeking an experienced **Vector Design Manager** to join the Crop Transformation Pipeline team within the Plant Biology Institute. This role will lead the design, build strategy, quality control and release of transformation vectors and genome editing reagents for gene edited and transgenic crop programme.
The successful candidate will be a technical authority in commercial vector design, plant molecular biology and crop genome editing technologies. They will translate trait and editing objectives into transformation-ready vector designs, ensuring that constructs are fit-for-purpose for high-throughput transformation, event recovery, molecular characterisation and downstream product development.
This role is critical to building an industrial-grade vector design capability for crops including corn, wheat and other strategic species. The candidate will establish design standards, construct QC criteria, vendor workflows, sequence/data management processes and clear handover packages for transformation and event delivery teams.
The candidate will own the upstream design-to-vector-release process, ensuring that all constructs entering transformation are technically sound, traceable, QC-approved and aligned with commercial and regulatory expectations.
**Your Responsibilities:**
* Lead vector design strategy for gene edited and transgenic crop projects, including expression cassette architecture, promoter and terminator selection, selectable/reporter marker choice, cargo design, guide RNA modules, donor templates and multiplex editing configurations.
* Translate trait biology, editing objectives and transformation requirements into vectors suitable for Agrobacterium-mediated, biolistic and emerging plant delivery systems.
* Provide expert guidance on CRISPR/Cas systems, Cas12, base editing, prime editing, multiplex editing, homology-directed repair, transgene-free approaches and marker-free design options where appropriate.
* Develop commercial-grade design rules that consider transformation performance, event quality, freedom-to-operate, stewardship, regulatory needs, trait stacking, construct stability and downstream assay ability.
* Own construct intake, design review, annotation, nomenclature, barcode strategy, version control, sequence verification, risk assessment and release criteria before vectors enter transformation workflows.
* Manage internal and external vector build activities, including DNA synthesis, cloning, plasmid QC, sequence confirmation, Agrobacterium strain selection, Agrobacterium introduction, glycerol stock tracking and vector delivery to transformation teams.
* Work closely with event delivery and genotyping colleagues to ensure vectors are designed with the right molecular assay strategy, including junction assays, copy number assays, guide/edit assays and marker/backbone detection.
* Build and maintain a structured vector inventory and construct database using ELN, LIMS and sequence management tools, ensuring full traceability from request through vector release.
* Create SOPs, design templates, QC checklists, construct handover forms and decision records to support reproducible, auditable and scalable vector delivery.
* Track vector design and build milestones, budgets, vendor dependencies, quality risks and delivery timelines, escalating blockers early and proposing contingency plans.
* Partner with legal, IP, regulatory, procurement and external collaborators to ensure vector designs and material transfers are aligned with programme and commercial requirements.
* Train and mentor scientists, research associates and project teams in vector design principles, sequence review, construct documentation and transformation-readiness criteria.
* The successful candidate will combine deep molecular design expertise with strong operational discipline. They will help reduce failed transformation cycles by ensuring that constructs are technically robust, well documented and suitable for downstream event confirmation before experiments begin.
The candidate will be expected to identify opportunities for IP creation, support commercial vector design decisions and contribute to EIT's mission of translating plant science into high-impact, scalable crop improvement technologies.
## Requirements
**Essential Skills, Qualifications & Experience:**
* PhD in Plant Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Genomics, Crop Science or a related discipline, or MSc with significant relevant industry experience. At least 5-7 years of experience in plant biotechnology, molecular design, genome editing or vector development.
* Demonstrated expertise in plant vector design for crop transformation, including binary vectors, expression cassette design, regulatory elements, selectable/reporter systems, multi-gene constructs and transformation-compatible plasmid architecture.
* Strong understanding of genome editing technologies, including CRISPR/Cas systems, guide RNA design, multiplex editing, base editing, prime editing, donor template design and edited event confirmation requirements.
* Experience with construct design and sequence analysis tools such as Benchling, SnapGene, Geneious, Vector NTI or equivalent platforms, with strong capability in sequence annotation, alignment and design review.
* Practical understanding of crop transformation workflows
