# IT Support Analyst
**IT Support Analyst** **Permanent, Full time: 35 hours per week** **Salary: £27,500 to £30,000 + benefits** **Home based in England, Scotland or Wales with occasional national travel for quarterly meetings and ad hoc events**
You’ll be recognised as the friendly, confident and supportive face of IT within Enginuity Group. Working at the heart of our day-to-day IT support operations, providing hands-on support to our end users and ensuring they have everything they need to succeed, you’ll help keep things running smoothly.
Alongside this, you’ll contribute to key projects and take ownership of keeping our core platforms up to date and performing at their best.
**What you’ll be doing**
You’ll provide day-to-day support to our end users across common platforms, ensuring issues are resolved quickly and effectively. You’ll create clear, practical self-help tools that empower colleagues to troubleshoot with confidence, while also managing and maintaining our IT asset and contract register to keep records accurate and up to date.
Alongside this, you’ll lead the onboarding and offboarding process for colleagues, delivering a smooth and secure experience. You’ll assist the wider team with project tasks, contributing to key initiatives, and carry out regular maintenance of our core platforms to ensure our systems remain secure and stable.
**What we’re looking for**
We’re looking for an IT Support Analyst with excellent written and verbal communication skills, who can build and maintain positive, effective relationships at all levels of the business. You’ll be confident organising your workload, and have experience managing tickets efficiently through an ITSM helpdesk platform such as FreshService, ZenDesk, or ServiceNow. A proactive problem-solver, you’ll be comfortable tackling challenges as they arise, sharing new knowledge with the wider team - all while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
Technically, you’ll be skilled in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams) and have a strong working knowledge of Windows 11 and Windows Server operating systems, including patching and security. You’ll have experience managing users and groups in Entra ID, deploying applications and settings via Intune across laptops and mobile devices, and using RMM tools to provide remote support. Experience creating and supporting sites, setting permissions, and working with iOS devices - including deployments via Apple Business Manager - is also key.
**Other skills which would be desirable however not needed to apply for the role**
Ideally you will have experience working with Azure, including VMs and basic networking concepts, along with an understanding of key Cyber Security Principals and tools to support our Cyber Lead with regular updates and maintenance. EAL develops and maintains a wide range of high-quality qualifications and assessments to meet evolving industry demands and accelerate the transition to net zero. Alongside this, Enginuity focuses on tackling the UK’s engineering and manufacturing skills gap - using data-driven insight to boost productivity. Together, we’re shaping a future where engineering and manufacturing talent can thrive, and UK industry stays at the forefront of innovation.

**Remote/home-based working -** our standard working hours are 35 per week, 9am until 5pm with a 1-hour lunch. Many of our team work flexibly, and we would be happy to discuss how flexible working could work for you and the business. **Annual Leave** – You will start with 25 days annual leave, increasing to 27 days after two years’ service. You’ll also enjoy three additional paid days off between Christmas and New Year during our company shutdown. You’ll also benefit from financial wellbeing resources, webinars to help you stay on top of your finances, life assurance cover of x2 your salary, and pension contributions of 4.5%. **Family Friendly** – We offer enhanced maternity, paternity, shared parental, adoption and dependant policies. **Volunteer** – Take paidtime off to volunteer, whether supporting your local community or contributing to causes that matter to you.
**Diversity, Equality, Inclusion & Belonging**
We promote a supportive, inclusive workplace where everyone is valued and encouraged to be themselves. We actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. We’re a member of the Association for Black & Minority Ethnic Engineers, hold Clear Assured Gold accreditation for our inclusive culture, and are a Menopause Friendly Committed Employer. As a Disability Confident Leader, we encourage applications from people with disabilities and are open to discussing reasonable adjustments throughout recruitment and employment.

## **About ExTrac**
ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.
The Middle East and North Africa (MENA) is a core region for ExTrac's intelligence coverage, spanning the political and security dynamics, actors, movements, and online ecosystems that shape risk across the region and beyond it. We are the analytical backbone for decision-making when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.
## **The Role**
As a Senior Analyst covering the MENA region, you will help ExTrac understand and anticipate political and security developments across the region, including the activities of state and non-state actors, violent extremist organisations (VEOs), and the online ecosystems in which they operate. Working in Arabic every day, across standard and dialectal material, you will turn what you find into timely reporting that feeds ExTrac's intelligence products and data platform.
## **What the job involves**
**Intelligence collection and analysis**
* Monitor and assess political, security, and socio-economic developments across MENA, including regional diplomacy, state and non-state actors, and geopolitical risk, with the ability to contribute to wider global coverage when required.
* Conduct daily monitoring of Arabic- and English-language media, including news outlets, social media platforms, official statements, and other open-source information environments.
* Track VEO and non-state armed group activity, including organisational developments, propaganda and communications activity, governance dynamics, operational activity, and regional linkages.
* Identify new narratives, actors, platforms, and threats appearing across online ecosystems.
* Apply structured analytical techniques to assess complex information and identify patterns and relationships.
**Intelligence production**
* Lead and contribute to daily, weekly, monthly, flash, and deep-dive analytical reporting, with a particular focus on MENA and VEOs.
* Translate and assess Arabic-language documents and other source material.
* Contribute to client-facing discussions, briefings, and ad hoc research requests as required.
* Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise across designated countries, actors, organisations, and thematic areas.
**Data curation**
* Lead and contribute to source coverage for the region, identifying and proposing new actors, entities, channels, and outlets for inclusion in ExTrac's research ecosystem.
* Verify and assess sources in the original language prior to inclusion.
* Maintain coverage against intelligence requirements, identifying where it should expand or deepen.
* Contribute to the taxonomy and tagging decisions that structure MENA and violent extremism data.
* Work with the wider research and data teams to translate analytical judgement into structured data that others can rely on without further verification.
**Leadership and collaboration**
* Support the Team Lead with the reviewing, and quality assurance of analytical outputs.
* Mentor junior analysts on research methodology, analytical standards, and source validation.
* Support other teams across ExTrac on projects and deliverables when required.
**Innovation and capability development**
* Help develop research methodologies, monitoring frameworks, and analytical processes to improve team efficiency and product quality.
* Integrate AI systems and AI-assisted workflows into analytical practice where they create genuine improvements.
## **You should apply if**
* MENA is the region you already follow closely, across its politics, security dynamics, and the violent extremist movements and online ecosystems operating within it. This is the region you want to go deeper on rather than a rotation on the way to something else.
* You work in Arabic, not just alongside it. You read Modern Standard Arabic and dialect comfortably, you notice when slang is doing something new, and you can tell the difference between a shift in language and a shift in intent.

We’re currently on an exciting journey as we drive forward significant organisational, people, process, and technology transformation to become a more forward-thinking, proactive regulator. We will use data more effectively to drive better regulatory decisions and build greater cohesion across our broad financial services remit.
Significant improvements in digital enablement, business intelligence, market data and information management maturity are all being pursued to maintain our position as a world leader in financial services regulation.
In March 2025, the FCA launched a new 5-year strategy to deepen trust, rebalance risk, support growth and improve lives. The FCA will focus on four priorities: * **Be a smarter regulator**; predictable, purposeful and proportionate. The FCA will improve its processes and embrace technology to become more efficient and effective.
* **Support sustained economic growth,** by enabling investment, innovation and ensuring the continued competitiveness of the UK’s world-leading financial services.
* **Help consumers navigate their financial lives** by working with industry to boost trust, product innovation and ensuring the right information and support is available for people to take financial decisions.
* **Fight financial crime,** focusing on those who seek to use the fact they are regulated to do harm. It will go further to disrupt criminals and support firms to be an effective line of defence.
**Background**
We are looking to appoint two additional Heads of Department to help lead our Wholesale and Unauthorised Business Investigations (WUBI) directorate, joining the leadership team which is made up of two other Heads of Departments (HoDs) and the Director. Our efforts help to fight financial crime, disrupt harm, protect the interests of consumers, and ensure that markets work well and operate with integrity. WUBI conducts forensic investigations into regulatory breaches and criminal offences by firms and individuals operating in the wholesale arena, as well as those carrying on regulated activities without authorisation, in breach of the general prohibition. Typical WUBI cases include insider dealing, market manipulation, individual misconduct, fraud and scams, and organised crime activity linked to the financial services sector. The portfolio includes regulatory and criminal operations, civil proceedings and the FCA’s Proceeds of Crime team sits within WUBI. By working across the FCA and with domestic and international regulators and law enforcement, WUBI helps ensure a coordinated and effective response to threats facing UK markets and consumers, and disrupting criminal activity.
**The Role**
Reporting to the Director of WUBI, the Heads of Department (HoDs) will be responsible for the development and delivery of the Enforcement strategy, in particular through ensuring investigations are delivered to a high standard. They will also play a key role in driving forward the FCA’s strategic work to fight financial crime and disrupt harm.
The appointed candidates will be part of the Division’s senior leadership team and will take an active role supporting and challenging others to deliver the full range of the Division’s responsibilities (which also include Market Oversight and Intelligence). The candidates will be innovative, forward-thinking leaders who look across organisational boundaries, join up our work and drive forward the outcomes that matter most.
**Key responsibilities:**
* Working with other Enforcement HoDs as part of a team to support the Director of WUBI in the delivery of the FCA’s work.
* Setting the strategic direction of the department (and with other senior management contributing to the strategic direction of the Division).
* Leading and inspiring a diverse, multi-disciplinary team of investigators.

# Senior Quantitative Analysis Manager
**A bit about Field**
Field funds, builds and operates battery storage and flexible renewable energy infrastructure across the UK and Europe. We are deploying grid-scale assets at pace across multiple markets - UK, Spain, Italy, and Germany - and are developing next-generation Long Duration Energy Storage (LDES) projects. Our Quantitative Analysis function is at the heart of our ability to monetise the optionality in our growing asset base, price and structure complex power market products, and support the origination of fixed revenue agreements that underpin investor returns. **The Role**
This is a senior leadership hire that will materially expand Field's analytical and risk modelling capability. The Senior Quantitative Manager will lead the Quantitative Analysis function, line managing the existing Quant Manager, and driving the build-out of pricing, valuation, and systematic trading models across UK, Spanish, Italian, and German power markets.
Reporting to the Group Treasurer & Head of Energy Origination, this role is the intellectual engine of the “Green Trading” function within Field, the power risk management and product origination arm of the business. The Senior Quantitative Manager will set the methodology, own the model architecture, and provide the analytical foundation for product structuring, origination pricing, and market risk management across Field's portfolio of owned and third-party assets.
This is a role for a highly experienced quantitative practitioner - someone who has built and run analytical teams in a power trading or energy risk environment and is ready to play a defining role in shaping how Field thinks about and monetises power market risk.
## Key Responsibilities
**Key Responsibilities**
**Power Market Risk Management**
* Own the architecture and development of Field's suite of power market pricing and valuation models across GB, Spain, Italy, and Germany, covering risk management, structured Battery Toll and Floor pricing, battery spread option valuation and delta hedging strategies.
* Lead the build-out of systematic spread-option valuation frameworks, including volatility surface construction, correlation analysis across power market products to inform execution
* Develop and maintain quantitative models for the valuation of structured power products providing robust pricing to support the origination and negotiation of commercial agreements
* Direct and continuously improve back-testing and scenario analysis frameworks to evaluate strategy performance, stress-test positions, and guide execution decisions, as well as automating analysis to enable systematic trading implementation
**Product Structuring & Origination Support**
* Act as the lead quantitative resource for the Trading & Origination function in the pricing and structuring of new fixed revenue products across Field's own assets and third-party asset pipeline
* Provide rigorous analytical assessment of BESS revenue structures: Day ahead swaps,, tolling agreements, and battery spread products - including sensitivity analysis, return attribution, and downside scenario modelling
* Develop and maintain performance benchmarking frameworks to assess and report on the risk-adjusted performance of trading and origination activity
* Support the assessment of new market entry opportunities in international markets, including developing market-specific pricing models that capture local market structure, liquidity dynamics, and regulatory nuance
**Market Risk Monitoring & Reporting**
* Own the group's market risk reporting framework: develop automated dashboards and analytics that provide real-time and periodic reporting of open positions, VaR, Cash Flow at Risk (CFaR), and portfolio-level risk metrics
* Manage mark-to-market valuation of live structured product positions and derivative portfolios, ensuring accurate and timely reporting to the Group Treasurer and senior leadership
* Oversee data infrastructure for quantitative analysis, including management of market data feeds (Bloomberg, N2EX, power exchange APIs) and integration with Field's Gaia optimisation platform
**Systematic Trading Strategy**
* Lead the development of systematic trading and bid strategy models for GB power markets, including delta hedging and rolling intrinsic strategies executed via Direct Market Access (DMA) platform
* Evaluate emerging algorithmic and machine-learning driven approaches to power market trading and advise on their applicability to Field's strategy and risk appetite
**Team Leadership & Systems**
* Line manage and develop the Quantitative Analyst, setting clear objectives, supporting technical development, and ensuring high-quality analytical output across the team
* Lead the assessment, procurement, and implementation of third-party ETRM/analytics systems alongside the Group Treasurer providing quantitative requirements definition and vendor evaluation
* Champion best practice in model governance, documentation, and validation, establishing internal standards for model review and version control
## Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
**A bit about you**
* You are a dynamic power market expert with a passion for building analytical models and identifying value
* You are not just on the cutting edge; you are a leader creating it. You think outside the box and challenge the status quo. Your ideas are game-changers and you are excited to make a huge impact in renewable energy and power markets
* You have innate ability to thrive in volatile markets, with a proven track record for turning complex data into intuitive trading strategies
* You’re an open, clear communicator who inspires others to think bigger and bolder through your analysis. You have ability to work collaboratively and present your ideas at all levels
* You have a reputation for delivering exceptional results within tight timelines. Your time management skills ensure that you stay ahead of the curve without compromising on quality.
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment, your capability to handle various tasks simultaneously while maintaining focus and creativity is crucial.
**Essential Skills**
* 5+ years of quantitative analysis experience in power or gas markets, with a strong track record of building and deploying pricing, valuation, or trading models in a live commercial environment
* Deep expertise in power market structure and dynamics, ideally across GB and continental European market(s), across the forward curve right up to intraday and balancing markets.
* Proven experience building spread-option or battery asset valuation models, including stochastic modelling, volatility surface construction, and/or Monte Carlo simulation
* Strong proficiency in Python (or equivalent OOP language) for model development and automation; experience with time-series analysis, statistical modelling, and/or machine learning applied to energy markets
* Experience managing or mentoring junior quantitative professionals
* Strong communicator - able to translate complex quantitative outputs into commercial insight for senior stakeholders, counterparties, and investors
**Preferred Skills**
* Experience pricing or structuring Day ahead swaps, tolling agreements, or other structured power products in a commercial or origination context
* Knowledge of interconnector markets (IFA, BritNed, ElecLink) and capacity auction mechanics
* Experience in continental European power markets (Spain OMIE, Germany EPEX, Italy GME/MGP)
* Masters or PhD in Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Physics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline
* Experience with ETRM systems or new data feed implementation
## Benefits
**Package Details**
Salary: £110,000 - £135,000
We’re offering a competitive compensation package, including participation in our growth share scheme which rewards all employees for the growth of the business.
Other benefits include:
* Up to 10% Company wide bonus based on company performance
* Hybrid working (blend of home and office working to suit individual needs)
* £2,000 per year to spend on your professional development
* Private medical cover with Bupa from day one with the option to add family members.
* Company Pension with 8% Contribution
* Enhanced parental leave, for all new parents:
* 6 months fully paid primary carer leave
* 3 months fully paid secondary carer leave
* 10 days fully paid leave for fertility treatment
* Fun co-working office space in Shoreditch, London
* 1 month work from anywhere, for those with a travel bug
* 1 day green leave to do something good for the environment
* Free lunch once a week - a great way to get to know people in the wider team
* Dog-friendly office, feel free to bring your pooch along
* Spill: our mental health benefit allowing every Fielder access to equal and unrestricted therapy and resources
* Regular, optional team socials designed to be inclusive for everyone (not just the pub goers!)
* Birthday carbon offset: a gift from Field to the world to celebrate your birthday
**Why join us?**
* **Genuine impact**: You will actually be building and operating the renewable infrastructure we need to reach net zero. This is not a green CSR initiative, but a company that is taking a leading role in building one of the critical solutions to a generational problem.
* **Make things happen**: We are still a relatively early stage company, and you will have significant accountability to make things happen from day one. You will have a lot of autonomy, will learn quickly, and be given a LOT of room to grow.
* **Define a new industry**: The energy market is in a paradigm shift right now, evolving at a breathtaking pace, and you will play a leading role in defining how that market evolves and innovates over the next few years.
* **Exceptional team**: We are an eclectic team with varied backgrounds. We have experience scaling billion dollar tech start-ups and building energy companies, as well as deep specialisms in the energy markets. You will learn from and work with a bunch of fun, curious, and entrepreneurial people who really want to make an impact.
**Our Values**
* **Move fast** - We’re finishers. Doers. Pragmatists. We take responsibility. We see things through and we always deliver on our promises. We roll up our sleeves and get things done. FAST.
* **Know your stuff** - We’re curious and pride ourselves on always learning, adapting and improving. There are no stupid questions here. We’re self-starters. We’re all learning and growing, always. And we take accountability for our own growth
* **Do it right** - We do things the right way and never cut corners. We always put safety above profit. We carefully manage the impact of our work on local communities and the broader environment. We are intentional and act with integrity at all times.
* **Work for the team** - We are friendly and approachable. We make time for one another, we lean on each other. We learn from one another, and we value diversity of thought and experience so we learn faster and get better
**Equality, Diversity & inclusion**
Diverse teams make better teams. Field is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment which is as representative as possible of our society. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender expression, marriage/civil partnership status, pregnancy/maternity status, race, nationality, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. We published a blog discussing our findings and learnings from our first Equity, Diversity and Inclusion survey in March 2023 which you can read here.
Still not convinced? See what our current team think about working here to find out why you should join us!
## About FIELD
To reach Net Zero, we need to solve big challenges. Field will fund, build and run the renewable infrastructure we need to tackle these challenges. At Field, we will show that batteries are a totally viable part of our energy infrastructure - ***now***, not in some distant future.
And, we have ambitious plans to become the defining new clean energy player in Europe over the next few years, gradually expanding beyond batteries into new asset types.

Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap.
*This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate.*
### WHAT’S THE ROLE?
We’re looking for a Senior QA Tester who will be responsible for testing Frontier’s games throughout all phases of development, from pre-production through post-release content.
In this role, you’ll work on medium-to-high-risk features, designing and executing comprehensive test suites, and conducting both regression testing and playtesting. Leveraging QA experience, you’ll proactively identify and resolve issues, provide guidance to QA team members and recommend and implement improvements.
Depending on project needs, you may also assume Assistant Lead or Team Lead responsibilities for specific phases or entire projects.
### WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
* Write, run and maintain medium-to-high risk test specifications and suites for new and existing projects, ensuring efficient time reporting and estimates on given tasks and written suites.
* Conduct playtesting using a variety of test personas e.g. destructive testing and player-like testing.
* Envision user stories and gather data with provided instructions.
* Identify and report issues in a clear and accurate manner.
* Perform regression testing for both internal and external issues.
* Act as point of contact for specific features, regularly collaborating with cross-discipline teams to gather and relay relevant information back to QA.
* Provide guidance and technical mentoring to other testers, including guidance on their documentation and advanced troubleshooting of other testers on the project.
* Raise potential future hurdles for testing, pre-empt problems, and suggest best fixes and ideas for further testing.
* Contribute to product information, identification of problem areas and analysis of trends to anticipate and navigate risks.
### WHAT YOU’LL BRING
* Significant QA experience in the games industry and a strong understanding of QA tools, procedures, methodologies and workflows.
* Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Experience aligning testing with requirements, managing priorities and successfully collaborating across disciplines/teams.
* Proven leadership or mentoring experience.
### BONUS IF YOU HAVE
* Ability to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
* Proven ability managing people.
### WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU
You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events. We strive to create an environment where everyone can fully demonstrate their capability and potential. If you therefore need any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition representative. For queries, please email: recruitment@frontier.co.uk

Values are extremely important to our culture and success at FullFibre...
We are Customer Centric. Our customers are at the centre of everything we do. We value, serve, and support our customers with care and dedication.
We are Collaborative. We prioritise effective communication, cooperation, and collaboration. We work as one team and celebrate our shared success.

The Senior Software Engineer will join our Systems, Development and Data team to grow our software engineering function and support our expansion as we support the rapidly growing business in providing market-leading onboarding, support, and account management experiences.
 
You’ll work on our estate of Python microservices (and related Rust modules), web applications, and API integrations - as well as working to integrate and configure our SaaS and hosted platforms - to build new features, understand and resolve issues, and design future work. You’ll also build web frontends for some applications and internal tools, and take ownership of full-stack end-to-end delivery.
 
We do interesting stuff, as well as the more straightforward bits of data plumbing – numerical routing and allocation optimisation, AI image analysis from field engineers, sentiment analysis, network analysis, low-level network monitoring, and lots of interesting geospatial bits and pieces.
 
As our senior software engineer, you’ll support junior engineers and help them develop into great software engineers. You’ll also help ensure that we keep our quality standards high, and that we’re developing the right tools to solve the business’ long-term challenges, even where requirements and demands are unclear or changeable. 
Ideal Profile...
* At least 5 years of professional experience with modern (typed, async) Python
* An inquiring attitude – you don’t like things you can’t explain, are driven to figure stuff out if you don’t know, and enjoy getting to the bottom of odd glitches and “one off” events
* Demonstrated experience working on live systems with real people’s data and services at stake, and a strong appreciation of risk and change management principles
* The ability to collaborate with technical and operations teams with a range of technical skill levels
* Excellent written communication skills, with strong asynchronous working familiarity
* Significant experience with Linux system and process administration, container technologies (Docker, etc)
* Experience with remote working in a fully distributed team environment
* Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics; or similar equivalent professional experience demonstrating your ability to work and think in a structured and analytical manner
Desirable skills, knowledge, experience 
* Experience with Kubernetes/Amazon EKS and GitOps/CI/CD workflows, GitLab
* Experience with frontend frameworks such as VueJS, and TypeScript (or JavaScript/NodeJS)

* Experience with SQL database technologies (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
* Experience with PySpark, Databricks, Delta Lake or other data warehousing technologies
* Experience with distributed systems engineering, message/event buses such as RabbitMQ, and RESTful API design
* Understanding of telecoms operational and business support systems
The Systems, Development and Data team is key function of the business, responsible for all internal and external facing systems, both third-party (SaaS) and internally delivered solutions. We build key internal and external tools, and make business processes flow smoothly, automating where we can, and making end-user experiences great where people need to be involved. We also own business data management; we deliver complex reporting outputs and maintain our data warehouse and processing pipelines.
 
We’re a friendly and diverse team, constantly helping each other out and supporting ongoing learning and development. We’re remote-first, and distributed across the UK, with occasional social get-togethers and workshops (usually at most once per quarter).
 
We do use AI where it makes sense in our workflows, including agentic coding systems and tools, but are thoughtful when it comes to selection of tools and use of automation in our day-to-day activities. The ideal applicant will bring a similar curious-but-sceptical attitude, be happy in a fully remote async-heavy team, and be aligned with our team values of inclusivity, openness, and curiosity.
You’ll have a head for architecture and the big picture but be happy stepping down into the detail to implement required changes. You’ll be a systems thinker, with experience working with distributed systems, business events, real-time systems and engineering reliable systems. 
 
You’ll be confident and happy to work independently, directly speaking with stakeholders and internal customers to ensure you’re delivering what they need, while ensuring we stay compliant and secure. As part of Gallagher, a global leader in animal management solutions for over 85 years, eShepherd is scaling rapidly across international markets. * Drive market growth for a game-changing livestock technology
* Sell AgTech that is changing livestock management
* Join a globally scaling business backed by Gallagher
* Significant career growth opportunities as we expand internationally
* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
* Tools, technology and support to help you succeed

* Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified prospects

# **Job Description**
**About GE Aerospace**
Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!
**Roles and Responsibilities**
In the 12-month **Research & Development (R&D)** Placement, you will work on R&D projects with multi-disciplinary and international teams. This is a Research Engineering role where you'll develop the next generation of projects. The placement will be a mix of hands-on, analytical & testing, working with a breadth of engineers providing you with exposure to the full life cycle.
We have several types of roles within this area; here is a snapshot of them:
**Advanced Technology Organisation (ATO)** **(Cheltenham)** - you will work on R&D and advanced technology projects in multi-disciplinary, international teams to help invent the future of flight and develop GE Aerospace’s next-generation products. The role blends design, analytical work, and hands-on prototyping and testing, giving you exposure to a wide range of engineering disciplines while maturing new technologies and products for commercialization and flight in roughly 2–5 years. You could work in areas such as embedded software, electronics and electrical hardware, prototype systems design and testing, and modelling and simulation across Power and Avionics products, joining an agile project team where tasks, support needs, and progress are discussed in daily meetings.
**Analysis team - R&D Performance Engineering** **(Dowty)** - you will work on R&D projects in propeller aerodynamics and acoustics with multi‐disciplinary, international teams, gaining exposure to the full lifecycle of propeller systems through a mix of hands‐on work, analytical tasks and testing. You will develop new design and analysis methods, run advanced CFD simulations to predict propeller performance, and validate results using wind tunnel data from high‐frequency pressure sensors, strain gauges and optical diagnostics such as PIV and SPR, in order to demonstrate aerodynamic and acoustic benefits of next‐generation propeller designs. Throughout the year you will be supported by structured goals, coaching and mentoring from your people leader and project team, present your findings regularly to experts in the UK, US and Germany, and may have opportunities to contribute to propeller or component test campaigns.
You will be guided by structured goals and objectives and will have responsibility to deliver on inspiring projects supported by your People Leader and team around you. We will guide you throughout the year to ensure you make the best of your GE Aerospace experience. Your People Leader will offer coaching and mentoring, and you will be provided with the opportunity to connect with other placement students across the UK.
This opportunity is offered in our **Cheltenham and Gloucester (Dowty, a GE Aerospace company) sites**, during the process we will ask you to share your location and role preferences.
With over 1,700 employees, **GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham** is one of the largest sites outside the USA and a major contributor to the local economy.
Our heritage dates back to 1940 yet our technology is cutting-edge. Located in the heart of Gloucestershire, the Power Distribution & Controls (PD&C) site focuses on the design, development and manufacture of state-of-the-art aircraft power distribution and avionics systems for the global aviation industry. Our customers include all major aerospace manufacturers - covering commercial, business jet and military applications. The scale and complexity of engineering projects offer our employees unique opportunities to work on major international projects, developing critical aircraft systems that will be relied on by many people for decades to come.
At GE Aerospace we strive to be an employer of choice by offering internships, apprenticeships, mentoring and staff development programmes that create a workplace where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential.
Innovation, a commitment to engineering excellence and leadership development places GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham as a pioneering force in building the future of flight.
**Dowty, a GE Aerospace company**, is based in Gloucestershire. It is a world-leading supplier of electronically controlled, composite propeller systems for A wide range of civil and military applications, including commercial airliners and military airlifters to multi-role seaplanes and marine hovercraft.
Key programs include the Lockheed Martin C-130J, the De-Haviland, Dash 8-400 and the Leonardo C-27J.
Operated by a highly skilled workforce, Dowty’s’ in-house production expertise for composite blades includes application of resin transfer moulding processes, which have been continuously evolved and perfected since 1976; and the use of braiding machines that rapidly and accurately apply the blades’ fibre outer layers.
If you are passionate about R&D, we would like to hear from you.
This placement role is an intended pipeline to our **Edison Engineering Development Programme (EEDP)**based in Cheltenham. Towards the end of the placement year, we will open graduate applications for our current placement students with an aim to secure a role prior to the end of their placement year.
Meaning, you can head back into your final year at university with a graduate job offer in hand. All you need to do is secure a 2,1 degree or above!
If you love technology and desire a career in Engineering, EEDP is for you.
Edison Engineers understand and apply engineering fundamentals in the business environment and design, analyse, and test the technology that continues to innovate how the world flies sustainably. Find out more here https://invent.ge/eedp

* Currently studying an Aerospace/Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Electrical, Systems or Software Engineering Bachelor’s or integrated Master’s degree
* On course to achieve a 2:1 degree or above
* To be in your penultimate year of study and returning to education post placement
**Desired Characteristics**
* Able to roll up your sleeves and get involved in projects
* Organised & able to work towards deadlines
* Inspired and curious to learn
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Able to take ownership for projects
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office
* Able to work as part of a team
A placement at GE Aerospace is an opportunity to learn while doing. At GE Aerospace, you’ll work with business leaders in an atmosphere that will develop you, while doing work that makes an immediate impact.
**Total Reward**
At GE Aerospace we understand the importance of Total Reward. Our flexible benefits plan, called FlexChoice, gives you freedom, choice, and flexibility in the way you receive your benefits, as well as giving you the opportunity to make savings where possible.
As a new joiner to GE, we are pleased to be able to offer you the following as default in your benefit fund, which you then can tailor to meet your individual needs.

* Life Assurance
* Group income protection
* Private medical cover
* Holiday Hourly equivalent of 26 days, with flexible options to buy or sell

As part of our recruitment process, you will be required to submit an initial CV application. After this, the stages include a video interview, testing and MS Teams online interview. Our recruitment team will be in touch with you at every stage to keep you updated and understand what is next in the process.
If you require any adjustments to the process to enable you to be at your best, please email the team via UKEarly.Careers@geaerospace.com.
Please note our applications will close on **Saturday 31****st****October** but may close earlier dependant on application volumes. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.
Please only submit one application. If you submit multiple applications, we will progress the most suitable one. If in future you are deemed to be suitable for other opportunities, we will automatically consider you for these too.

Our customers include all major aerospace manufacturers - covering commercial, business jet and military applications. Innovation, a commitment to engineering excellence and leadership development places GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham as a pioneering force in building the future of flight.

# Senior Agentic Engineer
We’re looking for an exceptional systems thinker who believes AI has fundamentally changed how software should be built.
We are building an AI-first engineering organisation where engineers increasingly design systems, orchestrate agents and build the tools that build the features, rather than writing most code by hand.
This isn't about being good at Cursor or Claude Code.
We’re looking for a deeply experienced, hands-on engineer who has fundamentally redesigned the way they build because of AI: someone who thinks from first principles, designs excellent systems, creates their own agents and tooling, and can take an ambiguous problem from zero → architecture → build → production.
You’ll help us move faster, but more importantly, you'll increase the capability of the engineering team.
You won't simply execute our roadmap.
We expect you to challenge it.
### **Your purpose in our mission**
We’ve raised $17.8 million in Series A funding led by Google Ventures and joined by Khosla Ventures. They believe in our vision that the law should be accessible to everyone, and this is where your skills come in.
We're hiring this person because we need another exceptional technical IC who can help us increase engineering velocity while challenging how and what we build.
The core problem we're tackling is AI Agentic Workflows.
We're looking for someone who:
* Is an exceptional systems thinker
* Solves difficult problems from first principles
* Designs excellent technical systems before reaching for implementation
* Uses AI creatively to multiply their own and the team's productivity
* Builds agents, subagents, tooling and automation, not simply uses them
* Thinks in backcasting: starting from the desired outcome and working backwards
* Has a strong cut strategy: simplifying architecture and identifying the shortest sensible route to an outcome
* Moves with urgency and cares deeply about momentum
* Is an exceptional hands-on IC who can own work end-to-end
* Challenges assumptions and proactively identifies opportunities that aren't already on the roadmap
* Can explain highly complicated technical ideas in remarkably simple language
* Is curious, open-minded and constantly experimenting
This is a capability hire, not a capacity hire. We're looking for someone who raises the technical bar of the team.
### **This is what you’ll be doing**
Your purpose is to increase Genie's engineering capability and speed through exceptional systems thinking and agentic leverage.
You won't just ship features.
You'll shape how we build products in the age of AI.
**Design exceptional systems from first principles:** You'll own technical design for complex problems, identifying technical risks, designing happy paths and edge cases, considering security, and breaking architecture into sensible milestones rather than producing huge theoretical design documents.
**Build the machine that builds the feature:** A conventional engineer might start by asking: “What already exists in the codebase that I can use to build this?”. We want you to also ask: “What tool could I build that would help build this for me?”. You'll create agents, subagents, software and workflows that allow AI to take on significantly more of the implementation process.
**Own products end-to-end:** You'll take ambiguous problems from: problem → discovery → technical design → architecture → implementation → verification → production. We care much less about whether you call yourself a frontend or backend engineer than whether you can understand the whole system and design it exceptionally well.
**Orchestrate AI, don't just use it:** You'll design, build and maintain agentic workflows that create genuine engineering leverage.
**Create 10x team leverage:** The goal isn't simply to make yourself faster. You'll build systems and tools that increase the output of the people around you too. sharing knowledge, improving workflows and designing for collective intelligence.
**Challenge our roadmap:** We don't want an engineer who waits for a PM to tell them what to build. Within 6–12 months, an exceptional person in this role will be identifying new ideas, technical opportunities and problems that the rest of us haven't even thought to put on the roadmap yet. You'll influence both engineering and product discovery.
### **This is how we’ll set you up for success and the outcomes we expect from you**
We're a startup in an exceptionally dynamic stage of growth.
The problems we're solving today may look very different in six months. We'll give you context, access and support, but we expect you to create clarity rather than wait for detailed instructions.
##### By the end of your first month we would like you to:
* Understand Genie's engineering and product-development workflow
* Get deeply familiar with our agentic engineering approach
* Understand how we prioritise speed improvements and legal-quality improvements
* Begin contributing to our agentic tooling and workflows
###### **By 90 days**
**We expect you to:**
* Be fluent in our development workflow and priorities
* Independently identify when and where speed or legal-quality improvements should be made
* Own meaningful work end-to-end
* Build/improve agentic tooling and workflows
* Begin proactively contributing to product and technical direction
###### **By 6–12 months**
You'll:
* Independently design and ship sophisticated AI-native systems
* Lead technical decisions within your area
* Create significant engineering leverage through agents and tooling
* Increase the team's delivery velocity
* Proactively challenge and improve the roadmap
* Identify valuable opportunities that weren't obvious to the existing team
##### We’ll continually develop and measure success on the below criteria:
**Systems & technical design quality:** Can you understand complicated systems, identify the real problem and design elegant solutions from first principles?
**Agentic effectiveness:** Are your agents, tools and workflows genuinely multiplying output, or are you simply using AI coding assistants?
**Engineering leverage:** Are you building things that make the entire team more capable?
**Delivery & momentum:** Are valuable things getting into production significantly faster because you're here?
**Product contribution:** Are you identifying valuable problems and opportunities rather than simply implementing an existing roadmap?
We are a start up in an exceptionally dynamic stage of our growth. We are a customer and employee led organisation. What this means is that we adapt to our customers' needs, and the problems we’re solving today could be very different in six months, or even by the end of this recruitment process. We also listen to our team as we empower you to have full autonomy of your role - you're the expert. You should expect to work with us on how your role develops, grows and changes throughout your time at Genie.
### **It can be tough here because**
* We move very fast
* Problems change quickly
* There are few precedents for this kind of engineering
* You won't always receive detailed specifications
* You'll need to create clarity from ambiguity
* We expect engineers to think about what should be built, not simply how to build it
* Our engineering practices are evolving rapidly as AI capabilities change
* You'll be expected to challenge established thinking, including ours
### **But we think you’ll love**
* Working at a truly AI-first company
* Building in ways much of the engineering industry is only beginning to discover
* Having radical ownership and autonomy
* Working alongside ambitious, deeply curious builders
* Experimenting with new engineering practices rather than following established playbooks
* Being close to product and technical decisions
* Building systems that can fundamentally multiply engineering output
* Challenging the roadmap rather than receiving it
* Shaping how Genie builds software in the age of AI
* Helping shape the future of legal infrastructure
### **The skills you need to succeed in this role**
We're looking for an exceptional senior hands-on IC.
But we're much more interested in evidence of engineering excellence than a collection of keywords on a CV.
**Exceptional systems thinking:** You can understand complex systems and design excellent solutions from first principles. You think about: Architecture, Technical risk, Security, Happy paths, Edge cases, Scale, Simplicity, Milestones, Trade-offs. You know when architecture needs sophistication, and when the best engineering decision is to cut complexity entirely.
**Deeply AI-native engineering:** You don't simply have "experience using AI coding tools." AI has materially changed how you engineer. You may already be: Building your own agents/subagents, Creating internal developer tooling, Building MCPs or other agent/tool interfaces, Automating parts of your development process, Orchestrating multiple agents etc.
**Exceptional hands-on engineering:** You are still a builder. You can personally take something from zero through architecture, implementation and into production. We don't want someone whose seniority has taken them far away from the technical work.
**Strong product instinct:** You don't think your responsibility ends when a ticket lands in Jira. You question assumptions, identify opportunities, understand the user/problem and contribute to what gets built, not merely how.
**Outstanding communication:** You can explain something technically sophisticated in language almost anyone can understand. You are open-minded enough to have your own ideas challenged and confident enough to challenge ours
*(Don’t worry about ticking every single box on the list to be considered for this role.)*
### **Our benefits**
Here’s just some of the benefits you can look forward to when you enter the Genie’s lamp:
* **Generous Stock Options:** We want all our genies to share in our success
* **Private healthcare:** To help keep you fit as a fiddle
* **Fully Remote Working:** Work from anywhere your heart desires
* **Unlimited book budget**: Dive into an unlimited budget for business, law, or technology books
* **Home Office Setup:** Equip your home office with the best – a top-of-the-range laptop, monitor, wireless keyboard, mouse, and a comfortable office chair. Your workspace will be as splendid as a royal palace
* **Learning and Development Budget:** Each Genie gets an individual £500 L&D budget annually, plus five days off for any job specific learning adventures
* **Unlimited Holiday:** Take as much time off as you need to recharge your batteries
* **Parental Leave:** Both genie parents get enhanced leave to welcome their little genies into the world
* **Free access to Genie:** For you to create, negotiate and collaborate on legal documents in real time on one platform!
#### ### **About Genie AI**
Genie AI is a machine learning startup with a mission to enable everyone to draft quality legal documents. We're shaking up the legal world and flipping the business model on its head!
Think of what GitHub did with open source code, Instagram and TikTok with entertainment, Airbnb with hospitality, and Uber with travel – Genie AI is doing that with legal contracts. We're conjuring up a community-based AI law platform that'll change the game. Join us, and let’s make some legal magic together!

Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. This is a single application for Site Reliability Engineering opportunities across Infrastructure Platforms. **Please note: This position is open to candidates based in the United Kingdom only. Candidates based in the United States or Canada can apply to this posting:** **Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — AMER (Intermediate to Senior Staff)**
**How our SRE hiring works**
Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team.
* **Recruiter Screen:** A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction.

* **Peer Technical:** Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on.
* **Skip-Level Interview:** A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams.

## Purpose of the role
Zego Insurance Limited (ZIL) is the Group's regulated insurance carrier, based in Gibraltar and supervised by the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC). As Interim Finance Lead, you are the ultimate owner of ZIL's financial health, accuracy and operational integrity. Because ZIL underwrites risk on its own balance sheet, the role demands deep, specialised expertise in insurance carrier accounting and technical reserves, not broker or agency finance.
This is a hands-on "player-coach" role. You'll own the end-to-end financial accounting cycle, ensure strict adherence to Gibraltar and insurance regulatory standards, and design and enforce robust financial controls. As a GFSC-regulated person, you carry personal regulatory responsibility for the accuracy and timeliness of ZIL's financial reporting.
## What you will be doing
**Insurance balance sheet and financial accounting**
* Own the general ledger and the insurance balance sheet in NetSuite, ensuring accurate accounting for premiums, claims, commissions, reinsurance recoveries and profit-share arrangements.
* Lead and execute the month-end and year-end close, producing management accounts (P&L, balance sheet and cash flow) tailored to an insurance carrier, delivered to agreed Group and Board reporting deadlines.
* Prepare and submit annual statutory accounts under UK GAAP (FRS 102) and the applicable Gibraltar Companies Act requirements, and support regulatory returns to the GFSC.
* Ensure all balance sheet accounts, bank and fiduciary accounts, and intercompany balances (including MGA/ZIL positions) are rigorously reconciled every month, with the ledger reconciled to actuarial reserves before submission.
**Actuarial partnership and capital management**
* Act as the bridge between Finance and Actuarial: understand, validate and integrate technical reserve calculations (IBNR, UPR, URR and similar) into the ledgers, and reconcile management accounts to reserving figures.
* Support Solvency II reporting as applied in Gibraltar, including inputs to QRTs, the SFCR and the ORSA, and help monitor capital adequacy so the business maintains appropriate buffers.
* Partner with actuarial, underwriting and pricing teams to analyse loss ratios, combined ratios and profitability by product line, translating technical data into commercial insight for the Board.
**Financial controls, audit and risk**
* Design, implement and enforce robust financial controls and SOPs, particularly around payment approvals, counterparty exposure and credit terms, to prevent fraud and eliminate reconciliation discrepancies.
* Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors and the GFSC. Manage the annual audit end to end, from planning through to sign-off, closing findings and embedding fixes so issues do not recur.
* Ensure timely, accurate filing of corporate taxes and other regulatory financial submissions, working with Group tax where relevant.
* Oversee daily cash flow and liquidity, produce rolling cash flow forecasts, and support investment income accounting to ensure claims-paying ability and operational funding.
* Own the ZIL finance system stack (NetSuite), ensuring it integrates cleanly with policy administration and actuarial data to maintain absolute data integrity.

* A fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* A proven track record in insurance carrier (balance sheet) accounting. You understand the mechanics of insurance financials; broker or agency-only experience is not sufficient.
* Demonstrated experience working closely with actuaries, and a strong conceptual grasp of reserving, pricing and capital modelling.
* Familiarity with Solvency II reporting (QRT, SFCR, ORSA) and statutory accounts preparation; Gibraltar or comparable small-jurisdiction regulatory experience is an advantage.
* Demonstrable experience building, testing and enforcing internal financial controls.
* The resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment: you stay calm and effective when priorities shift, without ever letting quality or accuracy slip.
* Willingness and ability to hold a GFSC-approved regulated-person position for ZIL.
* You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

* Big 4 audit experience with an insurance client portfolio.
* Hands-on experience with NetSuite in an insurance or MGA setting.

**Hybrid** - Primary location would be either in Gibraltar or nearby in Spain. Occasional travel to the London office may be required. To be considered for this role, you must be located in / OR willing to relocate to Gibraltar or nearby Spain.

# Head of Science
##### Leadership Scale 1-5 (Outer London) + Annual Loyalty Bonus + Pension Scheme (TPS) + Harris Wellbeing Cash Plan + Additional Harris Benefits
#### ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY
We are currently looking to appoint a dedicated and inspiring Head of Science to join and lead our Science Department, supporting our excellent students, promoting fresh thinking, creativity and ingenuity.
This full-time, permanent position is available for a January 2027 start. The successful candidate will have QTS and strong subject knowledge teaching up to and including KS5, with middle leadership experience desirable. As Head of the Science Department, you'll lead the department to continued success, whilst being responsible for shaping curriculum delivery, raising standards, and instilling a lifelong love for all things science in your students across all key stages.
#### WORKING WITH US
At Harris Academy Orpington, we have worked hard to create an environment where we look after and care for each other. Whilst being incredibly rewarding, working in schools can sometimes be hard. Colleagues at Harris Academy Orpington know that we work together as a team and we look out for each other; the environment here is one of care, nurture and support, along with a bit of challenge!
Harris Academy Orpington opened in September 2016, joining the highly successful Federation of Harris academies in London and the senior leaders here are experienced in creating and running great schools and that is what we are doing in BR5. We are a community school that serves families in and around Orpington and we are well on our way towards providing an outstanding education for the students who come here. We want out students to succeed and have choices in their lives; to take control of their futures and achieve beyond their dreams. We are **ambitious**, **tenacious** and **enterprising** and committed to helping our students succeed. Our work as a Health Science Specialist school, with students being given access to recognised professional qualifications, work experience and careers is unique and is designed to help and support the whole community who are regularly invited into the Academy to hear from guest speakers.
We have the most incredible facilities; with brand new science labs, 3 Main Halls, Dance Studios, 3 Astro Turfs, Drama Studios, dedicated Art and DT blocks, we are incredibly proud of the work that our students do here. We have developed a curriculum that is ambitious and broad. We believe in the need to nurture an appreciation of human creativity and achievement and have designed a curriculum that does just that.
We aim to ensure that every student is inspired and supported to achieve his/her personal best and learning comes first. Our motto is “Together We Can” and if you are interested in joining us, we would be very keen to meet you.
#### MAIN AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY
The purpose of your role will be:
* To be accountable for leading, managing and developing the subject area.
* To raise standards of student attainment and achievement within the whole subject/curriculum area and to monitor and support student progress.
* To ensure the provision of an appropriately broad, balanced, relevant and differentiated curriculum for students studying in the department, in accordance with the aims of the academy and the curricular policies determined by the Governing Body and Principal.
* To teach the relevant subject across the age and ability range.
* To facilitate and encourage a learning experience which provides students with the opportunity to achieve their individual potential.
* To effectively manage and deploy staff, financial and physical resources within the department.
* To share and support the school's responsibility to provide and monitor opportunities for personal and academic growth.
Your main areas of responsibility will fall under the areas of:
* Operational and strategic planning (including formulating the subject and faculty improvement plans, and leading the development of appropriate syllabuses, resources, schemes of work, marking policies, assessment and teaching strategies)
* Ensuring the delivery of an appropriate, comprehensive, high quality and cost effective curriculum and leading development of the subject and its delivery
* Staff development (including recruiting, building and managing an effective team of motivated staff)
* Student outcomes (including ensuring the effective operation of target setting, monitoring and evaluation systems and the input and maintenance of accurate student data)
* Pastoral system (including being a form tutor to a selected group of students)
* Teaching, including acting as an outstanding role model
#### WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We would like to hear from you if you:
* Hold QTS (or equivalent) and a relevant undergraduate degree, and, ideally, management training
* Demonstrate successful teaching of GCSE at good or better level
* Have experience of initiation and effective management of change
* Show evidence of raising achievement in present post and showing good value added for groups
* Have knowledge of current curriculum developments in subject and their implications
* Have good knowledge and understanding of current educational thinking
* Show good understanding of how children learn and how to raise standards of achievement
* Have good communication skills in speech and writing
* Display excellent organisational skills
* Are able to build and sustain professional standards and relationships with students
* Are able to contribute towards creating a safe and protective environment
For a full job description and person specification, please download the Job Pack.
#### APPLYING FOR THIS POSITION
Thank you for your interest in this position. If you would like to discuss this opportunity, or to request a visit, please email the academy via the Why work page on harriscareers.
Before applying, please download the Job Pack for full details on the job responsibilities and person specification. This will be help you when completing your application, and throughout the recruitment process.
We encourage you to apply as soon as possible as we may interview and offer to a candidate before the closing date. Please note that we only accept applications submitted before the closing date via our careers website.
#### WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU
**Teacher Development**
At Harris, we have curated professional development pathways that will guide you towards achieving your career ambitions. We have developed a strong culture of collaboration and best practice, with professional development and career planning at its centre. With a strong network of passionate educators, expert development initiatives and a multitude of opportunities for career progression, your journey with Harris could be the most rewarding one yet.
We offer a wide range of high quality teacher professional development programmes via the Harris Institute of Teaching and Leadership. Find out more here.
**Flexible Working**
We are committed to fostering a positive and supportive working environment for our staff, recognising that achieving a balance between professional and personal responsibilities is essential. We understand that each individual's circumstances are unique, which is why we offer flexible working options that can be adapted to meet the needs of both the academy and our employees.
**Benefits**
In addition to the opportunities for career development and progression, we also offer a competitive rewards and benefits package which includes our Harris Allowance (usually £2,000 for Inner London and £1,500 for Outer London), an Annual Loyalty Bonus, Teachers Pension Scheme, a Wellbeing Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme, and many other benefits. ## **We're Heidi.**
We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.
Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.
We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.
If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.
## **The role**
Heidi's UK and Europe business is growing faster than the finance scaffolding underneath it. Central finance across Sydney, Melbourne and Manila runs month-end close, core accounting and day-to-day operations, but the region needs someone on the ground who owns the accuracy of its numbers and sits close enough to the commercial team to shape decisions before they get made. Today, regional leaders wait on Australian hours for answers about their own P&L. You'll end that.
The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A.
## **What you'll do**
### Financial reporting and month-end close
* Own the integrity of the UK&Europe balance sheet, with reconciliations that stay current, reviewed and explainable
* Own the accuracy of the UK&Europe monthly group reporting and management accounts with variance commentary that explains movements
* Be the single point of contact for group finance on anything UK&Europe: queries, adjustments, restatements, consolidation-level questions
### Compliance and risk oversight
* Own the UK&Europe compliance calendar (Companies House, HMRC, VAT) by directing external accountants and advisers
* Own the adviser relationships (accounting, tax, audit), keeping work well scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi's internal finance standards
* Build an early-warning process so compliance risk is caught and escalated well before it threatens trading status
* Be the accountable owner if something in the compliance chain breaks down
### Commercial business partnering
* Be the day-to-day finance partner to UK&Europe leadership, owning the regional P&L narrative, budget vs actual and the "why" behind the numbers
* Bring a commercial lens to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, flagging risk and opportunity early
* Translate regional performance into clear, decision-ready input for FP&A and company leadership
* Give UK&Europe business leaders a reliable, self-serve view of their numbers, so decisions stop waiting on Australian hours
* Feed central finance the regional inputs it needs at close: accrual estimates, revenue and spend context, then review and sign off on the UK&Europe result
### Revenue risk and collections
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success to resolve aged and disputed balances and unblock stuck revenue
* Own the commercial view of collection risk: which accounts, why, and what it means for cash, and feed it into forecasting
* Drive down UK&Europe DSO by fixing the upstream causes (contracting, disputes, process), not by chasing invoices
### FinOps, controls and performance frameworks
* Build the operating rhythm that turns UK&Europe finance from reactive support into a reliable performance framework: clear KPIs, owners, review cadences and escalation paths
* Partner with budget owners on spend decisions before they are made, rather than policing them after the fact
* Strengthen financial controls across spend, approvals, vendor onboarding, card usage, subscriptions and commercial commitments, while keeping the process pragmatic for a fast-moving region
* Review regional AP and card activity, including prompt removal of leaver access and cards, and escalate anomalies to central finance operations
* Partner with external accountants, tax advisers, compliance providers and other vendors, making sure work is well-scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi’s internal finance standards
* Use FinOps-style discipline to connect spend, usage and outcomes, especially across tooling, GTM systems, implementation costs and region-specific operating expenses
* Create simple documentation and control checks so the region can scale without relying on informal knowledge or one-off fixes
## **What you'll need**
* Strong commercial and financial acumen — comfortable moving between P&L narrative, deal economics and cash impact
* Experience business partnering with Sales, Customer Success or regional leadership in a growth business
* Track record improving collections or DSO by fixing root causes, not just process
* Experience owning spend or expense controls in a way that supports the business rather than only governing it
* Comfortable directing (not necessarily performing) statutory compliance and VAT work through external advisers
* High degree of autonomy and ownership in a small, remote-first global finance team
* Clear, confident communicator — able to hold your own with commercial leaders and external advisers alike
* Experience in a multi-entity or multi-currency business
### Nice to have
* Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company
* Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent)
* Exposure to Companies House, HMRC and Irish Revenue processes
* Experience with Campfire, Airwallex or similar modern finance tooling
## **How we show up**
* **Build for the next decade, not next quarter.** Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.
* **Lead, don't wait.** We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.
* **Follow the evidence.** Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.
* **Own the outcome.** Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.
* **Ship, measure, go again.** A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.
* **Live in clinicians' reality.** Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.
## **Why Heidi?**
You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.
Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't *whether* AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.
## **We take care of you.**
We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.
