We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years - most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.
**ROLE PURPOSE**
We are looking for an Application Support Engineer to join our Engineering organization and help us improve how we investigate and resolve production and operational issues.
You will provide the first point of technical investigation for issues affecting our applications and services, working closely with Business Operations, Customer Support and our Product Engineering teams.
This is a hands-on technical role. You will investigate application behavior, query data, analyze logs and APIs, reproduce problems, and help determine what is happening before an issue needs deeper Product Engineering involvement.
The goal is not simply to process support tickets. You will help us make production support increasingly effective, repeatable, and scalable, while enabling our Product Engineering teams to remain focused on building and improving our products.
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Investigate and diagnose production and operational application issues
* Reproduce reported problems and identify likely causes.
* Query databases to understand application and data state.
* Investigate APIs, integrations and application behavior.
* Analyze application logs, traces and monitoring data.
* Identify potential relationships between issues, deployments, configuration and environmental changes.
* Resolve known issues using documented procedures and runbooks.
* Provide Product Engineering teams with clear technical evidence when deeper investigation or code changes are required.
* Support incident investigation and resolution alongside Product Engineering.
* Identify recurring issues and work with engineering teams to drive permanent improvements.
* Create and maintain technical runbooks and operational documentation.
* Help improve our monitoring, observability and overall application supportability.
* Share knowledge across Engineering rather than allowing operational knowledge to become dependent on individuals.
**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**
* SQL and investigating data in relational databases.
* HTTP and REST APIs, including requests, responses, authentication and status codes.
* Debugging web applications using browser developer tools.
* Investigating application logs, monitoring and observability tooling.
* Understanding how applications interact across services and integrations.
* Working with cloud-hosted applications and multiple environments.
* Understanding software deployments, configuration and environment differences.
* Structured troubleshooting and root-cause investigation.
**BENEFITS**

Job Description **Job Purpose**
The ICE Cybersecurity Threat Detection team is responsible for detecting malicious behavior across ICE's global infrastructure quickly and reliably enough to contain it. We build, tune, and maintain the detection content that security operation teams depend on, and hunt proactively for threats that existing controls do not catch, working alongside threat intelligence, incident response, and red team functions to keep coverage grounded in real adversary behavior.
**Responsibilities**
* Detection Engineering - Design, build, test, and maintain detection content across SIEM, EDR, and NDR platforms, and document the intent, data source, and expected behavior of each detection
* Detection Tuning and Health - Own false positive rates, alert volume, and rule health for assigned detection areas, including retiring logic that no longer earns its place
* Detection Coverage - Map detection coverage to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, identify gaps, and propose the telemetry or logic needed to close them
* Threat Intelligence Integration - Convert threat intelligence reporting into prioritized detection and hunting work, so coverage follows the adversaries and techniques most relevant to the sector rather than whatever arrived most recently
* Proactive Threat Hunting - Develop and execute focused hunts to discover threats that evade existing controls, and promote successful hunt outcomes into durable production detections
* Red Team Gap Remediation - Take ownership of detection gaps reported through red team and purple team exercises; track each gap to closure, build or amend the detection, and validate that the exercise activity is caught on retest
* Log Source Health - Validate the health and completeness of security log sources, detect collection failures and silent feeds, and onboard or update SIEM log sources in a timely manner
* Automation and Tooling - Apply a developer and problem-solving mindset to the work, using scripting to build internal tooling, process and normalize data, and remove repetitive manual effort wherever it appears
**Knowledge and Experience**
* Relevant experience in threat detection, security operations, or threat hunting
* Hands on, day to day experience with SIEM, EDR, and NDR platforms, including writing and tuning detection logic
* Working knowledge of a scripting language for automation, at the level needed to build useful internal tooling
* Demonstrated ability to investigate suspicious activity end to end: read the logs, form a conclusion, and communicate it clearly
* Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and the ability to reason about adversary tradecraft rather than only indicators
* Solid understanding of operating system internals, networking, and authentication as they appear in security telemetry
* University degree in Engineering, MIS, CIS, or related discipline; or equivalent years of experience
**Preferred Experience**
* Authoring Sigma rules and working with portable, vendor neutral detection formats
* Detection as code practices, including Git workflows, peer reviewed rule changes, automated rule testing, and pipeline based deployment
* Structured hunting methodologies such as PEAK or TaHiTI, and experience hunting against a documented backlog rather than ad hoc
* Applied AI engineering in a security context, including use or development of LLM assisted tooling for triage, enrichment, rule drafting, or log summarization, together with a realistic understanding of where these systems fail and how to evaluate their output
* Malware analysis, digital forensics, or reverse engineering fundamentals
**Specific Technologies**
SIEM platforms including Splunk and Elasticsearch. Endpoint detection and response platforms including Tanium, CrowdStrike, and SentinelOne. Network detection and response tooling and network traffic analysis. MITRE ATT&CK. Scripting and automation in Python or PowerShell. Windows, Linux, and cloud security telemetry, including authentication, process execution, and network log formats. Version control and ticketing workflows.

## Company Description
**At IFS, we're building the next generation of AI-native enterprise software, transforming how some of the world's largest organisations manage assets, operations and critical services.**
**Before you apply**
This role is about building and operating identity infrastructure, not administering it or governing it.
It is **not** a fit if your identity experience is:
* Managing Entra ID, Okta or AWS IAM as a consumer of a platform someone else operates: RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, SSO configuration, least-privilege policy

* Kubernetes RBAC and cloud IAM policies as part of a DevOps or SRE role
All valuable work. None of it is this job.
It **is** a fit if you have personally run an identity provider in production. Installed it, configured it, extended it, upgraded it, sized it, cut over between versions, restored it, and been on call when authentication broke at three in the morning.
If you have done that with Curity, we want to talk to you today.
This is a hands-on role and we expect you to still be writing code. We also expect that AI tooling has changed how you work. We'll ask what you delegate, what you still do yourself, and what you built to stop it breaking. Specifics, not a list of tools... so if you can evidence the correct experience for our role, please read on.
IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. We deliver award-winning enterprise software solutions through the use of embedded digital innovation and a single cloud-based platform to help businesses be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of ServiceTM.
At IFS, we're flexible, we're innovative, and we're focused not only on how we can engage with our customers, but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. ## Job Description
**The job**
Authorisation is the single biggest blocker to our next-generation platform right now. Two Principal Platform Engineers are joining to unblock it.
We are consolidating a fragmented authorisation landscape into one model across three hosting environments: our cloud-native platform, our legacy hosting platform and our lifecycle cloud. It is built on SpiceDB (relationship-based access control) on PostgreSQL, and it has to be correct, fast, and multi-tenant at enterprise scale. Alongside it, we run enterprise authentication on Curity, with Keycloak estates migrating onto it.
You will architect and build that, own it in production, and set the identity patterns the rest of engineering follows. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will write Go.
**What we need to see**
*Authorisation*
* Fine-grained authorisation systems you have built and run at production scale, in distributed multi-tenant environments
* Hands-on production experience with a Zanzibar-style authorisation engine: SpiceDB, OpenFGA, Ory Keto or equivalent
* Authorisation schemas and permission models you have designed, and the ability to reason about correctness, latency and consistency together
* ReBAC, RBAC and ABAC, and a view on when each is the right answer
* Policy-as-code exposure: OPA/Rego, Cedar or similar
* Running the authorisation engine in production on PostgreSQL, with observability and traceability of the decisions it makes
*Authentication*
* Enterprise-scale authentication you have architected and operated, not integrated with
* Hands-on production Curity and/or Keycloak: configuration, customisation, extensions, upgrades, operations
* OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML 2.0 and token patterns at a level where you can explain why a given flow, what its failure modes are, and where PKCE belongs
* Enterprise federation, SSO and directory integration, in a bring-your-own-identity model with per-tenant signing keys
*Operations and engineering*
* Identity infrastructure on Kubernetes (AKS): Helm, persistent volumes, blue/green cutovers, backup and restore, DR
* An IdP under load: config import latency, JVM tuning, pod sizing, dedicated node pools, and a story about what fell over and how you found it
* Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka/RedPanda, GitOps, IaC. Exact match not required, ability to get there fast is
* You still write code. These are principal engineers who build, not IAM consultants who produce documents
**How we work**
We expect that AI tooling has changed how you work. We will ask what you delegate, what you still do yourself, and what you built to stop it breaking. Specifics, not a list of tools.
We want strong opinions, held out loud. If you would not push back on your director in week two, this will not suit you.
## Qualifications
Authorisation (Must Have)
* **Architecting and engineering fine-grained authorisation systems at production scale**, in distributed, multi-tenant environments
* **Hands-on production experience with a relationship-based / policy-based authorisation engine**, ideally **SpiceDB** (or comparable Zanzibar-inspired systems such as OpenFGA, Ory Keto, or equivalent)
* Deep, practical knowledge of authorisation models: relationship-based access control (ReBAC), role-based (RBAC), and attribute-based (ABAC), and knowing when to apply each
* Experience designing authorisation schemas and permission models, and reasoning about correctness, latency, and consistency at scale
* Familiarity with policy-as-code approaches and tooling (OPA / Rego, Cedar, or equivalent)
* Understanding of the operational side: running the authorisation engine in production, backed by PostgreSQL, with observability and traceability of authorisation decisions
Authentication (Must Have)
* Architecting and engineering enterprise-scale AuthN solutions, demonstrated at production scale
* Hands-on production experience with **Curity** and/or **Keycloak**: configuration, customisation, operations, and integration
* Deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0, and token-based authentication patterns (JWT, opaque tokens, token introspection)
* Experience with enterprise identity federation, SSO, and directory integration (LDAP, Active Directory)
* Strong hands-on engineering capability across the NGA stack, or the ability to get there fast:
+ **Backend:** Go
+ **Messaging / Streaming:** Apache Kafka / RedPanda
+ **Data:** PostgreSQL
* Comfortable operating in a cloud-native environment: Kubernetes (AKS), containers, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code
* Event-driven and distributed systems architecture
* Secure coding practices and security-by-design principles

# 3D Graphic Designer Jobs
August 25, 2026
There are very few fields as diverse as graphic design, an industry in which no single role is clear cut and jobs often overlap (even with work that isn't graphic design related).
That's exactly what you'll find in our below list of graphic design jobs which we hope will help demystify some of the terms and provide a little bit of guidance as to how to get a graphic design job (as well as what kind of salary to expect once you do).
But it bears repeating: unlike our previous job glossary lists (such as the guides to jobs in film and broadcast journalism), rarely are two individual graphic design jobs alike and there's a lot of crossover between duties. As such, average salaries are given as very rough rules of thumb only.
We've also provided an approximate difficulty scale which indicates not the technical requirements of the job, but how difficult it is to get full time, paid work. Without further ado...
### Print Designer
The debate continues to rage as to whether designing for print is a dying art form (and it is true that jobs in this sector have diminished), but creating artwork that is intended solely for printed materials is still in demand. It's a highly technical field, requiring in-depth knowledge of both traditional print techniques and their integration with contemporary digital advancements.
Print Designer Career Path: While 'print designer' is a blanket term covering a wide number of subsets (such as package designer below), those looking to acquire print design jobs are nearly always required to have attended graphic design school beforehand. Proficiency in the Adobe suit and particularly InDesign Quark Xpress are also essential before hitting the classifieds.
Pros: There's a recognizable feeling of merit to work solely for print these days, and once you've mastered the art, you can tackle pretty much any job in the industry. Regular, 9 to 5 hours are also common.
Cons: The number of print jobs is dwindling rapidly - those working for book, newspaper and periodicals can expect a 16% decrease in jobs between 2012 and 2022 (according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics).
Difficulty: 7/10
Print Designer Salary: The median average is, 000, but the mean average is useless for print design salaries given the variance across the industry.
### Web Designer
Unlike a print designer, a web designer deals specifically in graphic elements intended for viewing on a desktop or mobile device. Given the hugely varied nature of the work that falls into this category, it's a broad term that covers a large swathe of the industry and is often conflated with web development; for the purposes of this entry, we're going to focus specifically on rather than coding.
Web Designer Career Path: While graphic design school and related qualifications can offer a huge step up, a lot of web designers are self-taught and build up their portfolios gradually to score further work. As above, the ability to also code in a variety of language is massively beneficial.
Pros: A reasonable degree of creative control, plus opportunities to work either on a freelance basis or salaried depending on your preference.
Cons: It's an extremely saturated market, so competition is high while the pay is low for what is actually a very skilled job.

# BI Developer (SQL, Data Modelling, Power BI)
bei innocent drinks
* London, Vereinigtes Königreich
* Full Time
* Vor gestern
Here at innocent, we’re on a mission to make it easier for everyone to get more fruit and veg into their bodies. We started back in 1999 and since then we’ve gone from selling a few smoothies at a music festival to becoming one of Europe’s biggest drinks companies with around 1,000 people (and the B Corp seal of approval).
It’s nice to be able to say things like that but we’re not patting ourselves on the back just yet. We want to show everyone that it’s possible to be a successful business while looking after people and the planet too, so we’re trying to get better in pretty much every way. And that’s where this job comes in.
A bit about the role
Data is becoming one of innocent's most important ingredients. We're investing in a modern Microsoft analytics platform that brings together information from across our business to help teams understand what's happening, spot opportunities, and act with confidence to achieve our ambitions as a company
As a BI Developer, you'll help build the trusted data products that sit at the heart of this. You'll turn data from multiple systems into clear, reliable models that people across the business trust and consume via enterprise reports and self-serve analytics. Working with SQL, Kimball data modelling concepts, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, you'll help create the foundations that supports reporting today and future Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities tomorrow.
This isn't a role for someone who wants to spend all day hidden behind code. The best solutions come from understanding how the business actually works, so we'll be looking for someone who's naturally curious, asks good questions, and enjoys getting close to the processes, people and decisions behind the data.
You'll be
* Designing and building enterprise data products that combine data from multiple business systems into trusted analytical datasets.
* Creating fact and dimension models that make complex business data easy to understand and use.
* Developing views, stored procedures and transformation logic using Transact-SQL (T-SQL).
* Building and optimising Power BI semantic models that support reporting and self-serve analytics.
* Turning business requirements into scalable data solutions that can be reused across teams.
* Supporting and improving the performance, quality and reliability of analytics solutions.
* Working closely with BI Analysts, Data Engineers and business stakeholders to solve real business problems.
* Sharing knowledge, contributing to development standards and helping raise the bar for analytics across innocent.
You'll have
* Strong experience creating dimensional data models using fact and dimension tables.
* Excellent T-SQL skills, including views, stored procedures and query optimisation.
* A good understanding of Kimball data modelling concepts including grain, surrogate keys, conformed dimensions, and star schemas.
* Experience turning raw or operational data into trusted, business-ready datasets.
* The ability to investigate complex data issues and work through them logically.
* Confidence explaining technical concepts to people who don't live and breathe data.
You'll get
* The chance to shape how trusted data is built and used across innocent.
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, SQL Server, Power BI and Azure as part of our evolving analytics platform.
* Opportunities to work with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain
* The opportunity to build data products that will be used by hundreds of people across the business.
* A seat at the table as we develop our future data and AI capabilities.
* Colleagues who care about good design, simple solutions and helping each other learn.
* The freedom to introduce better ways of working, challenge assumptions, and leave things in a better place than you found them.
We want innocent to be a great place to work, so we do lots of stuff to make people feel at home and try to make sure everyone’s career is shaping up the way they want it to. There are plenty of opportunities to have a go at something new or take things further.
In exchange for helping us do business in the right way, you’ll get a solid rewards package that includes a salary (phew), private healthcare, a target-based bonus, and a bunch of other nice things like a day off on your birthday. And yes, you get free smoothies.
We also know that not all our drinkers come from the same background, or think the same – so why should we? At innocent, we want to be a great place to work where a diverse bunch of people from all backgrounds can turn up and thrive. When we hire, we want all the juice, bits, and pulp that make you who you are.
Even if you don’t think you can tick all the boxes, if the job sounds right for you, come and throw your hat in the ring.
Probably best to get your skates on though, as we might close this early if we get loads of applications.

# Team Coordinator, President Team, London
London
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.
Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.
### **About Iso**
Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.
### **Your impact**
We are looking for an energetic, highly reliable and proactive Team Coordinator to join the President Team. Reporting directly to the President’s Executive Assistant, you will be the essential "boots on the ground" force ensuring the day-to-day physical operations, guest experiences and events of the executive suite run flawlessly.
This is an execution-focused, highly collaborative role for a true "do-er" who thrives on detail, mucks in wherever needed and takes pride in being a warm, professional extension of Isomorphic Labs’ President Team.
### **What you will do**
Executive Support & Meeting Readiness
* Own the end-to-end physical preparation for executive meetings, including printing and binding high-stakes materials, ensuring tech is connected, and preparing meeting spaces to immaculate standards to ensure pristine room and tech readiness.
* Own the physical logistics, environmental readiness and material distribution for all of the President’s internal speaking engagements and events, including company-wide forums, fireside chats and leadership presentations.
* Act as the face of the President’s team by greeting high-profile external guests, facilitating their arrival experience, and providing flawless hospitality (making coffees, teas, and setting up refreshments) with a high-touch, warm presentation.
* Take charge of local, practical details around the office and event venues—knowing the best pickup/drop-off points, tracking traffic or courier delays, and handling the local neighborhood logistics so everything runs without friction.
* Handle real-time adjustments on the President's travel days, coordinating directly with drivers or transport providers to ensure arrivals, departures, and transitions are perfectly timed and seamless.
* Run day-to-day administrative errands, including picking up executive lunches, organising couriers, and handling urgent operational requests while remaining highly proactive, responsive, and dynamic to real-time on-the-ground changes and issues that arise.
* Establish great working relationships and closely liaise with internal stakeholders, alongside external workplace teams, to ensure seamless suite operations.
Team Operations & Stakeholder Engagement
* Coordinate and deliver the end-to-end operational and space logistics for key leadership meetings, internal team milestones, and stakeholder events.
* Help bring team culture to life by driving the sourcing, logistics, and delivery of internal recognition projects and milestone keepsakes.
* Support the external operations of the President's Office by handling the physical distribution, courier logistics, and preparation of outward-facing materials with high attention to detail.
Event & Offsite Support
* Travel to select offsites and external leadership events to oversee physical space setup and ensure room layouts match the agenda's requirements while providing proactive, on-the-ground reactive logistics support to dynamically handle real-time shifts.
* Act as the primary on-the-ground point of contact for external coaches and facilitators, ensuring they have all physical materials, tech, and space requirements fully sorted.
### **Skills and qualifications**
### **Essential:**
* You possess a high bias for action. No task is too small, and you genuinely enjoy "mucking in" to solve problems before others even notice them, showing deep responsiveness to the unexpected.
* You understand that small things matter—whether it's the alignment of a printed document, the creative presentation of a gift, or the temperature of a meeting room.
* You will be operating around sensitive information and high-profile guests; you bring a calm, polished, warm, approachable, and strictly confidential presence to the workplace.
* You can switch gears instantly when schedules shift and maintain an upbeat, solution-oriented attitude under pressure.
* You can track multiple moving parts—from vendor deliveries for custom gifts to organizing presentation materials for global events and offsites—while actively liaising with external workplace stakeholders.
Reporting Structure & Growth
This role offers a unique window into high-level executive operations. You will report directly to the Executive Assistant to the President, sitting within a tight-knit support ecosystem that flows up into the President's Senior Operating Partner.
### **Culture and values**
We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.
**Thoughtful**Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.
**Brave**Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.
**Determined**Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.
**Together**Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.
### **Creating an extraordinary company**
We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.
We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

## **Job Description and Person Specification**
**Job Title**: Data & AI Manager
**Salary:** £48,500 - £52,500

## **BACKGROUND**
For more than 20 years, Magic Breakfast has been helping children and young people start the day with the nourishment they need to learn, grow, and thrive. But the impact of breakfast goes far beyond food. Every morning, we help pupils arrive at school feeling valued, included, and ready to reach their potential.
Today, 2.1 million children across the UK are at risk of hunger, the equivalent of four pupils in a classroom of 30. Working with schools in disadvantaged communities across England and Scotland, Magic Breakfast is committed to ensuring no child is too hungry to learn. One breakfast at a time, we are helping children and young people build brighter futures.
This is a pivotal moment to join Magic Breakfast. Governments in both England and Scotland have committed to expanding access to free school breakfasts, recognising the vital role they play in children’s wellbeing and attainment. Yet significant gaps remain. Pupils in secondary schools, alongside younger children in nursery and early years settings, are still at risk of starting the day hungry. By joining Magic Breakfast, you will become part of a passionate, ambitious organisation driving lasting change for children and young people across the UK.

We are seeking an enthusiastic Data & AI Manager to play a key role in driving Magic Breakfast's new Data and Technology Strategy and supporting the organisation's transition towards more product-led, data-informed and AI-enabled ways of working. In this new role, you will take on specialist management and be the subject matter lead for this evolving, business critical area and be responsible for the delivery, adoption and continuous improvement of Magic Breakfast’s data platform, reporting, AI and digital product capabilities.
You will manage a small specialist team responsible for:
* the development of a secure, scalable data platform (Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform and Salesforce)
* the delivery of high-value reporting and data products
* the identification and rollout of AI and data-enabled use cases across the organisation

Also supporting how capability is enabled and ways of working established to ensure non-technical colleagues can operate effectively in these areas.
* Balance external partner delivery with the development of internal capability, reducing dependency over time.
**Product-led Delivery and AI Enablement**
* Support the delivery of data, AI and digital products by providing technical leadership, platform expertise and delivery oversight across the product lifecycle.

* Champion the safe, responsible and effective adoption of AI-enabled tools and ways of working across the organisation.
* Identify opportunities to improve organisational efficiency through automation, workflow optimisation and effective use of existing technology.
* Monitor the performance, reliability and adoption of delivered solutions, using insight and feedback to inform ongoing improvements.
* Work collaboratively with stakeholders to balance innovation and experimentation with appropriate governance, security and risk management.
**Data Governance and Organisational Insight**
* Maintain and embed the organisation's data governance framework, ensuring data, reporting and AI-related activity is aligned with organisational standards, policies and priorities.
* Ensure business-critical data, reporting, metrics and KPIs are trusted, accessible and aligned with strategic objectives.
* Ensure data required for internal and external reporting is identified, prioritised and aligned with organisational standards and strategic objectives.
* Promote evidence-based decision making and support colleagues to make effective use of organisational data, reporting and insight.
* Provide expert guidance on data, reporting and governance considerations to support organisational change and improvement initiatives.
* Support the delivery of the Data and Technology Strategy, ensuring data, reporting and AI capabilities contribute to organisational priorities and outcomes.
**Line Management, Delivery and Adoption**
* Lead and develop the Data team in line with Magic Breakfast’s values, policies and procedures ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities and priorities
* Set objectives, monitor performance and support professional development across the team, building capability in data, product delivery and AI-enabled ways of working.
* Translate the Data and Technology Strategy into team plans, priorities and deliverables, monitoring progress and adapting to changing organisational needs.
* Ensure the team’s work is prioritised effectively, balancing strategic initiatives, operational support and available capacity.
* Support the successful adoption of data, reporting and AI-enabled tools across the organisation, helping colleagues build confidence and capability in their use.
* Build strong collaborative relationships across the organisation to support effective delivery, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, learning and continuous improvement that reflects Magic Breakfast’s values and mission.

* Help to maintain a positive working environment, keeping the vision of Magic Breakfast at the heart of everything we do

# Principal Software Engineer - (.Net, PHP, Umbraco, Drupal)
The most senior technical role in manifesto’s engineering team, a Principle Engineer, provides leadership when it matters most: whether shaping a new client opportunity, designing complex architecture or resolving a critical live issue.
Apply
Location:UK wide - hybrid
Salary:£65,000 - £75,000
## About the role
A Principal Engineer is the most senior technical role in manifesto’s engineering team , providing leadership when it matters most: whether shaping a new client opportunity, designing complex architecture or resolving a critical live issue.
You will work across our client estate rather than being embedded in a single project, moving between platforms and codebases as the work demands. You will hold technical authority across our core stacks, .NET and Umbraco, PHP and Drupal, alongside the cloud infrastructure and hosting platforms that sit underneath them.
The role has three sides to it. You help shape technical solutions through discovery, technical qualification and solution design. You steer delivery on our most complex projects, setting the architectural direction and lifting the standard of the engineering around you. And you are the person who can drop into an unfamiliar codebase under pressure and diagnose what is actually happening, giving both our teams and our clients confidence at the moments that matter most.
We build digital products for charities, non-profits and membership and visitor organisations. Our clients are purpose-led, often working with constrained budgets, and the platforms we build carry donation journeys, supporter data and services people depend on. Technical decisions here have real consequences, and this role exists to make sure we get them right.
### **Responsibilities**
* Provide technical authority across our client estate, spanning multiple platforms, hosting environments and codebases.
* Shape technical solutions for new business, from initial qualification through discovery to solution design and estimation.
* Lead the architecture of our largest and most complex client projects.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for live incidents and complex problems, across multiple stacks.
* Raise the standard of engineering across the department through mentorship, technical review and setting clear standards.
* Build client confidence by representing us credibly with senior technical stakeholders.
#### **You set and hold the technical direction on our most complex work**
* You define architecture that is appropriate to the client's budget, team and long-term maintenance capability, not to the most interesting technical solution available.
* You uphold a clear software design philosophy and ensure teams deliver maintainable solutions.
* You have a clear understanding of simplicity. You define solutions that are simple by design and challenge requirements that introduce unconsidered complexity.
* You identify and challenge ineffective practices in delivery teams and in client organisations.
* You delegate, and maintain clear separation from work that should be considered routine.
* You make hosting, infrastructure and platform decisions with a clear view of cost, security and who will be responsible for what after launch.
* You are the senior technical escalation point across the estate
* You diagnose and resolve complex problems in codebases you did not write and may not have seen before.
* You lead the technical response to significant incidents, establishing root cause and directing remediation.
* You give clients and internal teams confidence at the point where things have gone wrong, through clear communication and visible control of the situation.
* You identify the systemic causes behind recurring problems and drive the changes that stop them repeating.
* You raise the standard of engineering across the department
* You are an active and visible technical leader across the company.
* You mentor lead and senior engineers, building capability rather than absorbing the hard work yourself.
* You contribute to and uphold our engineering standards, technical governance and software development lifecycle.
* You demonstrate your passion for keeping on top of current tools, standards and trends, including AI-assisted engineering practice.
* You support marketing and new business with prototypes, thought leadership or presentations where it plays to your strengths.
* You create learning within the team by specifying solutions that further our collective knowledge and give others opportunities to grow.
## About you
### **Professional knowledge and experience**
* **Cross-stack technical depth.** Genuine working expertise across more than one platform and language, specifically .NET and Umbraco alongside PHP and Drupal. Comfortable holding technical authority in both rather than being deep in one and passing in the other.
* **Architectural leadership.** Expert in designing robust, scalable and secure architectures for content-managed platforms, integrations and modern web applications.
* **Cloud and infrastructure.**Practical, hands-on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and managed hosting environments. Enough depth to make infrastructure decisions and resolve infrastructure problems with minimal support.
* **Diagnostic ability under pressure.** Proven ability to enter an unfamiliar codebase, establish what is happening quickly, and lead resolution. This is a defining requirement of the role.
* **Pre-sales and technical discovery.** Experience qualifying opportunities, running technical discovery, producing solution designs and estimating work before it is sold.
* **Software engineering principles.**Mastery of clean code, testing practice, design patterns, security and accessibility standards.
* **Leadership and mentorship.** Demonstrated experience developing lead and senior engineers, raising standards through others rather than personally absorbing the difficult work.
* **Commercial awareness.**Understands that technical decisions carry margin, risk and maintenance consequences, and factors this into the solutions proposed.
* **Communication**. Outstanding ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and to hold client confidence when things are difficult.
### **Technical skills**
#### **Essential**
* Strong hands-on experience with content management platforms across more than one stack, specifically Umbraco and .NET, and Drupal and PHP
* Practical cloud engineering experience, primarily Azure, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and environment management
* Experience across managed hosting platforms such as Azure, Acquia, Umbraco Cloud, WP Engine or Pantheon
* API design and integration, REST and GraphQL, including third-party systems such as CRM, payment and marketing platforms
* Security by design and DevSecOps practice, with particular awareness of handling supporter and donor data
* Accessibility standards and practice, WCAG 2.2 and above
* Version control, branching strategy and release management at scale across multiple codebases
* Agile delivery practice, and how to make it work in a client services context
#### **Desirable**
* Headless and decoupled CMS architecture
* Authentication and identity, including OAuth and SSO
* Search implementation, including AI-assisted and hybrid search
* AI-assisted engineering practice, agentic tooling or AI-enabled development workflows
* Experience of the charity, non-profit or membership sector and its particular constraints
### **Behaviours**
* You are the person others want on the call when something has gone wrong. You stay calm, establish facts quickly and communicate clearly under pressure.
* You are pragmatic rather than purist. You choose the simplest approach that meets the need and challenge complexity that is not earning its place.
* You proactively define and champion the long-term technical direction, ensuring it aligns with business goals and client reality.
* You actively develop and empower other engineers, sharing knowledge and building capability rather than becoming a single point of dependency.
* You move comfortably between client contexts, quickly getting up to speed while maintaining the focus needed to provide effective technical leadership.
* You engage confidently with stakeholders across the business and in client organisations, translating technical concepts and influencing decisions.
* You resolve conflicting requirements and differing opinions into a plan all parties can support.
* You set high standards for quality, reliability, security and maintainability, and hold others to them constructively.
* You seek out new technologies and approaches that deliver genuine value, and are honest about the ones that do not.
* You embody Manifesto's values, championing purpose-driven work and fostering a positive team culture.
## About us
### **manifesto**
We are the digital experience agency for changemakers. We are committed to delivering purposeful and positive impact for people, planet and society, in restless pursuit of a better world.
We take pride in creating award-winning digital experiences, products and services that are measurably ethical, inclusive, accessible, sustainable and joyful.
Our changemaker clients include UNICEF UK, Breast Cancer Now, Trussell, Woodgreen, The Royal Academy of Arts, Zoological Society London, Historic Environment Scotland and Fauna & Flora.
Part of the TPXimpact group - a Certified B CorporationTM, we are a team of 130 digital product leaders, creative designers, user experience designers, engagement specialists, software engineers and experience strategists.

TPXimpact is a digital transformation company, and Certified B CorporationTM, on a mission to build a future where people, places and the planet are supported to thrive. Combining vast expertise in human-centred design, data, experience and technology, we help the public, private and third sectors with their digital transformation journey, delivering high quality solutions that improve services, experiences and outcomes. We’re passionate people who work in close collaboration with our clients to create sustainable solutions ready for an ever-evolving world.

# Lead Software Engineer - Umbraco
We are looking for a Lead Engineer to provide senior technical leadership on our Umbraco platforms, working alongside engineers, QA analysts and project managers to deliver high quality work on time and to budget.
Apply
Location:UK wide - hybrid
Salary:£55,000-£62,000
## About the role
As Lead Engineer you will provide senior technical leadership on our Umbraco platforms, working alongside engineers, QA analysts and project managers to deliver high quality work on time and to budget.
We are looking for genuine Umbraco expertise rather than broad CMS familiarity: someone who knows the platform properly, has taken sites through major version upgrades, understands Umbraco Cloud and its constraints, and can make architectural decisions that hold up over the life of a long-term retainer.
You will join an existing Umbraco practice and work as part of a small group of technical leads, sharing responsibility for standards, architectural direction and the technical health of the platforms we look after. Our Umbraco clients are charities, non-profits and membership organisations, and the platforms we build for them carry donation journeys, supporter data and services people rely on. Much of the work is continuous improvement on established platforms rather than greenfield build, which means the technical decisions you make will be lived with for years by the teams that follow you.
You will lead architecture and technical planning on the projects you are responsible for, uphold quality through code review and standards, and develop the engineers around you. This role does not carry line management or resourcing responsibility, that sits with the Engineering Manager. Your focus is technical leadership and delivery quality.
### **Key responsibilities**
#### **You provide senior technical leadership on the Umbraco platforms you are responsible for**
* You are a senior technical authority on Umbraco, setting and upholding standards for how we build, extend and maintain client platforms.
* You make architectural decisions appropriate to the client's budget, team and long-term maintenance capability, not to the most interesting technical option available.
* You plan and lead major Umbraco version upgrades, assessing package and integration compatibility before committing to a path.
* You maintain a clear view of the technical health of the platforms you support, and surface risk before it becomes a problem.
* You make sensible decisions about hosting, environments and deployment on Umbraco Cloud and equivalent platforms.
* You contribute to shared Umbraco standards and practice across the business, working with other technical leads rather than in isolation.
#### **You define the technical approach for solutions and plan their delivery**
* You consult with principal engineers and contribute to high level architecture during the Foundations phase of a project, specifying which technologies will be used and how they connect together.
* You provide broad plans for technical delivery, identifying the main themes, their approximate sizes, levels of risk and the order they will be delivered in.
* You produce estimates that state clearly what is in scope, what is out of scope and what assumptions the numbers rest on.
* You manage client expectations about the process of agile delivery and what they should expect to see at the end of each sprint.
#### **You lead the delivery of high quality software on time and to budget**
* You ensure your project team members are fully engaged and participating in all aspects of the project during evolutionary development.
* You ensure the ceremonies of your agile project happen at the right time with the right people present, including stand-ups, backlog refinement, timebox planning, code reviews and retrospectives.
* You ensure your team delivers the work they have committed to by the agreed deadline.
* You uphold quality through code review, and hold the line on standards when delivery pressure argues against it.
* You apply particular rigour to anything touching donation journeys, payment integrations or supporter data, where the cost of a defect is measured in lost income and lost trust.
* You ensure your team collaborates well at all times, that problems are discussed early and raised to the project lead and client as necessary.
#### **You manage the technical and support relationships with your clients**
* You are the senior technical point of contact for the clients you support, able to explain technical decisions and constraints to non-technical stakeholders clearly.
* You lead the technical response when things go wrong on your accounts, establishing what has happened and directing the fix.
* You ensure your clients are supported by the appropriate team members, working with engineering managers so the right profile of engineer is available.
* You ensure the smooth operation of support boards, unblocking technical team members and resolving issues.
* You provide the technical continuity that long-term retainer clients depend on, holding the context that would otherwise be lost between people.
#### **You support the growth of the engineering team and promote quality software engineering**
* You develop the engineers around you, particularly those growing their Umbraco capability, through pairing, review and structured mentorship.
* You show passion for keeping on top of current tools, standards and trends, including the Umbraco roadmap and AI-assisted engineering practice.
* You actively contribute ideas for the growth of the engineering team.
* You collaborate with principal engineers and the engineering leadership to deliver on departmental goals.
* You produce relevant content on software engineering and agile delivery to raise the profile of the department.
## About you
### **Professional knowledge and experience**
* **Deep Umbraco expertise.** Extensive hands-on experience building, extending and maintaining Umbraco platforms in production, including recent major versions. This is the defining requirement of the role.

### Description
MetalBear is **remote-first**, **early-stage, and product-led**. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.
The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.
That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

## **About Mistral**
Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
**About Mistral**
At Mistral AI, we believe in the power of AI to simplify tasks, save time, and enhance learning and creativity. Our technology is designed to integrate seamlessly into daily working life.
We democratize AI through high-performance, optimized, open-source and cutting-edge models, products and solutions. Our comprehensive AI platform is designed to meet enterprise needs, whether on-premises or in cloud environments. Our offerings include le Chat, the AI assistant for life and work.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society.
Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between France, USA, UK, Germany and Singapore. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
Join us to be part of a pioneering company shaping the future of AI. Together, we can make a meaningful impact. See more about our culture on https://mistral.ai/careers.
**Role Summary:**
As our Enterprise Sales Executive, you will be instrumental in shaping Mistral’s adoption with our largest customers across a variety of industries. You will be driving deals end2end: from prospective, first intro call until closing and beyond — together with our dedicated implementation specialist, tech and legal teams.
**What you will do:**
**Lead development (strategic outbound and qualified inbound):**
- Handle strategic outreach as well as warm introductions to promising enterprise customers
- Converting inbound deals where upselling / more bespoke agreements can be achieved
**Value prop validation for customer:**
- Provide hands-on support and guidance to clients during a potential Proof of Concept (POC) phase, ensuring a smooth and successful evaluation process
- Leverage successful POC outcomes to facilitate the conversion of POCs into long-term, revenue-generating contracts
**Deal management & closing:**
- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to convert leads into valued customers — you are the first point of contact for all external stakeholders and are responsible for properly managing deals and aligning all stakeholders (heavy involvement of customer engineering, product, and commercial teams, both on operational and C-level)
- Handle customer negotiation end2end, together with our legal and implementation specialist team
**Executive Engagement:**
- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, heads of innovation/AI, and other key decision-makers within target organisations
- Comprehend their specific challenges and needs, positioning our solution as an integral part of their strategic initiatives
**Technical Aptitude:**
- Demonstrate a deep understanding of the technical intricacies of our product and articulate its value proposition effectively to potential clients
- Work side-by-side with our implementation team to ensure that customer’s questions, concerns and challenges are taken care of during pre-sales, deployment and post-deployment phase
- Collaborate with our technical team to address any customer inquiries or concerns
**Training and enablement:**
-Empower internal teams with the knowledge and resources that you collect in customer conversations to drive product roadmap and align on priorities
**Who you are:**
- 7-10 years experience in Sales (enterprise sales/consultative selling, ideally selling a highly complex, technical product)
- Excellent academics: Bachelor and/or Master Degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field
- Significant work experience within AI ecosystem or related data/infrastructure field
- Experience at successful fast growing startup, ideally in deep-tech
- Strong technical skills to navigate quickly evolving products and steer technical discussions
- Excellent English & French, additional language welcome (e.g. German, Spanish, etc.)
- Outstanding negotiation and communication skills
**What We Offer:**
💰 Competitive cash salary and equity
🥕 Food : Daily lunch vouchers
🥎 Sport : Monthly contribution to a Gym pass subscription
🚴 Transportation : Monthly contribution to a mobility pass
🧑‍⚕ Health : Full health insurance for you and your family
🍼 Parental : Generous parental leave policy
🌎 Visa sponsorship

# IRL Coordinator

APPLY
IRL has become a fixture of every release campaign. Most of it is terrible.
A coffee shop takeover on release day: a queue, a photo wall, a hashtag. Fans aren't silly; they can tell when something exists just because there’s something to sell. We can all do better. Not with bigger budgets, but by starting from a different question: not "what can we activate," but "what do these fans actually want, and where do they already gather?" That means listening properly - the social listening that shapes our online communities should be shaping what happens in the room. It means the announcement, the RSVP, the room and the content afterwards are one continuous piece of work. It means thinking much bigger and in the long term. An effective fan engagement campaign goes far beyond the 6-inch screen of an iPhone. Fans live in real life, so we need to meet them there. Digital content should be an extension of the world you're building, but a story truly sticks once it becomes something people can actually step inside. IRL takes the fan communities we already run online and gives them a real place to gather - listening parties, release events, meet-ups, the occasional bit of absolute chaos. Same fans, same culture - just reaching out and going beyond the screen. Once fans are in the room together, content becomes memory, marketing becomes community, and music becomes shared identity. The event lasts a few hours; the stories travel much further. This role leads that work, sitting in our Fan Engagement team with the whole studio around you. **WHAT WILL I DO?** **Listen before you build.** Our community management and amplification teams live in fans' comment sections, Discords and group chats - you'll be alongside them, using their read and our social listening to work out what a fanbase does together, where they're clustered and what they'd genuinely turn up for. That's where every idea starts. **Shape ideas, then write them up.** We create collaboratively; ideas will land from all over the studio. You'll be in those sessions, then take the strongest thinking and turn it into a proposal: concept, format, timings, activities, content deliverables, budget and how we'll measure it, and present it. **Find the rooms that already exist.** Record shops, club nights, promoters, collectives, university societies, book clubs, run clubs, and so on and so on - you'll build that network out, keep the contact book live and share it around the studio, so we're pitching from real relationships. **Produce it, properly.** Recces, venue contracts, suppliers, quotes, licensing, risk assessments, run of show, call sheets, door and guest list, and being on site when things shift (they always do!). You'll direct our production team and partners through the build, with ops behind you on contracts, insurance and budget tracking. **Build the anticipation.** Announcement moments, launch assets, RSVP and ballot mechanics, waitlists, attendee comms. **Make it travel.** Working collaboratively with the team for shot lists, photographer and videographer briefs, live posting, and an amplification plan so the best moments are live before we’re even done for the night. **Feed it back.** Post-event reviews the whole team learns from: attendance, content performance, what fans shared unprompted, what fell flat, what we'd do differently. IRL is a discipline we're building here, and you'll have a big hand in shaping it. **WHO ARE YOU?** **A fan, first.** You understand why people queue for hours, travel across the country or post 20 stories from the same event. You know the best fan experiences aren't always the biggest - they're the ones that make people feel part of something. **A producer.** You genuinely enjoy making complicated things happen. Timelines, suppliers, venues and logistics don't overwhelm you - they're puzzles you like solving. **Social-first.** You instinctively think, "how will this live online?" while everyone else is still deciding where to put the bar. **Organised.** Events rarely go exactly to plan. You stay organised when everyone else is running around. **Collaborative.** You'll spend your week bouncing between strategists, creatives, producers, artists and clients. You enjoy making other people's ideas happen. **Curious.** The first event shouldn't look like the tenth. You're always looking for new formats, new technologies and better ways to surprise fans. **What’s in it for You?**
* **Salary:** £32,000 - 39,000K
* **Unlimited Annual Leave:** With tracking and support to ensure a minimum of 28 days per year.
* **Generous Pension Contributions:** 2:1 employer match on pension contributions.
* **Career Progression:** A clear path to grow with the company and develop your role over time.
* **Hybrid Working:** Two days in the office per week, based in East London, with the option to work remotely.
* **Overtime Pay:** Extra for the late nights, content shoots, weekend festivals.
* **Regular Event Invites:** Festivals, gigs, networking, the proper stuff.
* **Vibrant Work Culture:** A team that actually likes each other and takes the work (not themselves) seriously.
**Who Are We?** Something Something is the digital-native content strategy studio. We're a collective of social strategists and content producers who believe the voices we love deserve to be heard clearly amongst the noise. Working directly with music artists and cultural brands, we know what's happening online before it's even "happening", not because we study trends, but because we live them. We don't believe in artists working for trends; we believe in making trends work for them. And we measure success in worldbuilding and real fandom, not just like counts. **Now What?** Send an email to hello@somethingsomething.social with the subject "JOB APPLICATION: IRL Coordinator". We want to hear about the time you made something happen for a community you care about. A fan event. A meet-up. A community project. Something you organised, built or brought to life, whether it was brilliantly planned or held together by a group chat and sheer determination.
Tell us what you did, and what it taught you. Maybe it sharpened your eye for logistics, taught you how to bring people together, or made you think creatively when things inevitably went a bit sideways.

You’ll work closely with the Head of Financial Accounting and Control, providing expert technical accounting support across Group accounting activities and deputising when required. ## **Customer Success Manager –** **Scale Team**
**Location:** Bournemouth (Hybrid)
**Job Type:** Full Time 37.5 hours a week
## **Our Purpose: A Better Life for Everyone**
Nourish is not simply a technology company; we are a digital partner for the social and health care sector rooted in human connections, with the person being supported at its core. We offer a range of co produced software solutions tailored to the unique challenges of care, while still being flexible enough to meet the specific needs of each individual service we work with.
We are at an exciting stage of growth. While we are the market leader, we remain ambitious and dedicated to our mission. We continue to revolutionise the sector by investing in our platform and our incredible employees who make this impact possible.
## **Our Ecosystem**
At Nourish, you will contribute to a sophisticated ecosystem that includes:
• **Technology that impacts a million people every day:** Our core products are used by over 425,000 carers to support 417,000+ individuals
• **The Nourish Partnership Programme (NPP):** A sector leading programme that manages strategic integrations with third party systems to ensure seamless data syncing and interoperability across the care journey.
## **Our Culture & Values**
We look for people who align with the way we work. If you join us, you are joining a culture defined by:
• **Making a Difference:** We remember who we serve. We are passionate about making a meaningful, positive impact on the lives of carers and those we support
• **Agility:** We continuously refine and adapt. There is no room for complacency here; we are driven to constantly review and improve our products and processes.
• **Collective Effort:** We help each other out because we know that when one person wins, we all win. It's "all hands on deck", everyone is in it together.
• **Every Person Counts:** We treat everyone as a very significant part of our community. We welcome people being their true and authentic selves and value the diverse perspectives they bring.
• **Openness to Learning:** We believe no question is a silly question and all insights are valuable. Mistakes are part of the improvement process; we dust ourselves off and begin again.
## **The Team & Role**
As a Customer Success Manager at Nourish, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our customers achieve value from our solutions. You will care deeply about our relationships with customers, working collaboratively with them to understand and fulfil their needs. You will support a pooled portfolio of customers alongside a team of like minded people, delivering fast, high quality interactions that meet SLAs and drive exceptional customer satisfaction.
This role suits someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys working closely with peers in a shared workflow, and is always ready to jump in and support the team. As well as opportunities for renewals, you will identify growth opportunities, helping customers use Nourish in the best way possible and get real value from our solution. To do this, you will work cross functionally with different teams and stay data driven throughout.
## **Key Responsibilities**
• Manage customer requests from a pooled queue whilst meeting or exceeding SLAs for response, resolution and follow up
• Maintain a high standard of customer experience with every interaction
• Support customers in adopting products or services effectively to achieve their goals
• Gather customer insights and feedback to help drive product and process improvements
• Ensure that all customers receive the correct level of engagement with Nourish, based on their type of organisation
• Work closely with colleagues performing similar roles to ensure coverage, consistency and a seamless customer journey
• Embrace a team mindset, fostering a positive, supportive working environment, sharing knowledge and contributing to team initiatives
• Negotiate renewals and expanded use of our services, working with the Sales team as appropriate
• Contribute to improving both internal and customer facing processes with a view to improving customer experience
• Build your personal profile and domain knowledge within the sector
• Ensure complete and accurate recording of customer data in our CRM system
• Work cross functionally with sales, product and support teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience
## **Requirements**
**Experience:** 1 to 3 years in a customer facing role (Customer Success, Customer Support, Service Desk, Inside Sales/SDR) in a high volume environment, ideally for a fast growing business. Proven ability to meet SLAs and operate within structured queues, with experience using CRM or ticketing tools and basic data literacy, reading dashboards and spotting trends.
**Skills & Approach:** Strong multi channel communication (email, chat, phone/video) with clear written records in tickets and CRM notes. Demonstrable team collaboration, a proactive and collaborative mentality, and excellent time management with the ability to handle multiple accounts and assignments at once.
**Mindset:** A process mindset, able to design effective ways of working for the team. Comfortable with change and confident working in a fast paced setting. Remains curious, asks questions and seeks the best outcomes. Has the intellect to solve problems and find a way to achieve goals. A strong work ethic, always able to organise effectively, work within a team and take accountability for their own actions and results. A consultative approach, with excellent active listening skills, a humble style and a willingness to learn.
**Sector Interest:** A passion for how we care for people in society, whether from work experience or personal life. What matters is feeling connected to Nourish's goal of making care better. A quick learner, able to work effectively in a constantly evolving scale up environment, and willing and able to travel.

• **Annual Leave:** 25 days basic + Public Holidays + an extra day for your Birthday.
• **Service Related Leave:** 1 extra day for each completed year of service (up to 5 additional days).

Over the past five years, sand‐related deferrals have routinely exceeded 2 mboed net (~1.3 mmboe/yr) equivalent to ~$80MM/yr at $60/bbl. ## Description
We’re looking for a **Senior Agile Coach** to help our Technology, Product and Data squads become more effective as Our Future Health continues to grow.
This is an opportunity to work across multiple cross-functional squads, helping improve **how we build products, develop software, collaborate, make decisions and deliver value**.
Our Future Health is an ambitious collaboration between the public, charity and private sectors, designed to help people live healthier lives for longer through better prevention, earlier detection and improved treatment of diseases. We will speed up the discovery of new methods of early disease detection, and the evaluation of new diagnostic tools, to help identify and treat diseases early, when outcomes are usually better. With over 2.7M volunteers across the UK, we’re now the world’s biggest health research programme of its kind, and our volunteer group is also more diverse than other, similar health research programmes.
Technology and data are central to our mission. Our systems power websites, clinics across the UK, secure analytics and research environments, and pipelines processing highly sensitive health and genetic data. As we continue to grow, we want to **strengthen how our teams work together and build lasting capability** across our Technology, Product and Data organisation.
### **What you’ll be doing**
**This isn’t a traditional Agile transformation role.** We’re not looking for somebody to arrive with a framework or playbook and roll it out across the organisation.
Instead, you’ll work alongside squads and leaders to understand how teams operate today, identify opportunities for improvement and help make **practical, sustainable changes**.
You’ll work across a small number of squads at a time, spending enough time with each to make a meaningful difference before moving to where you can have the greatest impact next.
Depending on the situation, you’ll:
* **Coach, mentor and teach** squads, leaders and individuals.
* Help **improve cross-functional collaboration** between Product, Engineering, Data, Science and other disciplines.
* Help teams improve **flow**, reducing batch sizes, slicing work more effectively and shortening lead times.
* Support squads in becoming more **outcome-focused and self-organising**.
* Facilitate workshops, retrospectives and difficult conversations that help teams make progress.
* Use **qualitative and quantitative evidence** to identify improvement opportunities and understand whether changes are working.
* Improve interactions between squads and other teams, reducing friction and organisational bottlenecks.
* Develop training, tools and practical approaches that can help multiple teams improve.
* Support the formation of new squads and help improve onboarding across Technology, Product and Data.
A key part of the role is knowing **which approach to use when**. Sometimes that means coaching someone to work through a problem themselves. Sometimes it means teaching a new practice. And sometimes it means drawing on your own experience and saying, “Here’s what I’d recommend and why.”
Ultimately, success means **helping teams become more capable of improving without relying on you**.
## Requirements
You’ll bring **strong coaching skills alongside substantial practical experience of modern product and technology organisations.**
We’d particularly like to see:
* Experience helping **multiple cross-functional product, technology or data teams** become more effective.
* Experience working in **high-performing product and engineering environments**, giving you a strong sense of what good can look like.
* A broad understanding of modern **product development, software engineering and delivery practices**.
* Experience improving outcomes such as **flow, collaboration, quality, customer value or organisational capability**.
* The ability to coach and influence everyone from **individual contributors to senior leaders**.
* Confidence moving between **coaching, mentoring, teaching, facilitation and direct advice**.
* Experience using evidence and data to understand problems and measure whether improvements are making a difference.
* Strong judgement and pragmatism, knowing **when to adapt to organisational constraints and when they genuinely need challenging**.
* Comfortable operating in **regulated, governed, constrained or more traditional environments**.
You may have previously worked as an **Agile Coach, Product Coach, Engineering Coach or Agility Lead**, or developed this experience through another route such as Engineering, Product, Delivery or Engineering Management.
What matters most is that you bring **real-world experience, a strong point of view and the judgement to adapt your approach to the situation**.
We’re **not looking for someone focused on rolling out Agile frameworks, ceremonies or certifications**. Experience with approaches such as Scrum, Kanban, XP, DevOps or continuous delivery can all be useful, but we expect you to treat practices as tools rather than goals in themselves.
Similarly, experience with scaled Agile frameworks isn’t automatically a problem, but **we’re not looking for somebody who wants to introduce or advocate for a scaling framework such as SAFe**.
### Why join us?
You’ll be joining at an important point in the growth of our Technology, Product and Data organisation.
There is **significant scope to make an impact**, and you’ll have genuine autonomy to understand where the biggest opportunities are rather than being handed a predefined transformation roadmap.
You’ll also be working in an unusually interesting environment. Our squads bring together people from **technology, product, data, science and academic backgrounds**, all working towards the same mission but often bringing very different experiences and expectations about how teams should operate.
At the same time, we’re a **highly governed and security-conscious organisation handling sensitive health data**, so some of the constraints we work within exist for very good reasons.
We’re looking for somebody who finds that combination interesting, someone **pragmatic, curious and comfortable improving an organisation from where it is today**, rather than pursuing an idealised version of Agile.
**This is a long-term investment in continuous improvement, not a time-limited transformation programme**. The opportunity is to leave teams, leaders and the wider organisation stronger and more capable because you were here.
### **Hiring process**
We feel hiring should be transparent and give you a real sense for what Our Future Health is like. Here's what you can expect:
* **Initial chat with our Talent team (30 min)** to get to know each other, discuss the role and answer any questions you have.
* **1st interview with our Director of Technology Agility (30 min)** – an opportunity to learn more about each other and align on role expectations.
* **Role-based interview and coaching exercise (90 min)** – around 60 minutes discussing your experience and approach, followed by a 30 min practical mock coaching conversation based on a realistic scenario you could encounter in the role. We’ll explain the format beforehand, but you won’t need to prepare a presentation or specific solution in advance.
* **Final stage competency interview (60 min)** with a small cross-functional panel of your potential new colleagues. This will focus on how you collaborate, influence others, work through ambiguity and navigate challenges in real-world situations.
