## Accelerate Scientific Discovery with Oxford Instruments Andor; Imaris
At Oxford Instruments Andor, we are dedicated to enabling the world's greatest scientific breakthroughs. Our cutting-edge imaging, spectroscopy and microscopy technologies are helping researchers develop life-saving treatments, explore deeper into space and advance sustainable energy solutions.
As a global leader in high-performance light measurement technology, we combine expertise in sensors, electronics, optics and software to deliver industry-leading solutions to customers in over 55 countries worldwide.
Guided by our core values of **Inclusive, Innovative, Trusted and Purposeful**, we strive to create technologies that make a meaningful difference to science and society.
## The Opportunity
We are seeking a **Machine Learning Software Engineer** to join our Imaris software development team and help shape the future of intelligent image analysis within our world-class scientific products.
This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced engineer who is passionate about applying machine learning and computer vision techniques to solve complex real-world problems. You will act as the technical expert for machine learning within the Imaris team, researching, developing and deploying advanced ML solutions that directly enhance our image analysis, image processing, object detection and segmentation capabilities.
Working at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning and scientific imaging, you'll have the opportunity to tackle highly challenging problems involving large multidimensional datasets, cutting-edge algorithms and high-performance computing environments.
## ## **What You Will Be Doing**
### ### Machine Learning Innovation
* Research, develop and deploy advanced machine learning solutions for image analysis, image processing, object detection and segmentation.
* Evaluate technical challenges and determine the most effective ML approach, whether developing custom models or adapting state-of-the-art solutions.
* Explore emerging technologies and techniques to continuously improve product capabilities.
### ### Software Development
* Design, develop and maintain robust software solutions using modern software engineering practices.
* Integrate machine learning algorithms into high-performance desktop applications.
* Contribute to the wider C++ application architecture and codebase.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to development best practices.
### ### Performance & Optimisation
* Profile and optimise model execution for CPU and GPU acceleration.
* Ensure efficient processing of large-scale 3D and 4D imaging datasets.
* Develop scalable and maintainable solutions suitable for production environments.
### ### Technical Leadership
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring and support to other software engineers and test team members.
* Contribute to technical investigations and architectural decisions.
* Share knowledge and promote engineering excellence across the team.
### ### Collaboration
* Work closely with software engineers, scientists, product managers and domain experts.
* Support product development from concept through to deployment.
* Occasionally travel to other Oxford Instruments sites and customer locations when required.
## ## **What We're Looking For**
### #### Qualifications
* BSc / MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
#### #### Experience
* Experience in software engineering, machine learning development or advanced applied research.
* Proven experience delivering machine learning projects from concept through to production deployment.
* Strong software development background with object-oriented design principles.
* Experience researching, evaluating and implementing ML solutions for real-world business or scientific applications.
* Strong hands-on programming experience.
#### #### Technical Knowledge
* Deep understanding of machine learning theory, mathematics and image processing principles.
* Strong knowledge of modern deep learning architectures including CNNs, U-Net and related computer vision frameworks.
* Production-level experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Experience building, training, evaluating and deploying machine learning models.
* Strong understanding of Python scientific and machine learning ecosystems.
* Expertise in object-oriented software design and development.
* Ability to independently research and implement innovative solutions to complex technical challenges.
### ### Desirable
* Research experience or publications in Computer Vision, Biomedical Image Analysis or Deep Learning.
* Experience working with multidimensional image data, volumetric datasets or large-scale imaging systems.
* Experience deploying ML models into production environments.
* Knowledge of C++ software development.
* Familiarity with Git and Azure DevOps.
* Experience with cross-platform development (Windows and Mac).
* Exposure to cloud-based training workflows.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles.

* Enjoy solving complex technical challenges.
* Are naturally curious and passionate about innovation.
* Take ownership and accountability for delivering high-quality solutions.
* Enjoy collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
* Can translate research concepts into robust, production-ready software.
* Continuously seek opportunities to learn and improve.
* Are motivated by seeing your work contribute to meaningful scientific advancements.

# Hydrologist
**Powered by Water, Driven by Purpose**
At Pennon Group, we’re proud to serve communities while protecting the environment. Together with our subsidiaries, South West Water, Bristol Water, Bournemouth Water, SES Water, Pennon Water Services and Pennon Power, we’re leading the way in water and renewables.
We’re proud to be recognised as a leader in the UK water sector, working towards a greener future. Our goals? As well as lowering our carbon footprint, we’re working with partners to plant 300,000 trees, restore peatlands and supporting farmers and landowners to improve water quality and wildlife.
Whether you’re starting out or seeking a new challenge, our scale and ambition create opportunities for you to shape your own career.
Ready to make a splash? **Join our team today.**
## Role Purpose
The Hydrologist is responsible for providing specialist hydrological expertise to support water resource management, environmental compliance, and strategic planning activities across the organisation's operating regions. The role leads hydrological assessments and investigations that underpin key statutory programmes, including the Water Industry National Environment Programme (WINEP), Water Resource Management Plans (WRMP), and Drought Plans.
Acting as the organisation's expert client for hydrology, the postholder will analyse, interpret and communicate hydrological data and modelling outputs to assess environmental impacts, support water resource decision-making, and ensure compliance with environmental regulations and licence requirements. The role supports operations across Bournemouth Water, Bristol Water, South West Water (including the Isles of Scilly), and SES Water.
## Key Responsibilities
### Hydrological Leadership & Expertise
* Provide technical hydrological leadership and advice for key statutory programmes including WINEP, WRMP and Drought Plan development.
* Act as the subject matter expert for hydrology and hydrometry across water resources activities.
* Support environmental and water resource planning decisions through robust hydrological analysis and interpretation.
* Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, abstraction licences, permits and industry best practice.
### Hydrological Assessment & Analysis
* Undertake hydrological assessments associated with new and varied abstraction licence applications.
* Analyse the impacts of licence conditions, hands-off flows and abstraction regimes on water availability and environmental outcomes.
* Support drought permit applications and strategic drought planning activities.
* Deliver naturalised and de-naturalised flow assessments to support hydro-ecological modelling and environmental investigations.
* Undertake flow assessments to support fisheries and ecological studies.
* Support operational abstraction compliance monitoring and reporting.
### Data Management & Modelling
* Manage, maintain and improve naturalised flow models and associated analytical tools.
* Analyse and interpret hydrometric and environmental datasets to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Apply rainfall-runoff methodologies and hydrological modelling tools to support water resource assessments.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations to support operational and strategic decision-making.
### Hydrometry & Monitoring
* Support the design and delivery of hydrometric monitoring programmes and solutions.
* Review and develop stage-discharge rating curves where required.
* Assess flow measurement techniques, hydrological monitoring systems and data quality standards.
* Ensure monitoring activities provide robust evidence for regulatory and operational purposes.
### Stakeholder & Consultancy Management
* Build effective working relationships with regulators, including Environment Agency hydrology teams.
* Discuss modelling methodologies, hydrological assessments and monitoring approaches with external stakeholders.
* Specify, manage and review work undertaken by external hydrological consultants.
* Prepare scopes of work and evaluate consultant proposals and tenders.
## Person Specification
### Essential Knowledge & Experience
* Strong understanding of catchment hydrology and water resources management.
* Experience undertaking hydrological assessments, analysis and technical reviews.
* Experience analysing and interpreting hydrometric datasets.
* Ability to produce high-quality technical reports and present complex information clearly.
* Experience supporting low flow studies, drought assessments and water resource investigations.
### Technical Skills
* Hydrological assessment and catchment analysis.
* Hydrometric monitoring and flow measurement.
* Stage-discharge rating curve development and review.
* Rainfall-runoff modelling and hydrological forecasting.
* Technical report writing and stakeholder communication.
* Data analysis and interpretation.
* Project management and prioritisation.
* Analytical problem solving.
### Desirable Experience
* Use of hydrological modelling packages such as GR6J and Qube.
* Programming and analytical tool development using R or Python.
* Experience with GIS software and spatial analysis.
* Knowledge of groundwater-dominated catchments and regional hydrological characteristics.
* Experience working within the water industry environment.
* Hydrometric knowledge, including flow measurement techniques and monitoring infrastructure.
## Qualifications
### Essential
* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, Earth Sciences, Physical Geography or another relevant analytical discipline.
* Full UK Driving Licence.
### Desirable
* Master's Degree in a relevant subject.
* Minimum five years' experience delivering hydrological studies and catchment assessments.
* Professional membership of CIWEM or equivalent professional body.
* Chartered status or actively working towards chartership.

**About Us** Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem. Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more.
## **About the Role**
This is a rare opportunity to build a truly strategic Deal Desk function at Perk — one that shapes how our Sales organisation structures, prices, and closes its most complex, high-value deals. We're investing in this transformation now, and we want a leader who can turn that ambition into reality.
We're hiring a Senior Deal Desk Manager to lead this shift. You'll take ownership of the Deal Desk team and its transformation, personally running point on our most complex and strategic deals while building a team that operates as trusted commercial partners to Sales, Finance, and Legal. A major part of the role will be modernising how the team works: automating manual processes through AI and automation, and improving our CPQ and quoting systems so Sales can move faster with confidence.
This is a coach-player role: you'll lead and develop a team while staying hands-on with the deals that matter most.
## **What You'll Do**
**Lead the transformation**
* Rebuild Deal Desk's operating model so the team spends its time on complex deal structuring and pricing strategy for high-value opportunities, not manual admin like company setup or payment profile processing — and put in place the triage, tools, and ways of working that make that shift stick.
* Decide what Deal Desk should own, support, automate, or hand off to other teams, and build the case for change with Legal, Finance, and Sales Operations leadership.
* Agree clear ownership and service levels for work that moves to other teams (for example, NDAs, supplier and financial forms, payment term changes, and downgrade/churn processing), so handovers actually stick.
* Build performance metrics and reporting to track deal velocity, team output, and the impact of process and automation improvements over time.
* Represent Deal Desk as a trusted, credible partner in cross-functional forums and with Sales leadership.
**Lead the team and run point on complex deals**
* Build, lead, and develop a team of Deal Desk professionals, setting clear goals and performance standards as the team matures into a more strategic function.
* Act as a coach-player: personally run point on Perk's most complex, highest-value deals, modelling the standard of deal structuring, negotiation support, and stakeholder management expected of the team.
* Own pricing governance and deal structuring for complex, non-standard commercial deals, balancing commercial risk with deal velocity.
* Mentor the team on complex deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial risk judgement, and coach them through escalations.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product to unblock deals and resolve cross-functional friction quickly.
**Own our systems and quoting experience**
* Own the relationship with our CPQ platform end to end, bringing prior experience owning a complex CPQ implementation elsewhere.
* Identify and drive improvements to CPQ configuration, pricing logic, and quoting workflows so Sales can quote and close faster with confidence.
* Act as the primary Deal Desk voice in Revenue Systems and CPQ/CLM tooling roadmap decisions.
**Drive automation and AI**
* Own the automation roadmap for Deal Desk, with a clear mandate to remove manual, repetitive work from the team through AI and automation.
* Prioritise and deliver automation of the highest-impact manual workflows first, such as company and payment profile setup and post-signature subscription provisioning, which today account for a significant share of the team's ticket volume.
* Partner with engineering/systems teams to scope, sequence, and deliver automation initiatives, and track the time saved and volume shifted off manual processing.
* Evaluate and pilot AI tools for use cases such as contract redline review, NDA triage, and deal risk flagging, working closely with Legal.
**Protect the business**
* Act as Deal Desk's first line of defense on contract redlines and non-standard deal terms, escalating to Legal or Finance where needed.
* Own commercial governance frameworks, pricing and discounting policy, and approval structures across the function.
* Safeguard deal commercials, business risk, and revenue recognition implications on complex and non-standard deals.
## **What We're Looking For**
* Strong Deal Desk experience within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning mid-market and enterprise segments.
* Proven experience leading a Deal Desk (or equivalent commercial/sales operations) team, with direct people management responsibility.
* A genuine coach-player: comfortable personally running complex, high-value deals while simultaneously leading and developing a team.
* Prior ownership of a complex CPQ platform, with a track record of driving measurable improvements to quoting, pricing, and deal velocity for Sales.
* Experience scoping and delivering automation and/or AI initiatives that reduce manual operational work, ideally in partnership with engineering or systems teams.
* Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills, comfortable partnering across Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment where processes are still being defined and improved.
## **What We Offer**
* Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.
* Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.
* Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex.
* Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva.
* Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.
* Rest assured that you're covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence.
* Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus.
* Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.
* Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.
* Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks' paid parental leave.
* Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.
* Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.
* Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards.
* Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years.
* Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.
## **AI at Perk**
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.
We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.
We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.
**How We Work**
At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.
For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.
Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.
**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. ## About the role
This is a hands-on, multidisciplinary role suited to a strong product designer with varied experience across performance apparel and accessories. The ideal candidate will combine creative vision and passion with strong technical understanding.
Working within a small and collaborative team, the role requires someone who is proactive, resourceful, organised and able to take ownership of products from concept to production. This is not a concept-only design role.
We are particularly interested in applicants from performance-driven sectors, including:
* Activewear
* Outdoor apparel
* Motorcycle apparel
* Cycling
* Workwear / PPE
* Technical product development studios
This role will involve working across garments, gloves and accessories.
## Key responsibilities
* Collaborate closely with the Design Director, pattern makers, and production team to design and develop new products from initial concept through to production and market launch.
* Manage multiple technical development projects simultaneously across apparel and accessories categories.
* Research and develop new concepts, performance materials, trims, technologies and finishes appropriate to each product category bringing fresh and innovative ideas to the table.
* Create detailed technical drawings, specifications, and technical files for product development and factory communication, ensuring these are kept up to date throughout development.
* Design with consideration for target price, manufacturing feasibility and commercial requirements, while maintaining the intended design and performance objectives.
* Strong knowledge of performance fabrics, materials, trims and their applications, with the ability to select appropriate solutions according to function, performance and intended use.
* Work directly with suppliers and factories through development.
* Maintain clear communication with overseas factories via meetings, email, Teams, and telephone.
* Review samples critically throughout development and actively participate in fittings, assessing design, construction, fit, functionality and finish, and communicate clear and technically informed amendments to factories.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of relevant CE and safety standards, ensuring products are designed and developed with compliance, protection and intended use in mind.
* Work alongside development partners to support technically compliant product development.
* Present concepts and developments clearly to the wider team while responding constructively to feedback.
* Attend regular design, development, and production meetings.
* Maintain organised archives of samples, trims, fabrics, accessories, and development materials.
## Skills and experience required

job_description:
About Reap
Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.
Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.
Backed by leading investors including Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.
Why This Role?
Teams at Reap are already reshaping how their work gets done — agents running alongside operations, non-technical teams building their own tools in days, engineering shipping fast enough that the constraints have moved elsewhere entirely.
That's happening now, in pockets, without a platform underneath it. Your job is to build the one that brings everybody along for the ride — and to set the bar for what "using AI at work" means here. The days of pasting an email into ChatGPT are over. We're rebuilding how the work itself happens.
We are standing up a dedicated team to build the capabilities and tooling that let every team at Reap — technical and non-technical alike — fundamentally change how they work. The goal is a company where reaching for an agent is the default way anyone solves a problem, not the exception someone is proud of. Access to the data and services they need. The primitives to build on. The path from a workflow someone hacked together to a system that runs itself.
We are not a team that builds agents for everyone. We build the rails and the templates; the org builds on them. That distinction is the whole strategy. The measure of this role isn't how many agents you shipped — it's how many people at Reap are doing meaningfully different work than they were a quarter ago.
This is a top-10 company priority with executive sponsorship and an explicit mandate to drive standards across the organisation.
Who we're looking for
We want someone genuinely obsessed with this.
Not someone who has read about agents. Someone who has already rebuilt how they personally work around them — who runs their own harness, writes their own tools, has opinions about context management and eval design, and gets visibly restless watching a human do something an agent should be doing.
You should be energised by the fact that the ceiling keeps moving. The rulebook here gets rewritten every six months, and most of what we build this half will be obsolete by the next. The right person finds that exciting rather than exhausting, and is already watching for what's landing next so we can move on it early.
Your Mission Awaits
Find the leverage. Go deep into how Reap's teams actually operate and identify where agentic capability changes what the customer actually experiences — how fast they get onboarded, answered, unblocked, paid. Internal platform, customer outcomes. Rank ruthlessly on that basis.
Build the self-serve motion. Personal agent setups, tuned connectors, a curated skills library, working templates, a clear path to get started. Give people the capability and get out of the way.
And own the end-to-end flows. Self-serve unlocks breadth; the deepest impact comes from taking whole processes apart and rebuilding them around what agents can now do — not automating steps inside a process designed for humans. Pick the flows where that's worth the effort and drive them all the way through.
Take workflows to always-on. Prove the pattern end-to-end: a live, 24/7 operational system that acts unattended where it should and routes the rest to a human, with evals behind it. Then design the graduation ladder so the next one follows faster.
Design for speed. Data access, permissioning and auditability are our responsibility to get right — we operate on a regulated balance sheet and we take that seriously. But you treat them as design problems in service of velocity, not gates bolted on at the end. Built well, they're what lets people move fast on real data instead of waiting for approval. Built badly, they're the reason nobody uses the platform. That's your call to make, with Security and Data Governance alongside you.
Partner with engineering in tight step. This is one team building one set of foundations. The internal-tooling side and the developer-experience side are the same job, and you'll work shoulder to shoulder with engineering on both.
Make the value undeniable. Workflows live, functions covered, idea→live time, hours returned — measured on quality, not just cost. Unmeasured impact gets discounted.
Say no. Teams will ask faster than we can serve. Take on work only where it builds a reusable capability, and hold that line from day one.
Evangelise relentlessly. A platform nobody adopts is a hobby. Training, demos, office hours, internal comms — the enablement motion is your job as much as the product is.
What Makes You a Star
You have built and shipped production agentic systems — not prototypes, not evaluations. You can talk about where they failed, what you measured, and how you fixed them.
You are fluent in the stack as it is, and tracking where it's going. MCP, tool and context design, retrieval, orchestration, eval harnesses, observability. Equally: you know what's changing, you have views on what the next capability jump unlocks, and you're the kind of person who has already tried it.
You have driven change through an organisation, not just a backlog. Getting a workflow adopted by a team that didn't ask for it is harder than building it. Show us you've done that.
You think in systems and first principles. You start from what the work actually requires, not from what the current process looks like.
You have strong product fundamentals. Sharp prioritisation, clear writing, comfort operating with ambiguity and a small, fast-moving team.
You can design inside constraints rather than resent them. Experience in regulated, document-heavy or risk-sensitive domains, where accuracy, traceability and reliability are non-negotiable, is a significant advantage.
Why You'll Love it Here
A high-impact role in a rapidly growing fintech startup
Flexible hybrid/remote work environment with a global, collaborative team
Insurance coverage after probation
Reap Card stipend
Use of AI tools at work — and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them
A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning

**Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era.** Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen
**Relay’s Mission is** to **free commerce from friction**. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where **more goods move more freely between more people**, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.
**THE TEAM**• **~110 people**, more than **half** in engineering, product and data • **45+ advanced degrees** across computer science, mathematics and operations research • **Thousands** of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of **first‐principles thinking**, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation
## **The Opportunity**
**Nobody has solved quality in delivery.** The industry treats lost and undelivered parcels the way it treats weather: absorbed, apologised for, credited back. Retailers have learned to expect it. Carriers report on-time rates and go quiet on everything else, because when a parcel goes missing between a van and a sorting centre, nobody can say exactly where it happened or who should fix it.
We've spent the last year building the systems and infrastructure to make that answerable: capturing what actually happens at every handover and attributing loss to a specific point in the journey, with one team accountable for it. Thousands of data points per parcel give us a foundation most of this industry simply doesn't have.
That turns delivery quality from a reporting exercise into a modelling problem, and creates a rare **applied AI** opportunity in a huge physical industry. We treat every failed delivery as another signal: something to understand, model and feed back into a learning loop. We run ML and LLM inference daily, with the data density and engineering depth to go after the problem properly.
**This role is where those models meet the customer, and where insight becomes action.**
Get this right and the relationship changes. Instead of explaining a miss after the fact, you're showing a client where their parcels are being lost, what we're doing to fix it and what we expect that intervention to be worth, before they've had to ask. They can plan around us. They stop chasing and start relying on us to tell them first. That's what turns a supplier into a strategic partner.
You'll own two pictures and the connection between them: internally, a single view of what the network is doing to improve quality and in what order; externally, the performance story each strategic account sees. Today those views live in different places. Your job is to join them.
You'll lead a small team, with data, engineering, product and our operational pillars around you. You won't be building the underlying capture and attribution systems. Our engineering and data teams own that, and you inherit them. Which means you start from numbers you can trust, and can focus on the harder question: **what should we do about them?**
## **What You’ll Do**
* **Own delivery quality end to end for our strategic accounts:** know where performance is breaking, what we’re fixing, in what order, and what each intervention is worth.
* **Work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, product designers, and data scientists,** close enough to the modelling to understand what an output can and can’t support, and turn technical capability into decisions clients can act on.
* **Partner hand in hand with our Account Managers on client performance.** You’ll be their key counterpart on the performance of our strategic accounts: bringing the numbers, diagnosis, priorities, and plan, while working together to turn that into a joined-up experience for the client.
* **Build a compelling performance story that starts with the client’s needs.** Connect what we’re seeing in the data, what Relay is building, and what is changing operationally into a clear narrative about the outcomes that matter to the client and what we should do next.
* **Turn roadmaps into measurable impact.** Move us from “ships in March” to “ships in March, should move your rate by roughly this much, and here’s how we’ll know.”
* **Set the standard for connecting what the network builds to the loss it reduces,** and drive adoption across teams that don’t report to you.
* **Build and lead a small team,** raising the bar for how Relay manages client performance and growing the function as the remit expands.
* **Report to the CEO,** with a direct line to the exec team on how we’re performing for our biggest clients.
## **Who Will Thrive in This Role?**
* **You've owned an outcome that mattered for more than a year**, not just made the recommendation, handed it over and moved on
* **You turn ambiguous problems into a clear agenda.** You can work out what matters, what needs to happen first and which questions actually change the decision
* **You know how to work with account managers, engineers and data scientists**, because you can translate a business problem into something they'll actually build
* **You get things done through teams that don't report to you**, using clarity, judgement and influence rather than escalation
* **You're highly analytical and comfortable in the weeds.** You can sit with the data, spot where a story is weak, challenge what you're being told and know what a model's output can and can't support
* **You can judge work in a craft you don't own.** Your analyst says a fix moves the number by a third and you're not sure. You know the questions to ask
* **You're genuinely client-facing.** You're comfortable in the room with a demanding senior client, holding your own on numbers you didn't personally produce and owning the answer when things don't go to plan
* **You sequence complex work well.** Several dependencies, one client commitment: you know what ships first, what ships imperfectly and what gets cut
* **You think in portfolios, not accounts**, and are comfortable making differentiated calls about where attention and resources should go
* Experience in logistics, delivery or another complex operational environment is a plus, but the ability to learn a domain quickly, reason from first principles and hold your own with subject-matter experts matters more
One honest note, because we'd rather you self-select than find out in month four: this role has no end date on its metrics. You'll live with the same numbers, watch a plan you committed to slip, and revise that commitment in front of the client. You'll make presentations that matter, but success isn't the quality of the recommendation. **It's whether the numbers move, and whether you build a system that keeps moving them.** If in twelve months the picture is still being rebuilt by hand each quarter, the role hasn't worked.

# Senior Strategist, Data & AI (Remote - US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, India or Rwanda)
United States, United Kingdom, Nigeria, Ethiopia, India or Rwanda
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.
**Position Purpose:**
The **Senior Strategist, Data & AI** strengthens the capacity of RTSL and its government partners to use data, digital systems, and artificial intelligence to improve public health programs and decision-making. Working across RTSL's program portfolio, the role brings together public health strategy, data architecture, digital transformation, and AI governance to identify high-value opportunities and help translate them into practical, sustainable approaches.
The Senior Strategist advises program and country teams on data architecture, interoperability, data governance, and AI readiness; shapes and prioritizes data- and AI-enabled initiatives; and builds RTSL's capacity to use emerging technologies responsibly and effectively. Externally, the role works with governments, technical partners, and the broader global health ecosystem to advance country-owned approaches to stronger data systems and responsible AI.
Success in the role means that RTSL and its partners are making better-informed decisions about where and how to invest in data and AI, with stronger underlying data systems, clearer standards and safeguards, and practical applications that deliver measurable public health value.
**Core Duties and Responsibilities:**
***Data Strategy and Architecture***
* Advise RTSL program and country teams and government partners on strengthening the data foundations needed for effective public health programs, including data architecture, quality, interoperability, metadata, governance, accessibility, and appropriate data use.
* Ensure teams understand how data flows across systems and identify fragmentation, duplication, quality issues, and other barriers to effective program management and decision-making.
* Support governments and partners in developing practical, sustainable approaches to data architecture and interoperability that strengthen existing systems and promote country ownership.
* Translate public health and program needs into clear data requirements and help bridge communication among public health, epidemiology, product, data, and technology teams.
* Ensure high standards for data quality, usability, interoperability, governance, privacy, and sustainability in collaboration with IT, Legal, and relevant technical teams.
* Track developments in health information architecture, interoperability standards, digital public goods, analytics, and related fields and assess their implications for RTSL's programs and country partnerships.
***Applied AI, Innovation, and Responsible Use***
* Shape RTSL's approach to the responsible programmatic use of AI and advanced analytics, ensuring that investments are driven by public health problems and measurable value rather than technology alone.
* Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities where AI could improve planning, implementation, clinical or public health decision support, analysis, monitoring, or learning -- in close collaboration with program, country, and digital teams.
* Guide structured assessment of proposed AI use cases, considering the problem to be solved, user and workflow needs, data readiness, feasibility, public health value, equity, privacy, safety, sustainability, and country context.
* Advise teams on whether to build, buy, adapt, or partner for data- and AI-enabled solutions, emphasizing reuse, interoperability, sustainability, and fit for purpose.
* Partner with organizational leadership, IT, and Legal to translate RTSL's AI policies and principles into practical guidance and appropriate review processes for programmatic applications.
* Promote responsible AI practices, including appropriate human oversight, transparency, accountability, privacy, equity, and mechanisms for identifying and responding to risks.
* Lead responsible experimentation and learning, helping RTSL distinguish promising innovations from approaches that are not sufficiently useful, feasible, or sustainable to pursue.
***Program Advisory and Organizational Capability***
* Serve as a senior resource to RTSL's program and country teams, helping them integrate data and AI considerations into program design, implementation, monitoring, and scale.
* Develop practical frameworks, decision aids, guidance, and tools that enable teams to assess data and AI opportunities consistently and rigorously.
* Build organizational capability in AI and advanced tools through training, coaching, communities of practice, and practical learning opportunities.
* Help teams develop sufficient AI and data literacy to engage effectively with technical experts, vendors, government counterparts, and partners and make informed decisions.
* Provide strategic input to digital product and innovation initiatives where broader questions of data architecture, interoperability, AI, or cross-program applicability are relevant, while leaving product ownership and delivery with the responsible technology teams.
* Capture and share learning from data, digital, and AI initiatives across programs and countries, ensuring that evidence, successes, and failures inform future strategy, investment, and implementation.
***External Advisory, Partnerships, and Cross-Functional Collaboration***
* Advise government and public health partners on data architecture, interoperability, governance, organizational readiness, and responsible AI adoption in primary health care, epidemic preparedness, and other areas relevant to RTSL's mission.
* Build relationships with organizations shaping global health data standards, digital public goods, responsible AI, and related technical approaches.
* Represent RTSL in relevant technical forums and partnerships with governments, funders, multilaterals, academic institutions, technology partners, and peer organizations.
* Bring external developments and country experience back into RTSL to inform organizational strategy and program design.
* Work closely with the VP, IT to align programmatic data and AI needs with enterprise technology, cybersecurity, data protection, and infrastructure requirements.
* Collaborate with Legal and Shared Services on governance, procurement, compliance, contracting, budgeting, and risk management associated with data and AI initiatives.
* Partner with Development and Communications to support proposals, donor engagement, external communications, and clear articulation of RTSL's approach and learning in public health data and AI.
**Qualifications:**
***Experience***
* At least 12 years of progressively responsible experience spanning data, digital health, health information systems, analytics, applied AI, or related areas.
* Experience working in global public health and with Ministries of Health, national public health institutes, or other government health institutions, preferably across multiple countries.
* Demonstrated experience working on data architecture and systems, including areas such as interoperability, data standards, metadata, governance, information flows, or data quality.
* Experience translating complex public health problems into practical data, digital, analytics, or AI approaches.
* Demonstrated experience operating at the intersection of strategy and implementation and working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience assessing digital or AI initiatives for feasibility, value, risk, sustainability, and organizational readiness.
* Experience working with digital products, health information systems, digital public goods, technology vendors, or implementation partners.
* Experience building organizational capability or supporting adoption of new technologies and ways of working.
* Experience advising senior government, organizational, or partner stakeholders is strongly preferred.
***Skills & abilities***
* Strong public health and systems thinking, with the ability to understand how technology, data, people, workflows, institutions, and policy interact to affect program outcomes.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, interoperability, data governance, data quality, and the foundations required for effective analytics and AI.
* Strong working knowledge of responsible AI principles, including privacy, equity, transparency, safety, human oversight, and accountability.
* Enough technical fluency to engage credibly with data scientists, engineers, architects, and vendors while translating technical issues for public health and organizational leaders.
* Strong analytical and strategic judgment, including the ability to distinguish promising opportunities from technology-driven solutions without sufficient public health value.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify underlying needs, and translate them into practical recommendations and next steps.
* Excellent facilitation, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work across organizational boundaries and build alignment without direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex data and technology concepts clearly to government officials, program leaders, donors, and non-technical audiences.
* Strong cultural awareness and ability to work effectively with partners in diverse and resource-constrained settings.
* Pragmatic, curious, collaborative, and comfortable working in areas where technology and evidence are evolving rapidly.
***Education***
* Master's degree or equivalent advanced training in public health, health informatics, digital health, data science, epidemiology, health policy, computer science, information systems, or a related field.
***Other***
* Ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally for country engagement, technical consultations, and organizational meetings as needed.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in primary health care, cardiovascular health, epidemic preparedness, surveillance, or health systems strengthening.
* Familiarity with relevant health data and interoperability approaches such as FHIR/HL7, WHO SMART Guidelines and Digital Adaptation Kits, DHIS2, OpenMRS/OpenHIE, and digital public goods.
* Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to real-world public health or health system problems.
* Experience working in multilingual and resource-constrained implementation environments.
* Proficiency in languages in addition to English.
**Compensation and Benefits:**
Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success.
The starting salary range for this position in the US is $165,000 to $195,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.
In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including:
* Health insurance for you and your dependents
* Contributions toward retirement
* Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays
* Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year
* Professional development and home office setup benefits
* Up-to-date computer equipment
RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

# Content Support Executive
## Creating incredible automotive customer experiences by unifying people, technology and marketing.
# Content Support Executive
Great tech products need great content behind them.
**CODIFI is the technology division of ROI Automotive, a business supporting around 70% of the UK’s automotive brands. We build technology that helps automotive businesses connect, communicate and work more effectively.** We’re looking for a **Content Support Executive** to help make sure the content within our Gateway platforms is accurate, engaging, useful and built around what users actually need.
But this is much more than uploading content.
Sitting at the intersection of **content, digital, customer success and user experience**, you’ll help manage content from initial idea through to publication, performance and continuous improvement. You’ll use insight, engagement data and your own curiosity to spot opportunities, challenge what could be better and help make our digital products more valuable for the people using them.
### What you’ll be doing
Working across Fleet Gateway, Leasing Portal, Retailer Gateway and Affinity Gateway, you’ll collaborate with our Customer Success Account Managers, clients and wider CODIFI team to understand what users need and turn that into effective digital content.
You’ll:
* **Help manage content** across our Gateway platforms, making sure it stays accurate, relevant, well structured and up to date throughout its lifecycle.
* **Plan ahead**, helping to build forward content plans around client priorities, campaigns, launches and other key activity.
* **Spot the gaps.** You’ll proactively identify opportunities for new or improved content by understanding user needs, researching client activity and keeping an eye on relevant external sources.
* **Create and adapt communications, content and imagery**, including product information, news, bulletins, aftersales information and campaign content.
* **Work directly with clients**, particularly Fleet Marketing and Sales teams, to understand their objectives and translate them into content that works for their users.
* **Use data and insight** to understand what people are engaging with, identify trends and recommend changes to content, positioning and promotion.
* **Bring insight to client conversations**, providing Customer Success Account Managers with content performance, recommendations and opportunities for client reviews and presentations.
* **Support launches and change**, coordinating content for new clients, brands, functionality, campaigns and platform improvements.
* **Keep quality high**, applying consistent standards around accuracy, formatting, naming, categorisation, tagging and content governance.
* **Make the way we work better**, identifying opportunities to simplify and standardise processes and exploring how digital and AI tools can improve content creation, quality and efficiency.
* Contribute to wider **CODIFI marketing and communications activity** where appropriate, including campaign execution and content development.
### What we’re looking for
You’ll combine creativity with organisation. You’ll care about how something reads and looks, but you’ll be just as interested in whether it’s useful, whether people are engaging with it and how it could work better.
You’ll bring:
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to create clear, engaging, audience-focused content.
* Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to managing information.
* Great organisation, with the ability to manage different clients, platforms and priorities.
* Confidence using digital platforms and the ability to get to grips with new tools and processes quickly.
* A proactive mindset – you’ll look for opportunities and improvements rather than waiting for the next task to be assigned.
* Confidence working with clients and internal stakeholders to source information, understand objectives and get things moving.
* An interest in user behaviour and the ability to use engagement data to identify trends and make recommendations.
* Good judgement and the ability to understand what different audiences will find relevant and valuable.
* The confidence to constructively challenge existing content or ways of working when you can see a better approach.
* The ability to work independently, take ownership and see things through from idea to completion.
Experience in **content, marketing, digital communications or a similar environment** would be useful. Automotive, fleet or leasing experience is a bonus, but it isn’t essential – we’re much more interested in your ability to understand an audience, develop effective content and make digital experiences better.
### Why CODIFI?
CODIFI is the technology division of ROI Automotive. We create digital products that solve real problems for automotive businesses – and we’re always looking for smarter ways to do it.
That means challenging what already exists, using insight to make things better, embracing new technology and giving people the space to take ownership of their work.
If you’re naturally curious, organised, good with words and the sort of person who spots something that could be better and wants to fix it, **we’d love to hear from you.**

As a Stock Operative, you will ensure that stock is accounted for in the loading bay and store, allowing the sales team to provide an efficient service to our customers. You will manage the intake and distribution of deliveries and keep paperwork up-to-date, using your initiative to sort out any problems. Working effectively with colleagues to ensure deliveries are received within the correct time frame and unloaded and processed efficiently. This can often be a busy role, where the ability to problem solve and maintain high standards of housekeeping is important, and we’ll expect you to follow safety and security practices at all times.
As a Stock Operative you will:
* Support with organising and prioritising deliveries to ensure these are received and processed on time and delivered to the correct departments in store
* Collaborate with B&M on RTW/RTVs. Supporting the sales team in collecting stock and preparing items to be dispatched, ensuring all items are processed and accounted for
* Keep all records up to date to ensure any stock movements are accounted for
* Maintain a clear loading dock, ensuring all back of house areas and fire exits are kept clear
* Manage the movement of stock between various locations
* Supporting in peak periods with the effective operation of forklift and other machinery
* Regularly communicate with stakeholders to ensure all functions are aware of incoming deliveries and any issues such as delays or deliveries that were not received
* Distribute deliveries to the correct designated areas
### A Bit About You
* Well organised. You are able to prioritise your workload and understand the importance your role plays in our service proposition, dealing with multiple requests at any given time whilst ensuring all stock is accounted for
* A great communicator. You will work keep your stakeholders informed on workflow and timescales, pre-empting any issues and suggesting solutions
* Collaborative. You will work closely with multiple teams to ensure the safe guarding of stock, prevent loss and ensure product is accounted for at all times and in a sellable condition while being processed through the store
* Adaptable. Ability to work both independently as well as collaborate. You understand the need to shift working priorities due to competing deadlines and changing priorities
* A solutions focused individual with the ability to review ways of working and suggest improvements
* Able to lift and move stock safely and securely
* An example of our values, a trusted and respected colleague

As a Sales Associate, you are an essential part of a team that creates the extraordinary experiences our customers expect from Selfridges.

* Knowledge of customer service principles and practices
* Good working knowledge and understanding of computer systems specifically MS Office suite software
* Previous experience in reception or concierge service essential
* Luxury retail knowledge advantageous
* Experienced in dealing with multiple stakeholder levels from team members to senior leaders
* Highly organised
* Personable and friendly
* Great verbal communication
* Easily able to multi-task and prioritise
* Ability to successfully handle pressure
* Customer focused

More than 16,000 healthcare professionals across 80+ specialties rely on Semble every day to manage scheduling, electronic health records, billing and patient experience through one connected platform. Head of Customer Success
Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Are you excited by the opportunity to build one of the most commercially impactful Customer Success organisations in HealthTech?
At Semble, we're looking for a customer-obsessed, commercially minded leader who can take an already strong Customer Success function to the next level. This is far more than a traditional Customer Success leadership role - you'll own the strategy for customer retention, renewals, expansion and long-term customer value across our growing customer base.
You'll have the autonomy to shape how Customer Success operates, influence product direction through customer insight, embrace AI to scale customer engagement, and work alongside senior leaders to make Customer Success a key driver of company growth. Semble works with 1800+ customers, across multiple regions and of all sizes; SMB, Mid-Market and Enterprise.
If you're motivated by building high-performing teams, solving complex customer challenges and delivering measurable commercial impact, this is a rare opportunity to help shape the future of healthcare while leaving your mark on one of Europe's most ambitious HealthTech companies.
At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.
We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:
* Impact - We do work that matters.
* Collaboration – We are in it together.
* Human touch – We care deeply.
We are also quick to embrace new technologies: we have rapidly adopted AI internally, and we are always looking to work with people who are excited to augment their work with AI.
This role is hands on and requires experience of working at both ends of the market, while building a scaled CS function. It's a hybrid role based in the UK, with team attending the office twice a week. There's occasional travel to our Paris office. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside of this location and time zone at this stage.
What you will be doing
* Own the commercial success of our existing customer base, delivering industry-leading Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals and expansion revenue by ensuring every customer realises measurable value from Semble.
* Build and lead a high-performing Customer Success organisation, creating a culture of accountability, continuous improvement and customer obsession that develops future leaders and delivers consistently outstanding customer outcomes.
* Transform the customer journey into a strategic growth engine, increasing product adoption, customer advocacy and long-term partnerships through proactive engagement, Executive Business Reviews and value-led success planning.
* Identify and unlock commercial growth opportunities by partnering closely with Sales to drive upsell, cross-sell and expansion opportunities, ensuring Customer Success is a key contributor to Semble's long-term ARR growth.
* Develop scalable, AI-enabled Customer Success operations, implementing best-in-class customer health scoring, lifecycle programmes, automation and data-driven insights that enable the business to scale efficiently without compromising customer experience.
* Act as a voice of the customer across the business. Be a strong and consistent advocate for the customer across the business, partnering with Product, Engineering, Support and Commercial teams to influence product direction, improve the customer experience and ensure customer feedback directly shapes future innovation.
* Provide strategic leadership and insight to the executive team, using customer data, forecasting and performance metrics to identify opportunities, mitigate risk and help position Customer Success as a key driver of Semble's continued growth and success.
* Coach, mentor and inspire a high-performing Customer Success team, creating an environment where people are empowered to do the best work of their careers. Foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, continuous learning, recognition and accountability – which includes celebrating successes, learning from setbacks, and ensuring the team enjoys what they do while delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers.

We're looking for an ambitious, commercially minded, experienced Customer Success leader who is equally passionate about people, customers and business growth. You'll be a strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture while remaining close enough to the detail to coach your team, support customers and remove obstacles.
You'll naturally build strong relationships across the business, influence at every level and inspire those around you with your energy, positivity and high standards. Most importantly, you'll thrive in a fast-moving, scale-up environment where you'll have the autonomy to shape the future of Customer Success, challenge the status quo and make a measurable impact on our customers, our people and the continued success of Semble.
You will need to have:
* Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing Customer Success teams within a B2B SaaS environment, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* A proven track record of improving customer retention, reducing churn and delivering strong Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and customer lifetime value.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience identifying and delivering upsell, cross-sell and expansion opportunities while balancing customer outcomes with business growth.
* The ability to build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, confidently leading strategic customer conversations and business reviews that drive measurable value.
* Experience designing and scaling Customer Success operating models, including customer segmentation, health scoring, lifecycle programmes and success planning. Most of all you need to be curious, and keen to look at the CS function differently (your standard playbook might not be right for Semble, and you need to be happy pivoting – always pushing for new and smarter ways of working, and keen to embrace a new approach, idea or tooling.

* Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve Customer Success efficiency, customer engagement and team productivity.
* An understanding of the healthcare technology, clinical software or regulated SaaS landscape, or the curiosity and ability to quickly become an expert in a new industry.
* Experience partnering with Product teams to influence roadmap decisions through customer feedback, usage data and market insight.
* Proficiency in the French language (nice-to-have, not mandatory).

## Company Description
It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.
## Job Description
ServiceNow is the fastest growing enterprise cloud software company in the world, and we believe it's the great people we hire who will keep us there. We hire carefully, we hire the best, we celebrate our people. Come join our Sales team.
We're looking for a driven Senior Account Executive to join our Commercial Growth team, covering UK Private Sector accounts of 700 to 2,000 employees. You'll own a portfolio of accounts, responsible for both winning new logos and growing our footprint within existing customers. You'll build and execute account strategies that align ServiceNow's platform to each customer's business priorities, working closely with Solution Consultants, Customer Success, Partner Account Managers, and BDRs to build and progress pipeline. This role reports into the Senior Sales Manager, Commercial UK.
What you get to do in this role:
* Meet or exceed sales targets across your UK Commercial territory.
* Own and grow a portfolio of UK Private Sector accounts (700–2,000 employees), driving both net-new logo acquisition and expansion within existing customers.
* Build and execute account strategies, aligning ServiceNow solutions and use cases to each customer's business initiatives.
* Generate self-sourced pipeline, while also leveraging partner and BDR-sourced pipeline to build a healthy, diversified funnel.
* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through to close, following ServiceNow's value-selling methodology.
* Build genuine working relationships with partners to jointly source and progress opportunities.
* Collaborate with an extended team — Solution Consultants, Customer Success, Partner Account Managers, and BDRs — to progress deals and deliver customer value.
* Provide accurate and timely forecasting, territory plans, and account strategies to management.
* Represent ServiceNow's value proposition credibly to senior stakeholders, up to VP and C-level.
* Mentor and support colleagues, contributing to the wider success of the team.
* Occasional travel for training and/or meetings may be required.
## Qualifications
**To be successful in this role you have:**
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
Persistent and dependable, especially with attendance, deliverables, and deadlines.
Excellent relationship-building skills, with the ability to build meaningful business relationships with customers, prospects, partners, and internal colleagues.
Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills.
Strong business acumen — able to understand a customer's strategic priorities and position relevant value accordingly.
A thorough understanding of the sales process, with the ability to navigate and progress complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
Experience growing revenue within an existing customer base, identifying and progressing expansion opportunities.
Proven ability to self-source new logo pipeline, not solely reliant on inbound or partner-registered opportunities.
3-6 years of experience in a closing sales role, with a demonstrable track record of new business development and account management within enterprise software or solution sales.

## Company Description
**About Sibylline**
Sibylline is the world's largest private intelligence firm, helping organisations manage risk, spot opportunity, and build resilience in an increasingly volatile world.
Our people provide the insight that leaders need to navigate today's complex geopolitical landscape. It's meaningful work, with high-profile clients and real-world stakes – and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're innovative, entrepreneurial, and growing fast, which means genuine opportunities to take on complex challenges, work with cutting-edge technology, and build your career, whatever stage you're at.
Everyone brings something different to the table, and we want that reflected in how we operate. Our roles suit a wide range of working styles, personalities, and interests, and we invest heavily in our managers so that every person gets the support they need to do their best work.
We're looking for people who are ambitious, discreet, and sharp, with strong integrity and a genuine curiosity about the world. If you're comfortable with uncertainty, energised by complex problems, and passionate about global affairs, we'd love to hear from you.
## Job Description
**Position Summary**
We are looking for an experienced security Team Lead to join us in an embedded role for a tech client. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing a small team of embedded security analysts, and for its delivery of high-quality and actionable intelligence insights. The team is responsible for using the latest industry technologies and practices to identify, analyse, and advise on threats and risks that could affect the client’s people, operations, and data, with a particular focus on the AI sector. These include but are not limited to activism trends, intellectual property protection, information leaks, competitor analysis, and emerging markets.
You will be responsible for proactively engaging with the client and stakeholders on intelligence needs and priorities and help scope the output and strategic deliverables of the team. You will act as line manager for the embedded team, support each analyst on training, performance management and continuous improvement. You will be responsible for maintaining the team’s shift schedule to ensure capacity needs are meet.
This is a hybrid role working Monday to Friday 9am-5pm, with 3-4 days a week based at the client’s London office. There may be occasional need to work out-of-hours during emergencies and time-sensitive matters.
**Essential Functions / Responsibilities**
* Drive the implementation of the security programme, providing continuous editorial and mentoring support for a small team of UK and US-based Security Analysts
* Set team priorities, delegate tasks, manage deadlines, provide feedback and ensure high-quality service delivery
* Define and agree on key intelligence priorities with security stakeholders, to optimise the production and delivery of regular and ad hoc products
* Work with the team to prepare and deliver credible, timely and actionable intelligence products and verbal briefings to clearly and accurately inform decision making
* Drive the development of the team’s subject matter expertise on AI trends and sector developments, assessing client exposure and implications for its operations and reputation
* Supervise the team’s monitoring of all-source intelligence feeds to monitor for security incidents and trends within the client’s areas of operation and locations and determine the likely impact to staff, assets, operations, events, and reputation
* Support the growth of the intelligence function within the client company by working in collaboration with the client and other team leaders to develop and innovate assessment techniques and SOPs
* Provide thought leadership for internal stakeholders during ongoing incidents, senior management updates, and crisis management briefings
* Display creative thinking and consulting skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client, supporting the global business
* Be an effective leader of a small team, focused on the delivery of lean, high-impact services
* Oversee SOPs for threat triaging and incident management
* Provide mentorship and supervision for team members
* Work flexibly to ensure that client intelligence requirements are met
* Other duties as assigned
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
* Ability to determine how AI, geopolitical and security threats could impact private sector personnel, data, and operations
* Experience, knowledge and interest in current affairs, international relations and emerging security threats, with expertise in political and security dynamics
* Advanced research, intelligence gathering and analytical skills, and the ability to write high-quality products and deliver high-impact briefings for a senior security audience
* Excellent English written and verbal communication skills, with a high attention to detail and the ability to deliver work with little need for editing, and to quality assure (peer review) intelligence products
* Excellent time management and prioritisation skills, with the ability to set and meet deadlines and manage own / a team’s workload accordingly
* Ability to innovate and identify potential opportunities to enhance efficiency and/or effectiveness within a team, including developing own knowledge to increase value
* Ability to solve complex problems with patience and precision, whilst retaining a focus on customer needs
* Ability to build rapport, strong and sustainable relationships, and interact within all levels of the client
* Knowledge of foresight analytics and / or experience establishing horizon scanning products
## Qualifications
* At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in private sector security, corporate intelligence, and / or geopolitical analysis
* Fluency in English (both written and verbal)
* Previous team leadership/management experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Security Studies, International Relations, or related field; Master's degree preferred
* Experience or knowledge of AI trends, activism, and the tech sector, preferred
* Experience with analytical software or OSINT tools, preferred
* Preferred cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role
* Preferred experience with analytical software or OSINT tools
* Preferred experience in data analysis and visualisation

* Initial call with our Talent Acquisition team member

job_description:

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more.
